raw.description:
📍 Remote EMEA • Business • Kayzen

Hello! I am Sebastian, Marketing Lead at Kayzen, and I am looking for a Marketing Manager, Community & Events to join our team.

But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?

Kayzen is the Apps DSP: an AI-native platform built on its own bidding engine, for buying app inventory across mobile and connected TV screens. App developers, agencies, media buyers and ad platforms use Kayzen to drive full-funnel outcomes across both screens, from awareness and consideration to installs, purchases and calls. Available through self-serve and managed services, Kayzen combines machine-learning optimisation with bid- and impression-level transparency, granular control over buying decisions, and AI capabilities that connect campaign data to the AI assistants teams already use. Kayzen’s vision is to democratise programmatic marketing by making it accessible to every team. Headquartered in Berlin, Kayzen operates globally.

🤝 The Team

Join me as part of Kayzen’s growing marketing team, where we collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to drive our strategy forward.You'll collaborate alongside a high-performing, international group spanning customer success, sales, product, engineering, data, operations, design, and marketing. We are strongly guided by the values of positivity, curiosity, collaboration and ownership. Together, we share a strong drive to transform the advertising industry. Sounds interesting?

Responsibilities

We are seeking a relationship-driven, hands-on marketer to make Kayzen more visible and connected across key communities and events in our industry. You will own event marketing and help us to build an active community around Kayzen’s expertise, products and programs - turning in-person and online experiences into meaningful relationships and new commercial opportunities.

Events, Partnerships & Community

  • Own the marketing side of Kayzen’s industry event calendar end-to-end, from event selection and planning through activation, onsite execution and post-event evaluation.
  • Create engaging event experiences, including sponsorships, partner activations, executive dinners, webinars and smaller community gatherings.
  • Work closely with Sales to define target audiences, meeting goals, outreach plans and follow-up processes so events support real business opportunities.
  • Build and nurture a relevant community of customers, prospects, partners and industry voices through ongoing online and offline engagement.
  • Develop co-marketing initiatives with ecosystem partners, including joint events, educational sessions, content activations and shared audience-building opportunities.
  • Coordinate agencies, vendors, designers and other external partners on event production, collateral, communications, budgets and timelines.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Customer Success and Sales teams to bring customer stories, partner perspectives and Kayzen’s market narrative into activations.
  • Track event and community engagement, lead follow-up and program impact, using feedback and results to refine future initiatives.

Requirements

  • A strong track record in industry events, event marketing, experiential, integrated or partner marketing with at least 2 years of event marketing experience (ideally in AdTech, mobile apps or similar industry).
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with confidence representing a company in person, hosting conversations and engaging varied stakeholders.
  • Track record of delivering professional events or community programs from concept through coordination, execution and follow-up.
  • Experience collaborating with Sales on event goals, audience targeting, partner relationships and lead follow-up.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for building communities and connecting people through valuable experiences• Excellent project management, organization and attention to detail; comfortable managing vendors, budgets, timelines, logistics and multiple workstreams.
  • Strong written and spoken English; able to communicate clearly with customers, partners, speakers and colleagues.
  • Familiarity with the programmatic advertising, mobile apps or CTV ecosystem is a strong plus, alongside curiosity to build industry knowledge.
  • Comfortable working in an international, remote-first team and travelling to relevant industry events as the role requires.
  • Ability to cope with stress and a pragmatic approach to solve unexpected, last minute organizational matters.

What do we offer?

  • Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs reshaping the AdTech space.
  • Direct, day-to-day work experience with the leadership team.
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Europe, India, Argentina and soon the US
  • A flexible work-from-home arrangement
  • A 500-dollar home-office setup budget
  • A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget

raw.title: Senior Project Manager, Clinical Trials
raw.excerpt: At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
raw.description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Senior Project Manager accountable for managing multiple Cogstate projects overseeing the delivery of Cogstate Services. The Senior Project Manager will have experience with the pharmaceutical development process, a special aptitude and interest in scientific and technical information, an ability to motivate and mentor project and portfolio teams, and be a highly driven individual who demonstrates initiative and delivers against tight timelines in an agile environment. The Senior Project Manager will have demonstrated experience managing a full workload of clinical projects and/or internal development projects, and a growing awareness of information technology concepts and terminology and experience with direct and indirect people management. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will have confidence and composure in handling stressful situations, problem solving and communicating calmly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders, particularly in areas of disagreement.

This role will require extensive communication and interactions across multiple time zones with staff, Sponsors and clinical sites in countries all over the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage projects and execute tasks in line with company SOPs and agreed regulatory standards, including the following tasks:
  • Manage client relationships as main POC for individual studies and some sponsor portfolios.
    • Independently lead Cogstate’s complex global clinical trials projects – including implementation of projects with new service offerings in scope, where feedback is necessary to the development and commercialization teams to improve process.
  • Manage Clinical Trials projects in Start-Up, Conduct or Close-Out phases (multiple projects at one time).
    • Proactively manage risks with confidence, demonstrating strong leadership in guiding team members through challenges and making decisive, well-informed decisions.
  • Attending Investigator Meetings (as needed) and ensuring Cogstate is well represented.
  • Work in an Agile environment with a given Portfolio Team.
    • Oversight of resourcing and financials across a Portfolio of Projects- ensure team members follow pre-determined hours allocated in budget to target gross profit consistently
  • Generate invoices for assigned projects in alignment with expected timelines and project progress. Maintain a strong understanding of the broader impact of invoicing on company financials.
  • Actively maintain the change order process.
  • Oversee internal projects focused on developing processes for implementing new technologies, with the ability to map, visualize, and optimize workflows to support commercialization and scaling efforts
  • Develop operational deployment plans for new systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
  • Work closely with Business Development and project team managing relationship and supporting proposals for key accounts.
  • Potential to line manage or indirectly manage and mentor other project management team members and clinical operations staff in the future.
  • Analyze reports for project hours and budget utilization and making course corrections in conjunction with Operations Line Managers.
  • Forecast invoicing based on expected timeline and progress of the study
  • Ability to review Work Orders and determine deliverables and timelines for project.
  • Ensure accurate reporting to internal and external stakeholders on service delivery and progress.
  • People/Staff management: Demonstrate high performance in mentoring other project management team members and clinical staff.
  • Develop/contribute to playbooks for new Sponsors/Partners/systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
  • Participate in internal and external audits and inspections.
  • Support metrics reporting to sponsors.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, business or a technical discipline (psychology, nursing, biology, sociology, computer science or engineering). Master’s preferred (science or business) but not mandatory.
  • PMP Certification (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Previous CRO experience preferable.
  • Previous CNS experience.
  • 7+ Years Project Management experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or CRO environment.
  • Supervisory/mentoring experience (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Relationship Management Experience.
  • Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Budget management experience

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Bonus Scheme: This position is eligible to participate in Cogstate’s annual incentive program, with a target bonus opportunity of 10% of base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.
  • Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
  • 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate’s 401k program.
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
  • Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
  • Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
  • Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.
Wage Range
$125,000—$135,000 USD

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

raw.excerpt: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
raw.description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader in the $100B+ CPaaS market. Customers including Airbnb, Snapchat, and thousands of enterprises depend on our APIs and SDKs to deliver SMS, voice, and messaging at scale. The Technical Routing & Quality team sits at the heart of this — owning the configuration and performance of every message and call that traverses the Vonage network.

Why This Role Matters

Every OTP SMS, enterprise marketing message, and API-triggered communication travels through routing groups owned and maintained by this team. As a Technical Routing Analyst, you will own the day-to-day quality and cost performance of global SMS and voice routing, ensuring traffic is delivered reliably, efficiently, and at the best possible margin.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and respond to quality alerts (SMSCR, DLR Success Ratio, Rejected/Undelivered, Queue, Bind-down) via Zendesk and Tableau, following established investigation processes
  • Provide 24x5 follow-the-sun routing assurance coverage in rotation with regional peers
  • Perform proactive quality assurance across SMS and voice destinations — identifying degraded suppliers and initiating route changes
  • Manage country-level routing: evaluate supplier performance against cost and quality targets and implement tiered routing decisions
  • Onboard and test new supplier connections (SMPP/MM4/MM7 protocols) in coordination with Connectivity Operations
  • Identify and escalate carrier degradations, encoding errors, and throughput issues, coordinating resolution with CORT and suppliers
  • Contribute to automation initiatives that improve supplier onboarding times, cost management, and quality alerting
  • Participate in regional handover processes and maintain clear handover notes for the next-shift team
  • Support the migration of SMS services from IBM Data Centres to AWS

What You Will Bring

  • Solid understanding of SMS routing fundamentals — SMPP protocol, DLR codes, encoding, conversion rates, and delivery ratio metrics
  • Experience working with carrier or telco routing systems and monitoring tools (e.g. Tableau, Zendesk, or equivalent)
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate degradation patterns, cross-reference data sources, and drive root-cause resolution
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24x5 operational environment with on-call responsibilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate clearly across time zones with suppliers and internal stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with carrier, product, and engineering teams

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with voice routing metrics (ASR, NER, MOS, PDD) and SIP fundamentals
  • Experience with ML-driven or algorithmic routing systems
  • Knowledge of RCS, Network APIs, or US direct carrier connectivity
  • Background in a CPaaS, wholesale telco, or carrier operations environment

About the Team

The Technical Routing & Quality team is focused on three objectives: reducing tech debt, automating the core business, and investing in growth areas such as Network APIs, RCS, and US direct connectivity. We operate a follow-the-sun model and work closely with Carrier Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to deliver best-in-class routing services.

How You Will Benefit

  • Medical Insurance
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Ericsson Care Line
  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

Makeship empowers influencers, creators, and brands of all sizes to develop and launch limited-edition products that matter to their fans. Leveraging our design, manufacturing, and marketing expertise, we work with our partners to bring their products to life through our community-powered crowdfunding platform. Each product is given a window of 21 days to be funded by the community before we produce and ship to fans worldwide. We put our brand behind every product and guarantee quality and ethical sourcing.

We're profitable; we have a three-year revenue growth of over 200%, ranking us 97th in 2024 and 86th on The Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies of 2025 list. In 2025 alone, our sales exceeded $65M CAD. We are proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified™ for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at Makeship.com.

🧑‍💻 About the Role

Some of the internet’s favourite Creators launch their merch with Makeship, and we’re building the team that finds the next ones.

You know which Creators are about to blow up before everyone else does. You have opinions on the latest streamer drama, the indie game everyone’s sleeping on, and whose merch is actually fire. What if you could get paid to be this chronically online?

As a Business Development Rep (Emerging Legend Hunter) at Makeship, you’ll be the first point of contact for the Creators and brands we want to work with, from gaming and anime to lifestyle and pets. You’ll find them, reach out, and start the conversations that bring them onto our platform, where they turn their communities into limited-edition products their Fans love.

This is a new team with real room to grow. Bring in enough great opportunities, and you’ll help open up the next Account Executive seat. Help shape how the team works and lift the people around you, and there’s a path into leadership.

🌟 What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a Business Development Rep who’ll play a key role in helping us identify and partner with content Creators and brands that are ideal fits for Makeship’s core service offering, helping to drive our top-of-funnel business outreach.

  • Someone who lives online. Gaming, streaming, YouTube, Discord, Twitch fandoms: you know the difference between a trend and a fad
  • An adaptable and resilient self-starter who gets things done, and gets a little competitive about it
  • A hunter’s instinct. You love digging for the opportunities others miss, and you take pride in bringing in the right ones
  • Self-awareness. You take feedback well and actually use it
  • Passion, curiosity, persistence, and comfort reaching out to people you’ve never met
  • We care more about how you think than what’s on your resume

🚀 Your Key Responsibilities

  • Scout content Creators, streamers, and entertainment brands that are a great fit for Makeship
  • Reach out and start real relationships before they join our platform
  • Drive our top-of-funnel outreach and build a pipeline of future partners, getting the best opportunities into the hands of our Account Executives
  • Keep your pipeline organized in our CRM, and use automation to stay connected with Creators who aren’t quite ready yet
  • Bring what you’re seeing in internet culture back to the team, so we stay ahead of what’s next
  • Learn the playbook, run the plays, and tell us what to upgrade

🧠 What You Bring

  • You’re an internet nerd (compliment). You care about Creators, characters, and the communities around them
  • A year or two as a BDR or SDR, or experience reaching out to Creators and influencers for a brand or agency
  • You own your work. When something’s on your plate, you see it through
  • You’re a great listener and a clear communicator, in DMs, emails, and on calls
  • You stay organized when you’re juggling a lot of conversations at once
  • You get creative when the usual approach isn’t working

👀 Bonus

  • Experience working in a CRM, and a knack for turning what’s working into something repeatable. Bonus bonus points if that CRM was Hubspot.
  • Experience with social media or digital marketing, whether it’s for a brand, a Creator, or your own channel
  • Experience in merch or anywhere else in the Creator economy

Want to stand out? We get a lot of applications. Preference goes to the creative, original ones that show us why Makeship and this role matter to you.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

ABOUT US AND ABOUT YOU

Sullivan Cotter partners with health care and other not-for-profit organizations to enhance performance and improve outcomes by developing and implementing integrated workforce strategies. Using our time-tested methodologies and industry-leading research and information, we provide data-driven insights, expertise, and solutions to help organizations align business strategy and performance objectives – enabling our clients to deliver on their mission, vision and values.

Our Executive Workforce Services consultants provide comprehensive advisory services spanning executive compensation, governance, and leadership strategy. We help organizations define and implement effective executive compensation programs that align with market benchmarks, organizational strategies, and regulatory requirements. Our expertise includes governance support for boards and committees, performance evaluations for executives, and design of competitive total compensation . We also advise on executive benefits, pay-for-performance strategies, . Additionally, we provide insights on emerging trends, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and employment agreements to ensure a holistic and compliant approach to executive talent management.

As a Consulting Principal, you will establish and lead multiple executive compensation consulting projects, contributing to all aspects of client engagements, building and nurturing client relationships and providing responsive, thoughtful high-quality client experiences. In addition, you will mentor and develop staff to build technical expertise, strengthen client delivery skills and prepare them for increasing levels of responsibility.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Set or assist in setting strategic direction for large, complex client engagements and serve as one of the senior executive compensation advisor to executive and board-level stakeholders.
  • Own client relationships, including long-term strategy, revenue growth, retention and expansion of services across the portfolio.
  • Provide thought leadership on executive compensation design and governance, advising clients on market positioning, incentive strategy, regulatory considerations and workforce implications.
  • Oversee and quality-assure complex analyses and recommendations, ensuring strategic alignment, defensibility and executive-level clarity.
  • Drive revenue generation, including originating new opportunities, leading proposal development, structuring scope and pricing and participating in closing engagements.
  • Lead and develop high-performing teams, fostering engagement, accountability and a culture of excellence across projects and the broader practice.
  • Guide the allocation of resources across engagements, balancing profitability, client experience and team development.
  • Represent the firm as part of the client team in business development and market-facing activities and prospect meetings.
  • Lead strategic practice initiatives that enhance methodologies, tools, brand presence and overall client services.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert, contributing to innovation in executive compensation strategy and healthcare industry insights.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

We find people who generally fit this profile have a high degree of success in this role:

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in a business-related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Twelve years or more of executive compensation consulting experience.

  • Solid technical knowledge and experience working with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Remote or hybrid work settings. Occasional travel required. Must be physically able to perform the essential functions of the job.

raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask is the best Telehealth platform on the market.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask is the best Telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform.

With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of Telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers' hands for success.

We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

  • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve.
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes.
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
  • Ownership & Accountability, Together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success.

About the Role

Client Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. We're looking for an AI-Native Client Success Manager who takes full ownership of client relationships and uses AI as an essential part of their everyday workflow.

In this role, you'll manage client accounts from onboarding through renewals and expansion, helping entrepreneurs launch and grow their Telehealth businesses on the Bask platform.

You'll use AI tools to research client needs, troubleshoot challenges, improve processes, and identify opportunities to deliver a better client experience. We're looking for someone who is comfortable experimenting with new technologies, thinks independently, and knows how to combine AI-driven efficiency with genuine human relationships.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full client lifecycle, including onboarding, engagement, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.
  • Build strong relationships with Bask clients and help them successfully launch and grow their businesses.
  • Use AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to research client needs, structure problems, draft communications, and improve day-to-day workflows.
  • Develop AI-assisted workflows and automations to streamline onboarding, account management, follow-ups, and troubleshooting.
  • Build logic-based questionnaires and asynchronous patient visit workflows through the Bask platform.
  • Help clients launch medications and identify opportunities to expand their product offerings.
  • Troubleshoot platform, workflow, and order-related issues while proactively identifying solutions.
  • Monitor client health, platform usage, and engagement metrics to identify potential churn risks and growth opportunities.
  • Develop proactive strategies to improve client adoption, retention, and overall account performance.
  • Deliver platform demonstrations, answer technical questions, and recommend creative ways for clients to get more value from Bask.
  • Use client data and measurable outcomes to evaluate the effectiveness of AI-assisted processes and client success initiatives.
  • Validate AI-generated recommendations through research, testing, and client feedback before implementation.
  • Document and share successful AI prompts, automations, and repeatable workflows with the Client Success team.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to improve the client experience.
  • Work Weekends.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Services within a SaaS organization.
  • Experience in e-commerce, ideally supporting DTC brands, online merchants, or e-commerce technology platforms.
  • Experience managing large or enterprise-sized client portfolios.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar LLMs to improve professional workflows.
  • Experience creating, implementing, or improving AI-assisted processes, automations, or repeatable workflows.
  • Ability to provide real examples of how you've used AI to solve problems, improve efficiency, or deliver measurable business results.
  • Strong understanding of client onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, and account expansion.
  • Experience using client engagement data and performance metrics to identify risks and growth opportunities.
  • Ability to independently research problems, evaluate AI-generated information, and turn findings into practical solutions.
  • Good judgment when handling sensitive client information and using AI tools in accordance with company privacy and security requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A creative problem solver who takes initiative and is comfortable navigating unfamiliar challenges.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts and priorities.
  • Comfortable collaborating across teams and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

How We Work With AI

At Bask Health, AI isn't an occasional productivity tool. It's part of how we approach problems, make decisions, and support our clients.

We expect our Client Success team to:

  • Start with AI when researching, organizing information, and exploring solutions.
  • Use independent judgment to verify AI-generated recommendations before putting them into practice.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve existing workflows.
  • Use approved tools and follow applicable privacy and security requirements when handling client or patient information.
  • Measure the effectiveness of AI-assisted workflows and continuously refine them based on results.
  • Experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Share successful processes and workflows so the entire team can work more efficiently.

The ideal candidate doesn't need to be an AI engineer, but should be someone who naturally looks for ways to use AI to work smarter and deliver better results

raw.description:
As Mercury prepares to become a bank, our Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) program is in active development to meet bank-level regulatory expectations. As an early member of a growing TPRM team, you’ll help run the program day-to-day and contribute how it matures, bringing your own judgment and point of view to a function that is usually more rigidly defined, with room to be creative and make your mark.

As a Third Party Risk Manager, you’ll help protect Mercury, our customers, and the broader financial ecosystem from the risks that come with relying on third parties. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Third Party Risk Management, you’ll complete third-party risk assessments, support risk reporting, and provide second-line oversight.

As a Third Party Risk Manager, you will play a key part in helping protect Mercury, our customers, and the broader financial ecosystem from the risks associated with third parties. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Third Party Risk Management, you will conduct third party risk assessments, help build out related risk reporting, and carry out second line oversight activities to help reduce the impact of third-party risks.

This position focuses on enterprise-wide TPRM, rather than in-depth expertise in a specific domain like security or privacy. You will work closely with subject-matter experts across Compliance, Information Security, Privacy, and Procurement to make sure their requirements are reflected in the program, bringing a view across the full third-party lifecycle and the regulatory expectations that come with banking.*

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assess and risk rate: Complete third-party risk assessments, risk rate third parties, and open and track issues through resolution.
  • Second-line oversight: Review and challenge first-line due diligence and ongoing monitoring, including reporting, approvals and oversight of those activities. First-line owners remain accountable for managing the third-party relationship, including SLAs, business reviews, exit strategies and onboarding.
  • Reporting and data: Support maintenance of third party risk reporting and metrics for management and governance forums, and help keep the underlying data accurate.
  • Tooling and automation: Help implement tooling and automation to make processes more efficient
  • Program uplift: Support and contribute to uplift efforts across the TPRM program, including updates to policies, due diligence, risk assessment processes, and risk management across the third party lifecycle

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of third party risk management experience, including 2+ years in a regulated financial services environment (bank, or fintech working with bank partners)
  • Working knowledge of regulatory guidance on third party risk, including the Interagency Guidance on Third Party Relationships (and related FFIEC, OCC and FDIC expectations), and TPRM industry practices across the third party lifecycle (planning, due diligence, contracting, monitoring, termination)
  • Hands-on experience completing third party risk assessments across multiple risk domains, not only security
  • Experience reviewing and challenging first-line risk work with evidence-based pushback
  • Experience supporting audits or exams of a TPRM program (gathering evidence, responding to requests, following up on findings)
  • Experience building or maintaining TPRM reporting and metrics, with attention to data accuracy
  • Solid program and project management skills, with experience supporting a program that spans multiple cross-functional components and driving process improvements through to implementation
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners (Procurement, Finance, InfoSec, Legal, Privacy) without direct authority
  • Clear communicator who can explain a risk position and hold it under pushback

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience at a bank, or a fintech moving toward banking
  • Experience improving or uplifting an existing TPRM program
  • Experience with TPRM tooling, automation or AI-enabled workflows
  • Familiarity with enterprise risk concepts (risk register, risk appetite, committee reporting)
  • Relevant certification (e.g., CISA, CGRC)

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

$132,400—$165,500 USD

$119,200—$149,000 USD

$125,100—$156,400 CAD

Role Overview

ProAg is looking for an Associate Underwriter or Underwriter to join our western team who is innovative, builds strong relationships, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position is responsible for reviewing annual policy documents to ensure adherence to federal and company guidelines for our western region. Our underwriting staff builds meaningful, long-lasting relationships with agents and serves as a subject matter expert for internal and external customers.


In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

· Review policy information for crop insurance coverage, proper rating, and other information to determine if application is acceptable for the available program or selected coverage.

· Contact and respond to verbal and written inquiries from agents within designated timeframe to provide appropriate information and serve as an underwriting resource.

· Verify rates of policies or check previously rated policies for proper rating using the tools available such as the Risk Management Agency (RMA) and ProAg quoting applications.

· Utilize knowledge of automated underwriting and/or processing systems to develop information for new or renewal policies.

· Answer questions from agents, policyholder, or prospects.

· Adhere to all company underwriting authority directives, underwriting guidelines, and other applicable company policies and procedures.

· Request additional documentation necessary for the processing policy coverage, including applications, production reports, acreage reports, and endorsements.

· Approve or deny within given authority or recommend approval or denial to higher authority.

· Review requests for cancellation, endorsements, etc.

· Analyze and research detailed policy information related to Federal Crop Insurance Corporation (FCIC) error resolution and resolve any uncleared items.

· Read and interpret FCIC documents.

· Analyze and revise acreage reports.

· Respond to common inquiries from RMA and RSOs.

· Ensure compliance with organization policies and government regulations including all deadlines associated with sales closing dates (SCDs), acreage reporting dates (ARDs), production reporting dates (PRDs), accounting cutoffs, and fund designations.

· Cultivate relationships with internal and external contacts to facilitate the underwriting process, promote business development, and to remain abreast of industry trends.

· Serve as a resource to other departmental staff with regard to underwriting procedures and other departmental guidelines.

· Develop understanding of various factors that affect and influence policy rating and risk.

· Assist with data entry as needed.

· Attend required training sessions.

  • A minimum of two years of relevant and progressive professional experience.
  • Previous agriculture or crop insurance industry experience preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Business Administration, or a related field, or the equivalent education and/or experience.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.

  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription

  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service.


Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States,

the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability

raw.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Dataiku is the enterprise AI platform used by 25% of the Fortune 500. Since June 2026, we have priced our new products on credits. The opportunity now is larger: expand credits across the platform, bring partners and a broader set of technologies onto them, and build a real credit economy that gives customers optionality and control over how they use and pay for AI.

How you’ll make an impact

You will be the single-threaded owner of this new business: one revenue number, one plan, and the mandate to get product, engineering, sales, finance, marketing, and partners working to that plan. AI economics are still to be invented, and you will write the playbook for it.

You will report to the CEO and co-founder and work with the CTO and co-founder. You will have no direct reports. Owners in Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and Marketing stay in their teams, are accountable to you for this business, and meet in one recurring forum you run to review pipeline, launches, and blockers and leave with decisions.

You own the strategy for this business: where to play first, how to package and price it, and how fast to grow it. You share responsibility for a number with the sales leadership.

In your first year, you will:

  • Make credits the favorite way customers commit to Dataiku.
  • Build the partner ecosystem around credits: business development with infrastructure and software vendors.
  • Align the company around credits: product strategy and roadmap with the CPO and CTO, so new capabilities are built, packaged, and metered for consumption; the credit story with the CMO; and sales incentives with the CRO.
  • Give customers and account teams usage reporting they act on.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • You have built an enterprise software business on consumption or usage-based pricing, including the billing, revenue recognition, and compensation it required.
  • You know how to build a plan to scale a business from zero to $100M, and you have carried the revenue number for one: a product line, a business unit, a new market, or a company you founded.
  • You get teams working toward one business goal, and you have results to show for it.
  • You build the financial model yourself and can explain the product to a CIO.
  • You decide fast on incomplete information, argue in the open (including with the CEO), and change your position when the data calls for it.
  • You work AI-native. You use models and agents in your own analysis and operations, and you know how AI is priced and bought: tokens, credits, committed spend.
  • You are US-based (or willing to relocate), and ready to travel to customers, partners, and Dataiku offices worldwide.

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate.   • Direct experience working within, selling to or advising financial services organisations.
  • Strong understanding of financial services business models, value drivers and operating challenges, including the importance of governance, controls, data quality, resilience, auditability and regulatory compliance.
  • Credibility with senior finance and technology stakeholders, particularly CFO and Finance leadership audiences, and the ability to connect strategic priorities to a clear transformation and investment case.
  • Practical knowledge of Workday HCM & Financial Management and its role in an enterprise transformation. The successful candidate must be able to lead an informed business conversation about Workday and collaborate with specialists on detailed solution design.
  • Proven ability to create industry and account strategies, qualify opportunities, build pipeline, forecast accurately and deliver against quarterly and annual targets.
  • Experience leading complex, matrixed pursuit teams and coordinating sales, presales, delivery, commercial, legal, partner and executive stakeholders across multiple countries.
  • Advanced commercial and negotiation capability.
  • Excellent executive communication, storytelling and presentation skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence at C-suite level.
  • Ability to travel across EMEA as required and to work effectively across different cultures, languages, market maturities and regulatory environments.

Desirable experience and knowledge

  • Detailed knowledge of Workday HCM & Financial Management, Workday Adaptive Planning and relevant Workday platform capabilities; Workday sales, consulting or customer-side experience would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience selling cloud ERP, finance transformation, enterprise performance management, data, integration or managed services in regulated industries.
  • An established senior network across EMEA financial services and/or the Workday ecosystem.
  • Experience developing repeatable industry propositions, account-based marketing campaigns, executive events or alliance-led pipeline.
  • Relevant professional or industry qualifications, for example accountancy, finance, banking, insurance, risk or enterprise technology credentials.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

raw.title: Senior UX Designer
raw.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
raw.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

As a Senior UX Designer, you’ll both lead design and partner with other designers to create AI-powered experiences across CoLab. You’ll help shape how engineers interact with AI, evaluate its recommendations and work alongside agents to accomplish complex tasks.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll bring strong skills across the full design process, from discovery and problem definition to interaction design, visual polish, and implementation with particular depth in designing AI interfaces.

You’ll partner closely with product managers, engineers, and AI specialists to explore what’s possible, define useful applications, and build experiences grounded in customer needs. As a Senior designer, you’ll also guide design direction across squads, mentor other designers, and establish shared patterns for AI interactions throughout CoLab.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re an experienced UX designer with a demonstrated track record of making AI useful to people. You’ve worked beyond demos and prototypes, and you can speak to what happened when real users encountered your designs: what they understood, where they struggled, and how you improved the experience.

You know when conversation is a useful interaction model and when a structured workflow, direct manipulation, or a combination of approaches will serve users better. You think carefully about how people provide context, communicate intent, review results, and stay in control as AI takes on more work.

You’re comfortable designing for uncertainty. You consider incomplete information, incorrect outputs, long-running tasks, and unexpected behavior as part of the core experience. You help users understand what the system is doing, what needs their attention, and how to correct or recover from a mistake.

You also bring the judgment and influence expected of a Senior designer. You help teams navigate ambiguity, connect decisions across product areas, and balance near-term delivery with a coherent longer-term experience. You care deeply about research, interaction quality, accessibility, and visual craft.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead, partner and support UX design for AI-powered products and workflows from discovery through implementation and iteration.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and AI specialists to identify valuable customer problems and shape how AI capabilities address them.
  • Design conversational, contextual, and agent-driven interfaces that help users express intent, provide relevant information, and act on results.
  • Design agent orchestration experiences that make plans, task progress, dependencies, approvals, and handoffs understandable and manageable.
  • Establish clear patterns for human oversight, including reviewing proposed actions, setting boundaries, intervening in execution, and recovering from errors.
  • Help users evaluate AI outputs through appropriate source context, explanations, and visibility into system limitations.
  • Plan and conduct customer discovery, usability testing, and prototype validation, including realistic scenarios where AI outputs are incomplete, incorrect, or unexpected.
  • Create design artifacts across the full fidelity spectrum, from workflow diagrams and wireframes to interactive prototypes and polished interfaces.
  • Partner with engineers throughout implementation and evaluate the resulting experience using customer feedback, product data, and AI performance insights.
  • Contribute shared AI interaction patterns to our design system, align experiences across teams, and mentor other designers

Qualifications

  • Significant product or UX design experience, typically gained through 5+ years of practice, with a track record of leading complex initiatives at a Senior level.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping AI-powered interfaces. Your portfolio should show your contributions, the behavior of the AI system, the interaction decisions you made, and what you learned from real-world use.
  • Substantial experience with one or more of the following: conversational interfaces, LLM-powered workflows, AI assistants, autonomous or semi-autonomous agents, or agent orchestration tools.
  • A practical understanding of how AI behavior affects UX, including variability in outputs, latency, context limitations, and failure modes.
  • Strong UX fundamentals, including information architecture, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, and systems thinking.
  • Fluency in Figma and the ability to build prototypes that communicate dynamic interactions and system behavior.
  • Using AI tools like Claude and Codex to accelerate your design process with code-based prototypes
  • Strong collaboration with technical partners and the ability to make clear trade-offs between user needs, model capabilities, engineering constraints, and business goals.
  • Experience influencing design direction across teams and helping other designers improve their work.

Nice to Have:

  • Education or practical knowledge in machine learning, how LLMs work, or agent architecture.
  • Experience designing controls for agent permissions, action approvals, activity history, or auditability in enterprise environments.
  • Experience collaborating on AI evaluations and connecting measures of model quality with usability, task success, and user trust.
  • Ability to prototype with code, APIs, or AI development tools to explore realistic interactions, potentially submitting your own PRs for simpler collaboration
  • Experience designing for engineering, manufacturing, or other technical domains where accuracy and human judgment matter.

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

raw.title: Gameplay Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories.
raw.description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Gameplay Engineer, you will craft tactile and immersive gameplay systems that will fuel the adventure and enable the stories within our games. You will partner with designers to understand the vision and intent behind game features, realize those features in Unreal using C++ and Blueprints, and apply your architectural expertise to enable the iterative development and evolution of our game. You will be a key player in connecting our players to the game world and enabling them to explore, interact and create memorable multiplayer moments.

A Day in the Life:

  • Apply your expertise with the Unreal Engine (C++ and Blueprints) to own the implementation of gameplay mechanics in close collaboration with the design team.

  • Develop flexible, scalable systems designed for iterative development that facilitate emergent game interactions.

  • Playtest regularly with the team to prototype new ideas and ensure gameplay is progressing in accordance with our game’s pillars.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple gameplay features across the game, partnering closely with design and production to achieve creative intent and balance development prioritization.

  • Advocate for excellence in tactile, immersive game feel across the project and the studio.

  • Collaborate closely with design, art and animation to align with game vision and provide technical expertise and perspective on decisions and alternatives.

  • Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and identifying and reducing friction in the development process.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience building game mechanics across one or more projects.

  • Deep expertise in Unreal’s gameplay frameworks, including character/camera controllers, behavior trees, Blackboard and the Gameplay Ability System.

  • Solid understanding of Unreal’s multiplayer framework, including replication RPCs, and the ability to incorporate the implications of a networked multiplayer environment into feature implementation.

  • Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

Nice to Haves:

  • Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine.

  • Prior experience owning the decision-making and implementation of significant portions of control/camera systems, NPC AI/behavior, combat or ability/action features in a multiplayer context.

  • Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay systems for large-scale content.

The Team:

  • You will report to the Lead Gameplay Engineer.

  • You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on.

How We Work

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

  • Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions.

  • Adapt when plans change.

  • Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection.

  • Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work.

  • Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning.

  • Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together.

You'll Thrive Here If...

  • You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions.

  • You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve.

  • You balance ambition with pragmatism.

  • You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback.

  • You care about helping your teammates succeed.

  • You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new.

Please Note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST).

Our Interview Process

(all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted)

  • Step 1: People Operations Introduction

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview

  • Step 3: Panel Interview (3 - 1 Hour Sections)

  • Step 4: Gardeners Debrief

  • Step 5: Offer

Life at Gardens

Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more.

We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it.

Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us could build alone.

Gardens Offers:

  • Competitive salaries and pay transparency

  • Stock options

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for individuals, 90% for dependents)

  • Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, and additional benefits

  • 401(k) contributions (U.S.) / RRSP + DPSP contributions (Canada)

  • Paid parental leave

  • A fully distributed remote studio across North American time zones

Benefits and perks listed may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Gardens and the country in which you work.

Physical Requirements: This is a primarily sedentary, remote role requiring the ability to remain stationary and perform computer-based work for extended periods, including sustained use of monitors, keyboards, mice, and game controllers for a minimum of six hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. Gardens is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Encouragement: We believe that diverse perspectives make our team stronger and our games better. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every single qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Research consistently shows that talented people, particularly women, people of color, and those from historically underrepresented communities are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. We care far more about curiosity, growth, and a willingness to learn than checking every box.

Scam Note: Unfortunately, scammers have impersonated Gardens Interactive by offering fake employment opportunities intended to collect financial information.

Official communication from our team will always come from a @ email address. We will never ask for financial information during the hiring process.

If you're ever unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly through LinkedIn or

Compensation Range: $155K - $171K

¡Trabaja en DaCodes!

Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.

Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.

En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.

Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.

¿Te interesa?

Requirements

🎯 Sobre el rol

Buscamos un Fullstack .NET Developer que trabaje en las tres capas: backend en C#/.NET, base de datos en SQL Server y frontend en Vue, React o Angular.

Gran parte de la lógica de negocio vive en la base de datos. Por eso buscamos a alguien que escriba y optimice stored procedures en SQL Server sobre tablas con millones de registros, y que también construya las pantallas que consumen esa información.

🔧 Principales responsabilidades

  • Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web con C# / .NET (Framework y/o .NET Core / .NET 8), MVC y Web API.
  • Construir pantallas y funcionalidades completas en Vue.js (ideal), React o Angular.
  • Escribir, optimizar y depurar consultas y stored procedures en SQL Server.
  • Analizar planes de ejecución, índices y queries lentos en tablas de millones de registros.
  • Desarrollar funcionalidades de punta a punta: pantalla → API → stored procedure.
  • Participar en pruebas de rendimiento y en el troubleshooting de SQL y backend.
  • Trabajar en equipo bajo metodologías ágiles.

✅ Requisitos obligatorios

  • +3 años desarrollando con C# / .NET como stack principal (MVC, Web API, .NET Core).
  • +3 años con SQL Server escribiendo stored procedures, queries complejos y optimizaciones. La experiencia en MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle o DB2 no sustituye a SQL Server.
  • +3 años construyendo pantallas propias en Vue, React o Angular, conectadas a APIs .NET.
  • Experiencia comprobable en funcionalidades completas de punta a punta (frontend + backend + base de datos).
  • Uso de Entity Framework, con dominio de SQL nativo.

🚫 Este perfil no es para ti si:

  • Tu stack principal es PHP/Laravel, Java, Node o Python.
  • Solo trabajas en backend o solo en frontend.
  • En frontend solo has hecho mantenimiento o soporte, sin construir pantallas propias.
  • Tu experiencia en bases de datos es principalmente en Oracle, DB2, MySQL o PostgreSQL.

⭐ Deseable

  • ASP.NET WebForms o sistemas legacy
  • Integraciones con APIs de IA (OpenAI, Google Cloud)

📍 Requisitos adicionales

  • Ubicación: cualquier país de LATAM
  • 100% remoto
  • Ingeniería en Sistemas, Computación o afín (deseable)

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

📍 Modalidad híbrida

📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients 


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.  

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer.  As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.  

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. 


SENIOR DIRECTOR CLINICAL RISK AND INSIGHTS


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the Clinical Risk & Insights function, driving systemic investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and clinical risk intelligence to strengthen clinical trial execution, inform strategic decisions, and enable continuous improvement across Global Development Operations (GDO).

  • Define and lead the GDO-wide RCA strategy, establishing investigation standards, methodologies, and capabilities to identify systemic risks and prevent recurring issues.
  • Oversee complex and cross-portfolio clinical execution investigations, ensuring effective issue prioritisation, escalation, and resolution.
  • Provide strategic risk insights and recommendations to senior leadership and governance forums, translating investigation findings and emerging trends into actionable decisions.
  • Drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), challenging ineffective solutions and sponsoring cross-functional improvements to address systemic risks.
  • Lead the Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) strategy, integrating systemic learning and portfolio risk intelligence into proactive risk identification and clinical trial execution.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, overseeing strategic priorities, talent development, resources, budgets, and organisational RCA capabilities.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across GDO, Clinical Compliance, R&D Quality, study delivery teams, and external stakeholders to strengthen governance, risk management, and operational excellence.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. What we seek in you as an experienced professional, are these qualifications and skills:

  • Degree educated
  • Extensive experience in biopharmaceutical clinical development, Clinical Operations, or clinical quality, with strong knowledge of GCP and clinical trial execution.
  • Proven expertise in RCA, complex cross-functional investigations, systemic risk identification, and CAPA effectiveness.
  • Ability to translate complex clinical risk insights into actionable recommendations for senior leadership and governance forums.
  • Strong strategic leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with experience driving cross-functional improvement and organisational change.
  • Experience in clinical risk management or Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM), including risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and quality indicators.
  • Experience in quality trend analysis, operational excellence, analytics, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience leading teams, including managers, and overseeing budgets, resources, and organisational capabilities.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.  

careers.amgen.com 

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Congress Peer to Peer Engagement Obesity and Related Conditions - Senior Manager

The Senior Manager, Congress Peer to Peer Engagement translates U.S. peer to peer strategy into coordinated congress programs across the portfolio. This role requires recent, hands on experience leading congress programs from end to end logistics and commercial opinion leader management through on site execution and post congress follow through. The Senior Manager works closely with Congress, Health Care Professional (HCP) Marketing, Omnichannel, Sales, Medical, Corporate Affairs, Advocacy, Strategic Account Managers, Global partners, and agencies to create relevant, well coordinated customer experiences.


This role is an opportunity to shape how healthcare professionals connect and learn at congresses while ensuring that the right people, programs, and partners are aligned from planning through follow through.


What You Will Do


Lead Congress Peer to Peer Planning and Pull Through


  • Translate approved peer to peer and brand priorities into integrated congress plans that define audiences, engagement objectives, program scope, key milestones, and follow through before, during, and after each congress.
  • Coordinate commercial peer to peer activities across priority congresses and commercial meetings, ensuring plans are connected to the broader customer journey and consistent with approved strategy.
  • Build detailed workback plans, timelines, budgets, roles, and decision points with internal partners and agency teams; identify risks early and keep work moving through execution.
  • Partner with Congress and Sales leaders to align congress plans with customer engagement priorities, field needs, and launch readiness.

Coordinate Commercial Opinion Leader Engagement


  • Manage commercial opinion leader engagement across congress programs, including outreach, relationship coordination, availability, briefing, preparation, scheduling, and on site support, consistent with company policies and approved plans.
  • Coordinate opinion leader contracting from initiation through completed agreement, working with Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and other internal partners to keep contracts, documentation, and timing aligned with company requirements.
  • Develop clear faculty and opinion leader preparation materials with relevant content owners; prepare speakers on program objectives, audience needs, logistics, and approved content, and support clinically grounded HCP discussions in partnership with Medical and other content owners.
  • Maintain an organized view of opinion leader participation and program needs across congresses, and identify opportunities to strengthen continuity and the customer experience.
  • Partner with the Experiential Peer to Peer Engagement and Amplification Senior Manager to connect congress voices and insights with experiences and approved content that may extend beyond the event.

Coordinate Cross Functional Congress Engagement


  • Create clear planning rhythms and shared workplans with HCP Marketing, Omnichannel, Sales, Medical, Corporate Affairs, Advocacy, Strategic Account Managers, Global partners, Congress, and agency teams.
  • Clarify objectives, audiences, roles, and handoffs across programs so customers experience coordinated engagement while each function maintains its distinct purpose and review process.
  • Coordinate appropriate opportunities for cross functional participation and ensure that agendas, materials, and logistics are aligned with approved plans.
  • Work with Medical, Legal, and Regulatory reviewers and other partners to move materials and activities through the appropriate review pathways while preserving strategic intent.

Manage Congress Logistics and On Site Execution


  • Own end to end logistics for peer to peer programs, including schedules, venues, registration, travel coordination where applicable, run of show, rehearsals, vendor and agency deliverables, contingency planning, and on site readiness.
  • Coordinate rehearsals, speaker support, room or experience readiness, staffing, and issue resolution to ensure programs run smoothly and provide a positive customer experience.
  • Track budgets, purchase orders, timelines, and deliverables; maintain accurate documentation and escalate risks or changes promptly.
