raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.title: QC & Data Management Lead
raw.excerpt: About Us: Flourish Research is where clinical trials thrive.
raw.description:
About Us:

Flourish Research is where clinical trials thrive. Flourish Research is one of the industry’s most progressive and diversified clinical trial organizations, with strong capabilities across cardiology, metabolic disorders, renal, oncology, CNS, pulmonology, and vaccine research. At Flourish Research, we strive toward excellence. In clinical trials and healthcare, excellence means everyone deserves the best care, regardless of their race, color, gender identity, religion, ethnicity, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation, or veteran status. We embrace employees, customers, and patients from these underrepresented groups to help make this vision a reality. Flourish is committed to a safe work environment where all employees, customers, and patients are included, and treated with dignity and respect. The more diversity we have in our team, the more unique perspectives, and ideas we share, and the better prepared we are to serve our communities. WE SEE YOU. WE ARE YOU. WE EMBRACE YOU. WE CELEBRATE YOU! 

 Flourish Research is looking for motivated, talented, creative individuals who want to learn and grow in their careers while contributing to research that changes lives! We offer an excellent comprehensive benefits package, a supportive and collaborative work environment, and endless growth opportunities. 

About the Job:  

We are actively hiring a QC & Data Management Lead. This is a remote position.

Shift: Monday-Friday (40 hours per week)

Location: Remote- United States

PURPOSE: Assure quality research data is collected by adhering to Flourish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), GCP, FDA, and protocol guidelines for all subject data that is submitted into the QC data entry department. Work closely with clinical research coordinators (CRCs) and ensure that the QC data entry department is utilizing the Punctual Accurate Complete True (P.A.C.T.) System. Assist clinical research associates (CRAs) during internal monitoring visits.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  1. Conduct a thorough and precise review of all study charts utilizing Flourish SOPs and sponsor-provided protocols.
  1. Accurately enter data into an eCRF/CRF system according to the sponsor provided eCRF/CRF guidelines in a timely manner.
  1. Identify and report any missing data points or inconsistencies to the CRC in a timely manner to ensure all data is clean and accurate.
  1. Source document creation/approval.
  1. Report any discrepancies between the source and CRF/eCRF immediately to the primary CRC and/or Team Lead.
  1. Notify Operations Leadership, Team Lead, and CRC of any major discrepancies and deviations in a timely manner.
  1. Resolve open queries thoroughly, accurately and in a timely manner.
  1. Assist in sponsor monitor visits to resolve queries in a timely manner.
  1. Perform all assigned duties in a timely- and cost-effective manner.
  1. Actively learn and seek opportunities to expand expertise as a Lead, QC & Data Management.
  1. Oversee quality/quantity of QC & Data Management Specialists to ensure that all assigned tasks are completed accurately and in a timely manner.
  1. Perform employee 1:1s.
  1. Conduct regular team meetings.
  1. Train new employees regarding QC/DE processes.
  1. Attend pre-study visits (PSVs) and site initiation visits (SIVs).
  1. Attend manager meetings.
  1. Efficiently and effectively oversee the QC Data Entry department.
  1. Represent Flourish Research in a professional and courteous manner (verbal, written and in appearance) when interacting with all staff, clients, and vendors.
  1. Additional duties as assigned by management.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND/OR ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:

  1. Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment.
  1. Local travel is required.
  1. Monitor/Sponsor customer service.
  1. Daily computer use.
  1. Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time as work is performed on computer.
  1. Occasional evening and weekend work schedules.
  1. Ability to properly lift thirty-five pounds and occasionally more than thirty-five pounds.
  1. Ability to drive and daily availability of an automobile.

Requirements

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Education:Bachelor's degree or commensurate experience.

Experience: Minimum of 2 years in the department plus 2 years in related role within the clinical research industry. Must have industry certification, as applicable.

Knowledge and Skills:

  1. Consistently demonstrates core values & high proficiency in skills set.
  1. Must have the ability to understand medical terminology and research concepts.
  1. Must have the ability to identify appropriate subject care, relate in a professional and knowledgeable manner to physicians, pharmaceutical sponsors/CROs.
  1. Must have a basic knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), computer, internet, and Microsoft Office applications.
  1. Manage multiple tasks, ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, work independently, exercise initiative, demonstrate sound judgement, and consistently demonstrate effective oral and written communication.
  1. Develops and implements key initiatives in the department.
  1. Identifies and implements process improvements for increased efficiency.
  1. Builds and fosters relationships across teams.
  1. Consistently accomplishes 80% of individual goals each quarter.
  1. Serves as preceptor, mentor, and subject matter expert in the department.
  1. Demonstrates strong critical thinking and decision-making skills resulting in sound judgment.
  1. Flexible and able to multi-task and prioritize competing demands.
  1. Ability to think independently and influence when appropriate.

Benefits

Health, dental, and vision insurance plans, 401(k) with a 100% employer match on the first 4% of employee contributions, tuition reimbursement, parental leave, employee referral program, employee assistance program, life insurance, disability insurance, and a generous PTO plan covering vacation, sick, personal days and 8 paid holidays. 

Flourish Research is an equal employment opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on merit and business needs, and not on race, color, sex, (including pregnancy and gender identity), citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, or any other factor protected by law. Flourish Research complies with the law regarding reasonable accommodation for handicapped and disabled employees.

raw.title: Senior Manager, Information Assurance Services
raw.excerpt: Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything.
raw.description:
Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything. Aprio has 40 U.S. office locations, as well as international office locations and more than 3,200 team members that speak 60+ languages across the globe. By bringing together proven expertise, deep understanding, and strategic foresight for fast-growing industries, Aprio ensures clients are prepared for wherever life or business may take them. Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio.

Job Summary

Aprio is seeking a Senior Manager, Information Assurance Services to lead client delivery across a growing portfolio of compliance and assurance engagements, including SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, and privacy advisory services. In this role, you will manage all phases of the client engagement lifecycle, build lasting client relationships, and drive quality outcomes across delivery teams. You will play a meaningful role in developing team members and contributing to business development as part of a practice experiencing sustained growth of over 30% year over year. This is an opportunity to bring your technical expertise and leadership skills to a team making a real impact for clients navigating complex regulatory environments.

What You'll Gain / Impact:

  • Opportunity to lead and shape a high-growth Information Assurance Services practice at a national scale.
  • Exposure to a broad range of compliance frameworks, regulatory environments, and client industries.
  • Ability to influence team member development, career growth, and practice talent strategy.
  • Hands-on leadership across client delivery, business development, and practice operations.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and initiative drive real outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

    • Lead client engagements across all phases, including planning, delivery, staffing, quality management, issue resolution, and reporting.
    • Apply industry and technical expertise to identify and assess risks and controls relevant to clients' business environments.
    • Deliver a range of compliance and assurance services, including SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, GDPR, CCPA, and Privacy Shield.
    • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.
    • Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support practice growth and individual career advancement.
    • Contribute to business development efforts, including supporting sales initiatives and practice growth strategies.
    • Lead and participate in internal initiatives that strengthen practice operations and service delivery quality.

Candidate Qualifications

    • Relevant certification (CPA, CISA, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent), or demonstrated willingness to obtainMinimum of 7 years of IT audit or equivalent consulting and/or auditing experience.
    • Demonstrated ability to lead engagement teams, manage client relationships, and oversee work paper review and testing.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality reports and audit documentation.
    • Proven project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple delivery teams and client engagements simultaneously.
    • Ability to train, develop, and retain team members in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
    • Commitment to exceptional client service with strong problem-solving skills and a consultancy mindset.
    • Preferred: Experience supporting business development, sales, or practice growth initiatives.
The application window is anticipated to close on December 1, 2026 and may be extended as needed.

Why work for Aprio:

Whether you are just starting out, looking to advance into management or searching for your next leadership role, Aprio offers an opportunity to grow with a future-focused, innovative firm.
Perks/Benefits we offer for full-time team members:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance on the first day of employment
- Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Account
- 401k with Profit Sharing
- 9+ holidays and discretionary time off structure
- Parental Leave – coverage for both primary and secondary caregivers
- Tuition Assistance Program and CPA support program with cash incentive upon completion
- Discretionary incentive compensation based on firm, group and individual performance
- Incentive compensation related to origination of new client sales
- Top rated wellness program
- Flexible working environment including remote and hybrid options

What’s in it for you:

- Working with an industry leader: Be part of a high-growth firm that is passionate for what’s next.
- An awesome culture: Thirty-one fundamental behaviors guide our culture every day ensuring we always deliver an exceptional team-member and client experience. We call it the Aprio Way. This shared mindset creates lasting relationships between team members and with clients.
- A great team: Work with a high-energy, passionate, caring and ambitious team of professionals in a collaborative culture.
- Entrepreneurship: Have the freedom to innovate and bring your ideas to help us grow to become the CPA firm of choice nationally.
- Growth opportunities: Grow professionally in an environment that fosters continuous learning and advancement.
- Competitive compensation: You will be rewarded with competitive compensation, industry-leading benefits and a flexible work environment to enjoy work/life balance.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Aprio is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex; pregnancy; sexual orientation; gender identity and/or expression; age; disability; genetic information, citizenship status; military service obligations or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Aprio, LLP and Aprio Advisory Group, LLC, operate in an alternative business structure, with Aprio Advisory Group, LLC providing non-attest tax and consulting services, and Aprio, LLP providing CPA firm services.

Molina Healthcare of Nebraska is hiring for a Senior Analyst, Provider and Claim Data & Analytics. This role is remote for those within the United States.

Highly Qualified Candidates Will Have the Following Experience-

  • Medicaid and managed care
  • Claims and coding experience. A coder certification is a plus but not required
  • Ability to support network adequacy and provider data integrity by digging into provider claims and lead provider data clean-up efforts.
  • Root cause analysis
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing their own formulas or queries along with strong Excel skills
  • Be a self-starter who can jump in where needed, pivot when required, all while having strong attention to detail

Essential Job Duties

  • Provides senior level analyst support for data analysis and reporting activities. Responsible for organizing data from multiple sources to produce reports, dashboards, and analyses related to utilization, cost-containment, and business performance. Generates data-related insights that support strategic and operational decision-making and cost-containment. Designs and delivers reporting, analytics, and data solutions across business and healthcare domains, including claims, utilization, finance, and other business areas. Partners with stakeholders to define requirements, develop scalable reporting and data processes, and apply advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and drive business performance. Supports projects, regulatory requests, and initiatives that improve data quality, reporting workflows, and process efficiencies.
  • Analyzes complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Designs, develops, and maintains reports, dashboards, and data solutions using tools such as Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft Excel, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), that support utilization analysis, cost-containment, and operational performance.
  • Translates business needs into reporting and analytical requirements; partners with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
  • Facilitates healthcare data analysis, including data related to claims, pharmacy, lab, utilization, cost, and other areas.
  • Develops and maintains data processes for extraction, transformation, validation, and integration.
  • Ensures data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through quality assurance and validation processes.
  • Creates forecasts, models, and recommendations based on statistical analysis and business context.
  • Organizes, documents, and maintains datasets and reporting workflows across multiple business areas.
  • Consolidates research and analysis into clear summaries and recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Supports regulatory, contractual, and enterprise reporting requirements, including state mandated submissions.
  • Identifies and implements enhancements or fixes to existing reports and reporting processes.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define reporting requirements and maintain project/report timelines.
  • Documents methodologies, reporting processes, and business requirements.
  • Identifies and drives process improvements, standardization, and automation opportunities.
  • Leads or supports projects, including timeline management, requirements gathering, and deliverable execution.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Supports regulatory, audit, and ad hoc data requests as needed.
  • Provides training and support to new and existing data analysis team members.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare analytics, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to interpret complex datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Technical proficiency with SQL, Excel, and reporting/analytics tools, and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Experience with healthcare analytics (e.g., claims, utilization, cost containment, medical economics).
  • Experience working with complex datasets/provision of data analysis and insights.
  • Experience with healthcare utilization metrics, medical cost analysis, and performance indicators.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy in data validation, report development, and documentation.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and present data-related findings and solutions.
  • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Crystal Reports, MedInsight, Power BI, relational databases or similar tools.
  • Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) systems (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tools such as SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure data lakes) and business intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting and healthcare payer systems (e.g., QNXT or similar platforms).
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling concepts and trend forecasting.
  • Project management experience.
  • Microsoft certification or similar technical credentials.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

CompHealth is the nation’s largest locum tenens staffing agency, offering more than 100 physician specialties, as well as permanent physician placement and both temporary and permanent allied healthcare staffing. At CompHealth, we are known for our employee-centric culture, strong core values and providing outstanding customer service. With CompHealth you can love what you do and impact the lives of millions of patients ever year.

Responsibilities

As an Inside Sales Representative at CompHealth Medical Staffing, you will reach out to healthcare providers, learn their career goals, then match them with a healthcare facility that needs their services.


It’s challenging work, especially in the first year or two. But as you build a network of interested providers, the job becomes easier and more rewarding. And you can leave each day feeling proud that you’ve helped make a difference in healthcare.


Qualifications

  • Have worked at least one year in sales by selling products or services
  • Intrinsically motivated and able to persevere through tough markets
  • Passion for sales and a "roll up your sleeves and get the job done" mentality
  • Demonstrated knack to persuade and influence clients through a consultative sales approach
  • Develop prospective business through numerous channels
  • Negotiate contracts that help the gross margin shine

We believe in fair compensation for all of our people, which is why our pay structure takes into account the cost of labor across U.S. geographic markets. For this position, we offer a pay range of $60,000 -- $250,000 annually, with pay varying depending on work location and job-related factors such as knowledge, position level and experience. During the hiring process, your recruiter can provide more information about the specific salary range for the job location.


CHG Healthcare offers starting salaries for sales positions in the form of total target compensation (TTC = base + commission + bonus), which includes base pay, commission, and bonuses. Sales positions receive short-term incentives through commission plans and bonuses. On the other hand, non-sales positions have starting salaries that consist of a base salary and short-term incentives through various bonus plans, which are paid out monthly, quarterly, or annually.


In return we offer:

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Traditional healthcare benefits such as medical and dental coverage, and some unique benefits like onsite health centers, corporate wellness programs, and free behavioral health appointments.
• Flexible work schedules - including work-from-home options available
• Recognition programs with rewards including trips, cash, and paid time off
• Family-friendly benefits including paid parental leave, fertility coverage, adoption assistance, and marriage counseling
• Tailored training resources including free LinkedIn learning courses

• Tuition reimbursement programs

We welcome applicants of any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status and individuals with disabilities as an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. We are an at-will employer.

LouwersHanique is a company of IDEX Corporation.

We are supplier of customer-specific solutions and precision components using technical glass, ceramics and special material combinations.

We Facilitate the Next Generation of Technologies

The world is moving towards the 4th industrial revolution at an unprecedented pace. This poses unprecedented technological challenges for the supply chains of the various high-tech markets. For LouwersHanique, this means adapting and continuously developing our manufacturing capacity and processes.

We are based in the Eindhoven region (Brainport) and help solve some of the most complicated, high-tech industrial issues. As a long-term partner of several leading high-tech companies around the world, we tackle the toughest challenges and strive for perfection.

Our Method

We achieve the best results through close cooperation with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of a product. From prototype to mass production of critical components. LouwersHanique can act as an extension of an R&D or engineering team and is happy to be involved in an NPI project from the start. This enables us to anticipate design considerations and select the right materials from the start.

We strongly believe in long-term partnerships with customers and suppliers. Long-term partnerships do not just happen and are based on mutual trust. Because we are often active in innovative markets, we often experience the growth of our customers. With its drive for innovation, LouwersHanique facilitates the growth and ambitions of our customers to the maximum.

PLEASE NOTE: THIS ROLE IS OPEN TO WORKERS FROM ANY EUROPEAN COUNTRY AND CAN BE REMOTE WORKING


The Sr. Director of European Sales owns regional commercial strategy and execution for the Global Semiconductors business across Europe.


This role leads customer engagement, revenue growth, opportunity prioritization, and forecast discipline while ensuring strong alignment between Sales, Product Management, Applications Engineering, Operations, and Business Line leadership.


This position serves as the senior commercial leader for the European region, driving disciplined funnel management, account planning, deal progression, and customer relationship management across strategic semiconductor equipment OEMs and key accounts. The role sets clear commercial priorities for EU and APAC sales reporting into the position and ensures customer engagement is disciplined, well-coordinated, and aligned with global semiconductor growth priorities.


Key Responsibilities:

Regional Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth:

  • Own the European sales strategy, revenue plan, account coverage model, and growth priorities for the assigned semiconductor market.
  • Lead regional funnel creation, qualification, prioritization, and progression to improve win rate, forecast accuracy, and deal velocity.
  • Develop and maintain executive-level customer relationships across strategic OEMs, regional accounts, and ecosystem partners.
  • Ensure regional commercial actions are aligned with global business objectives including those driven by Key Account Directors, market priorities, and operating cadence.

Commercial Governance & Cross-functional Alignment:

  • Drive disciplined use of CRM, funnel reviews, account plans, and commercial KPIs across the European sales organization.
  • Coordinate with Product Management and Applications Engineering to prioritize customer requests, technical engagement, and commercial resources.
  • Ensure customer commitments, RFQs, quotes, and major programs are clearly qualified, prioritized, and supported by the right cross-functional owners.
  • Serve as the regional escalation point for commercial priorities, customer issues, and cross-functional execution barriers.

Leadership & Team Development:

  • Lead and develop the European sales team, establishing clear goals, operating expectations, and accountability for performance.
  • Build a culture of disciplined commercial execution, customer focus, and transparent communication across regions and functions.
  • Partner with global leadership to support organizational change, talent development, and consistent commercial processes.

Preferred Knowledge Base: Semiconductor Industry Experience | Strategic Account Management | Regional Sales Leadership | MEDDIC / MEDDPICC Processes | Sales KPI and Funnel Analytics | Executive Customer Engagement | Cross-regional and cross-functional experience | CRM Systems |


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's required and advanced degree preferred
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in complex B2B sales, semiconductor equipment, industrial technology, or engineered products
  • Strong experience leading regional sales teams and managing strategic customer relationships in Europe
  • Demonstrated ability to own revenue plans, commercial KPIs, funnel discipline, and forecast accountability
  • Ability to lead through influence across Sales, Product Management, Applications Engineering, Operations, and Business Lines
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, organizational, and leadership skills

Compensation Information

The expected pay range for this position is 150,000 - 170,000 annually.Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other objective job-related factors. This position may be eligible for a bonus or other incentive plan, as well as other forms of compensation.

raw.title: Lead Employment Counsel
raw.excerpt: Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time.
raw.description:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Lead Employment Counsel to join our team!
Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you'll be Greenhouse's dedicated employment lawyer and the go-to legal partner for our People team and business leaders. You'll advise across the full employee lifecycle in the US and our international footprint, including employer of record and contractor arrangements, own our employment policies and agreements, and manage outside counsel on litigation and specialized matters.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. In a single day you might walk an HR business partner through an accommodation request, mark up a sales commission plan, and prepare for a mediation. You'll also build the training, templates, and self-service guidance that let a busy People team handle routine questions with confidence and escalate the right ones. And because Greenhouse builds hiring software, you'll have a real voice in how AI is reshaping employment law, both for us and for our customers.

Who will love this job

  • A trusted advisor - you build credibility quickly with HR partners, managers, and executives, and you turn legal risk into plain, practical guidance they can act on
  • A builder who scales - as the sole employment specialist, you prioritize well and multiply your impact through policies, playbooks, and training rather than answering every question one at a time
  • A detail-obsessed drafter - you sweat the language in agreements, policies, and compensation plans because you know that's where the risk lives
  • A pragmatic, curious lawyer - you track a fast-moving landscape (pay transparency, restrictive covenants, new leave mandates, AI in employment decisions) and make sound calls grounded in ethics, integrity, and the human impact of every decision

What you’ll do

  • Serve as the primary legal advisor to the People team (HR business partners, People Operations, Total Rewards, and Talent Acquisition) and business leaders on employee relations, performance management, terminations, reductions in force, leaves of absence, and accommodations
  • Lead wage and hour compliance, including FLSA and state exemption classification, timekeeping and overtime practices, payroll issues, and periodic classification audits in partnership with Total Rewards
  • Review and advise on compensation programs, including sales commission and bonus plans, overpayment recoupment, privileged pay equity analyses, and pay transparency requirements
  • Draft, negotiate, and maintain employment documents and policies, including offer letters, confidentiality and invention assignment agreements, restrictive covenants, separation and contractor agreements, and handbook content with state and country supplements
  • Conduct or oversee workplace investigations, and manage employment litigation matters with outside counsel, from demand letters and EEOC through class and representative actions, mediation, and settlement
  • Advise on employment law outside the US, supporting employer of record and contractor arrangements, entity launches, temporary work-from-abroad requests, and relocations alongside local and immigration counsel
  • Build and deliver training for managers, HR, and recruiters, create self-serve resources, and share clear, actionable updates on legal developments with Legal and People leadership
  • Partner with Product, Privacy, and HR technology stakeholders on the use of AI in hiring and employment decisions, vendor assessments, employee and candidate data retention, and the employment law implications of product launches
  • Support M&A diligence and integration, benefits and EEO/affirmative action compliance, manage outside counsel relationships and budgets, and represent Greenhouse externally as an employment law subject matter expert
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one US state bar
  • 7+ years of labor and employment law experience at a law firm and/or in-house
  • Deep knowledge of US federal and multi-state employment law, especially wage and hour
  • Experience advising on employment matters outside the US and working with employer of record providers and local counsel
  • A track record of managing employment litigation with outside counsel, including settlement strategy
  • Experience with workforce planning and management
  • Experience owning employment policies, agreements, and compensation plan terms, and conducting or overseeing workplace investigations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including giving practical advice to non-lawyers and executives and designing engaging training, plus the judgment and organization to work independently as the subject matter expert
  • Experience using AI tools effectively while verifying output, protecting privileged and employee data, and keeping final legal judgment human
  • In-house experience, strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with the HR tech industry, a plus
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linkedhere.

The national pay range for this role is $163,800 - $230,680. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role.

Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO).

The anticipated closing date for this role is December 18th, 2026.

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a US remote-based Cytogenetics Technologist to join our team in Research Triangle Park, NC!


Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm (candidate's local time zone and the option to work Sunday - Thursday or Tuesday - Saturday)


Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform analysis of chromosomes, which includes imaging and karyotyping of cytogenetic specimens. Focus is primarily on constitutional blood cases, with a possibility of prenatal cases
  • Analyze chromosomes for count, structural abnormality, and morphology from computer acquired image of a metaphase according to appropriate SOP
  • Prepare preliminary report for interpretation by arranging (karyotyping) the different pairs of chromosomes identifying their proper numerical sequence
  • Enter analysis information into appropriate computer systems for director interpretation
  • Check karyotypes according to departmental and group procedures and protocols prior to director review
    • Ensure chromosomes are placed and oriented properly
    • Verify patient demographic information.
    • Verify that karyotype matches written diagnosis.
    • Ensure karyotypes are appropriate for director review based on test ordered and result
  • Remote transfer of electronic images to and from satellite reading labs for analysis.
  • Perform routine maintenance on laboratory and computer equipment in designated area
  • Participate in proficiency testing as required, maintains records that demonstrate that proficiency samples are tested in the same manner as patient samples
  • Attend all required meetings and represents laboratory in a professional manner
  • Participate in required continuing education activities.
  • Comply with company policies and procedures
  • Perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the department and company

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a Chemical or Biological science, Clinical Laboratory Science, or Medical Technology
  • 2 years or more of experience working in a Cytogenetics clinical laboratory
  • 1 or more years experience performing karyotyping
  • 1 or more years experience performing constitutional cytogenetics analysis

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1 or more years experience with prenatal analysis
  • 1 or more years experience with Applied Spectral Imaging (ASI) software
  • ASCP certification in Cytogenetics (ASCP CG)

Additional Job Standards:

  • Previous experience with cytogenetic analysis of metaphase spreads via computerized images
  • Computer skills; able to effectively use the Internet, email, text messaging, chat applications, and familiarity with Microsoft Office
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation), is an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback
  • Strong patient focus
  • Effectively manages own time, conflicting priorities, self, stress, and professional development
  • Self-motivated and self-starter with ability to work independently with limited supervision
  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

Work From Home Requirements:

  • A dedicated home office space that isn’t shared and meets HIPAA compliance
  • Agree to have your home address added to reports of cases you analyze or report. This is a CMS requirement
  • Provide wired or wireless internet at a minimum speed of 100 mb/sec
  • Ability to work remotely effectively in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities and demands

Application Window Closes: 11/11/26


**Pay Range: $25.00 - $40.00 per hour


All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Community Programs team creates the spaces, programs, and opportunities that help our community thrive. We're looking for a Community Engagement and Advocacy Manager to help us strengthen relationships with the people who use, build with, and advocate for Tailscale.

In this role, you'll own and grow three important areas of our community: the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program, our digital communities, specifically Discord and Reddit, and our Community Projects program.

You'll focus on creating meaningful opportunities for community members to connect, contribute, share their expertise, and be recognized for the work they do. raw.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a US remote-based Cytogenetics Technologist to join our team in Research Triangle Park, NC!


Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm (candidate's local time zone and the option to work Sunday - Thursday or Tuesday - Saturday)


Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform analysis of chromosomes, which includes imaging and karyotyping of cytogenetic specimens. Focus is primarily on constitutional blood cases, with a possibility of prenatal cases
  • Analyze chromosomes for count, structural abnormality, and morphology from computer acquired image of a metaphase according to appropriate SOP
  • Prepare preliminary report for interpretation by arranging (karyotyping) the different pairs of chromosomes identifying their proper numerical sequence
  • Enter analysis information into appropriate computer systems for director interpretation
  • Check karyotypes according to departmental and group procedures and protocols prior to director review
    • Ensure chromosomes are placed and oriented properly
    • Verify patient demographic information.
    • Verify that karyotype matches written diagnosis.
    • Ensure karyotypes are appropriate for director review based on test ordered and result
  • Remote transfer of electronic images to and from satellite reading labs for analysis.
  • Perform routine maintenance on laboratory and computer equipment in designated area
  • Participate in proficiency testing as required, maintains records that demonstrate that proficiency samples are tested in the same manner as patient samples
  • Attend all required meetings and represents laboratory in a professional manner
  • Participate in required continuing education activities.
  • Comply with company policies and procedures
  • Perform other duties as required to meet the needs of the department and company

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a Chemical or Biological science, Clinical Laboratory Science, or Medical Technology
  • 2 years or more of experience working in a Cytogenetics clinical laboratory
  • 1 or more years experience performing karyotyping
  • 1 or more years experience performing constitutional cytogenetics analysis

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1 or more years experience with prenatal analysis
  • 1 or more years experience with Applied Spectral Imaging (ASI) software
  • ASCP certification in Cytogenetics (ASCP CG)

Additional Job Standards:

  • Previous experience with cytogenetic analysis of metaphase spreads via computerized images
  • Computer skills; able to effectively use the Internet, email, text messaging, chat applications, and familiarity with Microsoft Office
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation), is an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback
  • Strong patient focus
  • Effectively manages own time, conflicting priorities, self, stress, and professional development
  • Self-motivated and self-starter with ability to work independently with limited supervision
  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

Work From Home Requirements:

  • A dedicated home office space that isn’t shared and meets HIPAA compliance
  • Agree to have your home address added to reports of cases you analyze or report. This is a CMS requirement
  • Provide wired or wireless internet at a minimum speed of 100 mb/sec
  • Ability to work remotely effectively in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities and demands

Application Window Closes: 11/11/26


**Pay Range: $25.00 - $40.00 per hour


All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.


Work Location: Remote based in US

Help train and evaluate AI agents that work inside a real CAD environment on long engineering tasks, work that would take an expert 10–15 hours.   • A degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. A Master's or PhD is a plus.
  • 5+ years of professional, hands-on CAD modelling (CATIA, SolidWorks, Siemens NX, Creo or similar). Experience preparing geometry for simulation (ANSYS or similar) is a strong plus.
  • An active professional CAD licence of your own (required).
  • Comfortable with Python and GitHub.
  • English at B2 level or above.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

raw.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Priority given to those located remotely in North Carolina, Arizona and Texas.

As a Senior Incident Response Analyst, you'll be a member of the bank's Cyber Incident Response team. We are looking for an experienced senior level analyst with proven skillsets to detect and respond to threats in the environment, interact with business stakeholders and work to restore operations. This is a technical role and will support the Threat Hunting, Intelligence, and Monitoring functions with content creation, threat analysis, detection recommendations, and colleague mentoring. Seeking a candidate with strong communication skills to complement their technical skillset providing the ability to distill down complex issues for broader understanding expedited incident management.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Incident Analyst/handler –investigate SIEM/SOAR events as necessary; bring experience in malware analysis, network/endpoint security to respond to and contain incidents.
  • Incident Responder/Incident Lead – Lead Incidents, coordinating the investigation, mitigation, and remediation from a technical perspective. Liaise with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Incident Management – Ensures Information Security incidents are properly detected, documented, investigated, and resolved.
  • Content Development - Support the creation of countermeasures and mitigations in response to an incident.
  • Threat Hunting - Support the operational driven inputs (eg. on the heels of an incident or event) into threat hunting and help build countermeasures/mitigations to address commodity and targeted threats. Also build a capability to track evolving threat actor techniques.
  • Post Incident Review – Provide recommendations to improve communication, processes, procedures, and mitigation options based on high severity incidents.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's Degree and 8 years' experience.

OR

High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 12 years' experience in Information Security.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with all aspects of Incident response including stakeholder management.
  • 2+ years of Threat Hunting experience.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and its application to countermeasure creation is a plus.
  • Experience analyzing/dispositioning and escalating security events (systems, application, network, authentication email events)
  • Experience translating threat actor techniques to building mitigations across a variety of security technologies. This could take the form of Yara, Sigma or Regular Expressions.
  • Ability to define security requirements and drive project deliverables.
  • Ability to keep track of multiple incidents and ensure responses are provided in a timely fashion.
  • Experience responding to cloud-related incidents in Azure, AWS and Google cloud.
  • Cloud administrative experience preferred.
  • Cyber Incident Response experience – 3+ years required in which your primary job was an Incident Response role.
  • This role requires participation in the afterhours on call rotation.  Rotations will cycle on a weekly basis.

Additional Information

The base pay for this position is generally between $140,000 and $188,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

This job posting is expected to remain active for 45 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants

raw.excerpt: About SimpliGovSimpliGov is the government operations platform where state and local agencies design, run, and improve how their programs operate.
raw.description:
About SimpliGov

SimpliGov is the government operations platform where state and local agencies design, run, and improve how their programs operate. We help agency teams move applications, approvals, signatures, and payments across systems and departments, without waiting on IT backlogs, long transformation projects, or outside consultants.

Our work puts the people who know the programs best in control of how the work gets done. We value simplicity, ownership, and results, and we're committed to helping government teams deliver reliable, better-run programs for the constituents who depend on them.

Position Overview

The Customer Operations & Automation Manager builds the AI-first operating system behind SimpliGov's customer team, redesigning how Customer Success works internally so government customers get faster, more consistent, and more proactive service. This role is Customer Success's owner of customer data and process, the primary liaison to Revenue Operations for Salesforce, and the owner of Professional Services capacity planning, forecasting, and reporting. It reports to the Director of Professional Services, has no direct reports initially, and partners closely with Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Finance, Support, Product, and Security and Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Find, prioritize, and ship AI and automation use cases across the customer lifecycle, such as renewal and QBR prep, account health summaries, call and meeting notes, ticket triage, and risk alerts
  • Build and maintain automated workflows in Salesforce Flows, CS tools, and approved AI platforms, and measure each one's impact (hours saved, response time, adoption), retiring what does not deliver
  • Set standards for responsible AI use with customer data, partnering with Security and Compliance so workflows meet public-sector data requirements
  • Train and enable CSMs on new tools and prompts, and maintain a shared library of approved AI workflows
  • Map and improve the customer journey end to end, from sales-to-onboarding handoff through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and own the account health score model, including inputs, weighting, thresholds, and the actions each score triggers
  • Design and document CS playbooks, SLAs, and escalation paths, drive adoption across the team, and plan capacity and book-of-business coverage models as the customer base grows
  • Run the voice-of-customer loop (surveys, NPS/CSAT, feedback themes) and route insights to Product and leadership
  • Serve as Customer Success's primary partner to Revenue Operations: own CS data quality in Salesforce, agree shared metric definitions with RevOps and Finance (GRR, NRR, churn, expansion), and keep integrations across shared tools working
  • Build and maintain CS dashboards and the renewal forecast view, and prepare CS data for leadership and board reporting

What We Offer

raw.description:
Column is the software platform for public information. We build automated tools and workflow solutions that help governments, law firms, and media organizations notify the public. Today, thousands of publishers and tens of thousands of agencies, firms, and individuals rely on Column to keep their communities informed every day. We’re reimagining how public information connects people, institutions, and media.

We're a remote-first team of engineers, designers, and builders who are committed to creating software that supports an informed public.

About the Role

Column | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time

The Content Marketing Manager will build Column’s content engine: turning our expertise, customer stories, frontline insight, and national public notice developments into consistent, high-quality content that establishes Column as the expert on, and advocate for, public information, access to it, and public notice.

You’ll own the marketing calendar and Column’s core publishing channels, including our blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, monthly Public Notice reports, educational resources, case studies, and sales collateral. You’ll stay closely connected to our Customer Success and Services teams so our content reflects what is actually happening in the field.

As Column invests in SEO, media, partnerships, and demand generation, this role will help establish us as the definitive resource on public notice. We’re looking for a strong writer and steady operator who values quality over quantity, publishes consistently, and writes in a voice that is strong, professional, mature, and trustworthy. Candidates should also be able to move fluidly between long-form thought leadership, visual and video content, CMS publishing, and email campaigns while maintaining a consistent, high-quality publishing cadence.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Column’s marketing calendar and publishing cadence across the blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, email, and internal enablement, managing projects from request through drafting, review, publication, and distribution.
  • Follow public notice and public information news nationally, turning legislation, court decisions, industry shifts, and market trends into timely, credible content, including news commentary for our media channels.
  • Build a content source of truth with CSMs and our Services team (affidavits, pagination, and placement), turning their frontline knowledge into educational resources, FAQs, and enablement materials.
  • Write and produce high-quality content across formats, including weekly SEO blog posts, newsletters, customer case studies, guides, press releases, and sales collateral.
  • Own customer storytelling and case studies, from interviews and data collection through written stories, pull quotes, graphics, and video testimonials, while also supporting partnership announcements and sponsored content opportunities.
  • Create compelling visual and video content for marketing campaigns, social media, YouTube, reports, presentations, one-pagers, conference collateral, and other channels, bringing strong graphic design and video production/editing skills to Column’s content.
  • Grow Column’s LinkedIn presence and repurpose content for distribution and conversion, turning reports, customer stories, webinars, product launches, and news commentary into posts, graphics, short video, and email while improving CTAs, lifecycle campaigns, and website performance through testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • Exceptional writer and editor who makes complex, legal, or regulatory subjects clear and credible, with a high bar for accuracy and a mature, trustworthy voice.
  • Consistent, organized operator who manages an editorial calendar, juggles multiple projects, and ships on schedule without sacrificing quality.
  • Genuinely news-engaged, with curiosity about government, law, local media, and access to information, and the judgment to know what is worth writing about and when.
  • Experienced B2B content marketer with a track record of blogs, newsletters, case studies, reports, and educational resources.
  • Strong visual judgment and an eye for design, with experience creating polished assets such as reports, PDFs, presentations, social creative, email graphics, and sales collateral.
  • Digitally fluent and performance-minded, with experience publishing in a CMS, understanding SEO fundamentals, and using data, testing, and conversion insights to improve content and campaigns.
  • Collaborative and comfortable becoming an expert, able to interview customers, CSMs, operators, and leadership and translate what they know into clear content.

What Success Looks Like

Key performance indicators will include:

  • Consistent publishing cadence: Approximately 1 blog post per week, 1 LinkedIn post per week, 1 newsletter per month, 1 Public Notice report per month, 1 case study per month.
  • Campaign and channel support: Timely press releases, webinar and lifecycle communications, conference collateral, sales enablement, and social distribution tied to major launches, partnerships, events, and customer stories.
  • Authority and education: Column’s blog, reports, and resources become a go-to reference on public notice and public information, and Sales, CSMs, and Services actively use them. You also establish a reliable monthly loop with internal teams to surface trends, customer questions, and field insights into published content.
  • Audience growth: Growth in organic traffic, newsletter engagement, LinkedIn followers and engagement, and gated resource downloads.
  • Business impact: Clear attribution between content and pipeline, showing which blogs, newsletters, reports, case studies, and posts generate and influence marketing leads.
  • Editorial execution: Maintain a clear content calendar, independently manage recurring workflows. Ensure content moves efficiently from idea through publication and distribution.
  • Content repurposing: Major webinars, research, case studies, product education, and customer conversations are consistently turned into multiple useful formats across web, email, LinkedIn, video, and sales enablement.

Your First 90 Days

First 60 Days: Learn Column and Build the Foundation

The first 60 days focus on learning Column’s products, customers, voice, and the public notice ecosystem, while quickly contributing to our content engine.

You will:

  • Learn Column’s products, customer segments, positioning, marketing priorities, and the public notice landscape
  • Review our existing blogs, newsletters, case studies, email programs, and sales enablement
  • Take over the Marketing Calendar, Marketing Requests, and recurring content workflows
  • Set up a regular check-in with CSMs and Services team to source insights and stories
  • Build a news-monitoring routine for public notice legislation and public information developments

By Day 60, you will have:

  • Published 2 blog posts
  • Published 2 newsletters
  • Published 1 customer case study
  • Published 2 LinkedIn posts
  • Published 1 Public Notice report
  • Responded to and managed incoming content and marketing requests
  • Actively maintained and managed the Marketing Calendar

By the end of your second month, you understand Column’s voice, audience, products, and priorities—and can independently own standard content projects from request through publication.

Days 61-90: Own and Build

By your third month, you are independently running Column’s content engine: a weekly blog, newsletters, the monthly Public Notice report, steady LinkedIn publishing, and timely news commentary for Glorion.

By Day 90, you have published a second monthly Public Notice report, built a repeatable process with CSMs and Services for sourcing content, and established a consistent, recognizable Column voice across every channel.

Must Haves

  • 2+ years of experience in content marketing, B2B marketing, editorial, journalism, communications, or a related field
  • Excellent writing, editing, research, and interviewing skills, with experience producing substantive long-form content
  • Strong visual judgment and experience creating polished marketing assets in Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
  • Strong project management skills, including managing editorial calendars, multiple stakeholders, and competing deadlines
  • A track record of publishing on a consistent cadence and owning projects from idea through distribution

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with lifecycle marketing platforms like and website tools like Framer
  • Deeper experience with B2B SEO, original research, and A/B-tested email campaigns
  • Experience covering legal, policy, or government news, or building a LinkedIn audience for a B2B brand
  • Experience supporting PR, sponsored content, media, or industry partnerships
  • Familiarity with government technology, legal technology, local media, public notice, or another regulated industry

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $80k-$100k based on experience
  • 401K with match
  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Flexible PTO and fully remote work environment (U.S.-based)
