Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments

The Device Engineer will work with Product Management and other Engineers to design, develop, and maintain network device integration software.

About the role

    • Develop support for emerging next-generation technologies in the networking security space
    • Develop device integration solutions for products from Palo Alto, Juniper, Checkpoint, and others
    • Gather technical requirements for integrating with the security devices through administrator guides, user guides, CLI guides, and other available resources
    • Learn the inner workings of the security device and convert that logic into a structure that the application can use
    • Work closely with the sales engineering team to prioritize device pack development based on the needs of prospects and customers
    • Occasionally participate in customer and support calls to understand and troubleshoot device-related issues

Required Skills and Experience

    • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or another related field
    • Proficient Java coding skills, including an understanding of optimization, performance ramifications of coding decisions, and object-oriented design
    • Scripting expertise in either BASH or Python programming languages
    • Linux and general command-line experience
    • Experience with and working knowledge of Maven, SQL, JUnit, XML/XSLT, RESTful web services, and logback/log4j
    • Regex experience
    • Outstanding problem-solving skills.
    • Able to pick apart software, analyze it and become a subject matter expert on it
    • Must be willing to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple roles and demonstrate high emotional intelligence
    • Flexible and able to handle and prioritize multiple tasks
    • Possess a positive attitude and work well with others

Preferred Skills and Experience

    • Experience in an Agile/Scrum software development lifecycle
    • XML / XSD Design experience
    • Expertise in networking (Cisco, Juniper, Check Point, Palo Alto, etc
    • Cisco network and security certification is a plus (CCIE / CCNA)

Practice/Department: Marketing Position Title: Marketing Manager Position Location: United States - Remote Reports to: Director

Job Summary:

The Marketing Manager is responsible for executing integrated marketing programs that drive awareness, demand generation, customer engagement, and sales growth across Pellera's solution areas. Working closely with Marketing leadership and sales teams, this role brings marketing strategies to life through campaigns, events, content, and sales enablement activities. This position is ideal for a marketer who enjoys both thinking and doing. The successful candidate can translate technology solutions into customer-focused messaging, understands how to align marketing efforts with business objectives, and thrives in a highly collaborative sales-driven environment. The Marketing Manager will contribute ideas and market insights that help shape strategy while primarily focusing on flawless execution and measurable business outcomes. FLSA Status: Exempt SOC Occupational Code: 13-1161 EEO-1 Job Category: 2

Essential Functions:

Execute marketing plans, campaigns, and programs aligned to company priorities, solution areas, and regional growth objectives. Collaborate with the Director of Marketing to support annual and quarterly marketing initiatives. Translate technical products, services, and solutions into compelling customer-centric messaging that addresses business challenges and outcomes. Develop campaign assets, content, communications, and event execution plans that support demand generation and customer engagement goals. Partner closely with sales leaders and practice teams to ensure alignment between marketing activities and revenue objectives. Create and deliver marketing resources, messaging, and enablement materials that help sellers engage prospects and advance opportunities. Develop a strong understanding of target customers, key accounts, industries, and market trends to improve campaign effectiveness. Coordinate and execute marketing activities, including webinars, digital campaigns, and customer engagement programs. Manage program logistics, timelines, approvals, budgets, and performance tracking. Analyze campaign results and provide recommendations to optimize future marketing efforts. Collaborate across marketing, sales and practice areas to ensure a consistent and effective customer experience.

Required Skills, Abilities, and Competencies What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate is:

A strong executor who can manage multiple projects simultaneously and consistently deliver high-quality work. Naturally curious and eager to understand customer challenges and business drivers. Comfortable collaborating with sales teams and building trusted relationships across the organization. Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take ownership without requiring detailed direction at every step. Adaptable and positive in a fast-paced, growing environment. Focused on business outcomes rather than simply completing marketing activities.

Skills & Experience

Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into customer-focused business value. Experience supporting B2B marketing campaigns, programs, and events. Strong project management and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Analytical mindset with experience measuring and reporting campaign performance. Working knowledge of demand generation, lead nurturing, sales enablement, and customer marketing principles. Experience using marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across sales, marketing, and technical teams. High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing field preferred. 3-5 years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably within the technology industry. Experience executing integrated marketing campaigns that support pipeline growth. Experience working closely with sales organizations and supporting seller engagement activities. Experience developing customer-focused messaging, content, and campaign assets is strongly preferred. Familiarity with managed services, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data, AI, or other technology solutions is a plus.

Physical Requirements:

Travel to marketing events as requested/required. Less than 10%. Must be capable of lifting 40 pounds. Event set-up/booth set-up, etc.

At Amsive, we're more than just a performance marketing agency; we're a team that thrives on collaboration and innovation. We're a team of passionate individuals ready to tackle challenges, learn from one another, and drive results. We believe in empowering our team members, providing them with the tools they need to succeed, and trusting them to lead the way. 

If you're looking for a place where your work matters, a career path you can grow on your terms, and a team that's as invested in your success as you are, Amsive is for you. We offer a unique blend of flexibility, growth opportunities, and a culture that values each individual. 

We regret to inform you that currently, Amsive DOES NOT provide sponsorship opportunities.
This is a REMOTE position, candidates will be required to live in the United States and work EST or CST time zones.

What we are looking for:

Amsive is looking for a Director, Digital Media. This role provides direct leadership and support to Amsive’s digital media teams, assisting with a portfolio of key agency clients. The role requires an experienced innovator and thought leader with the technical, communication, and strategic marketing skills necessary to continuously improve client performance, develop internal teams' knowledge and skillset and help grow Amsive’s business.

What you will be doing:

  • Strategic leadership of digital advertising for high compliance clients. 
  • Developing channel resources and training media staff to find opportunities to increase campaign performance and strengthen skills that help advance their careers 
  • Partnering with clients and Amsive’s Planning team on client marketing plans and on-site experience to improve their digital performance and profitability.  
  • Hands-on management and optimization of ads in programmatic DSPs, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, YouTube, Amazon, Pinterest, TikTok, and any other platform that fits our clients’ needs, as needed. 
  • Ensuring testing schedules are up to date on all accounts, learnings are being applied throughout each account, and that tests focus on the areas with the highest potential returns. 
  • Collaborating with our Client Experience team to ensure client strategy and performance are being met. Ensure that all reporting explains why things are happening and what Amsive plans to do about it.
  • Working with Analytics team on any tracking and reporting requirements. 

Who you are:

  • A minimum of 7 years of hands-on digital advertising experience is required.  
  • Experience managing sophisticated, demanding clients and client accounts, with a proven ability to increase client revenue and profitability. 
  • Experience managing and training staff, specifically a matrixed team of managers and specialists.
  • Proven ability to find the story within the data. Not just the “what,” but the “why.” 
  • Proven ability to create strategies that meet client goals and translate those strategies into tactics. Also, a track record of working with clients to make sure their requests and budget plans align with the client’s corporate goals.
  • Excellent written communication and interpersonal skills.

Additional Information:

  • Salary starting at $130,000/yr, based on skills and experience
  • Paid time off that includes Unlimited Vacation Time, Annual Sick Days, Mental Health Days, and Holidays

raw.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
raw.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

This is an opportunity for you to make a significant difference on a massive scale as you work alongside 900+ (and growing!) talented colleagues, spanning three continents. Your charge? To help us build a pain-free world, powered by AI, enhanced by people — accessible to all.

All of our PTs work 100% from home. This is a variable hour position with hours assigned weekly based on business needs. While hours will vary between 25-40 per week, the exact number of hours is determined by the company and may change week to week. Seasonal Treatment Physical Therapists must be available to work the assigned number of hours and cannot choose a specific number within that range.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reinforce our physical therapy team with knowledge and solid clinical experience
  • Drive clinical outcomes for our patients through exceptional patient engagement
  • Apply our digital approach in the treatment of patients with musculoskeletal disorders

What you need to have

    • You need to have DPT (Doctor of Physical Therapy)
    • At least 3 years of clinical experience
    • Must be a licensed physical therapist
    • Experience in the treatment of musculoskeletal disorders
    • Digital health experience strongly preferred
    • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to engage members
    • Extremely comfortable with technology and navigating multiple platforms at once
    • Ability to think outside the box and adapt to a hands-off approach
    • Adaptability to rapidly evolving processes without intimidation
    • Hard-working and able to handle the pressure of a fast-paced, remote environment
    • Comfortable working a flexible schedule, between 25 and 40 hours/week

Licensing Requirements

This role requires eligibility under the PT Compact. To qualify, you must:

  • Reside in a PT Compact member state (see the current map:). Non-participating states currently include CA, ID, WY, NM, MN, IL, MI, RI, NY, FL, ME, and MA.
  • Hold an active PT license and a valid driver’s license, both issued by that same home state.

Role Commitment & Schedule

This role guarantees a minimum of 25 hours per week, with opportunities to increase up to 40 hours as you build your caseload and grow with the team.

This is a seasonal position guaranteed for at least 3 months, with the potential for extension of another 3 months and conversion to a permanent role based on individual performance and business needs.

This job description is not all-encompassing, and Sword Health reserves the right to modify it at any time. There may also be opportunities to contribute to other operational requirements as they arise.

Work Hours

This is a variable-time position with hours fluctuating between 25 hours/week and 40 hours/week and is fully remote.

Compensation Range

Base Compensation:

    • Regular: $44/hour, with 25 hours/week guaranteed. The $44/hour rate applies equally to all hours worked, whether within the guaranteed 25 or beyond it.
    • Bilingual: $46/hour, with 25 hours/week guaranteed. The $46/hour rate applies equally to all hours worked, whether within the guaranteed 25 or beyond it.

Variable Compensation:

    • In addition to base pay, this role is eligible to participate in a monthly incentive program based on the achievement of established company metrics. Payouts are subject to the terms and eligibility requirements of the applicable incentive plan.

*Compensation plans may be modified from time to time at the Company’s discretion, consistent with business needs and applicable law

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
$44—$46 USD
Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.
Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender, Gender expression, Gender identity, Gender information, Marital status, Medical condition, National origin, Physical or mental disability, Pregnancy, Race, Religion, Caste, Sexual orientation, and Veteran status.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, or equivalent), with proven experience designing, building, and supporting scalable applications. The role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders and technology teams to develop solutions across investment management, portfolio analytics, compliance, data platforms, and enterprise workflows.

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.

• Strong proficiency in Python and Java.

  • Full-stack development experience with React, Angular, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building APIs, integrations, and data-driven applications.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage projects from design through deployment and production support.

A proactive and accountable engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments, takes ownership of outcomes, and enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges. Experience: 8-15 Years

Primary Skills: Python, Java, React/Angular, APIs, Enterprise Application Development

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Enterprise Services team uses a high touch engagement methodology to guide our largest customer segment, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We use data and automation to ensure all customers receive a high level of service and onboard to our platform successfully.

As the Manager of the Enterprise Implementation Consultants team, you will lead a team of Implementation Consultants who deploy Samsara’s connected operations platform — spanning hardware installation, software configuration, and system integrations — for our largest enterprise accounts. You will improve our high touch implementation motions, provide focused coaching for each team member, and be an inspiring leader who establishes an energizing team culture.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage team performance
  • Deliver results across team KPIs and org level OKRs
  • Own executive-level stakeholder relationships and lead escalation resolution for at-risk, high-ACV accounts
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Customer Success to ensure seamless handoffs, and protect renewal and expansion opportunities on these accounts
  • Coach consultants through complex, multi-site technical implementations, including hardware deployment logistics and system/API integrations
  • Identify and implement process-improvement opportunities; such as systems efficiency gains and leaning into data resulting in increased automation
  • Lead from the front with a willingness to get hands dirty
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience managing as services team, including experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments
  • Experience implementing Enterprise (medium/high touch) accounts or account management programs. SaaS and/or IoT/hardware implementation experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong work ethic, prioritization, and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience managing escalations and executive stakeholder relationships on complex, high-value accounts
  • Experience with a customer success CRM such as Gainsight and/or PSA tool
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Project/program management experience (PMP or similar) a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$109,480—$165,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

The problem we collectively solve for customers


Organisations invest in Workday to transform how they run their People, Finance and Planning services – yet most fail to realise the value they set out to achieve. Programmes drift from the business case, legacy operating models and fragmented processes are simply re-platformed, and people are not ready, willing or able to work differently at go-live. The result is a modern platform sitting on top of yesterday’s organisation, with value eroding in the months after deployment.

Kainos Transformation & Advisory exists to close that gap. Working alongside C-suite sponsors from vision and business case through to measured outcomes, our three specialisms act as one team: we define and protect the value case and programme governance, design the target operating model and harmonised processes Workday will enable, and ensure the organisation’s leaders and people are ready to adopt and sustain the change. Together we help customers deliver the transformation they intended – easier, smarter and faster – and have the evidence to prove it.


Main purpose of the role


Lead Kainos’ value and programme advisory, ensuring Workday transformations are anchored to a clear business case and governed to deliver measurable outcomes. Act as trusted adviser to CFOs, CHROs and transformation sponsors from Phase 0 through to benefits realisation.


Core responsibilities

  • Act as trusted adviser to C-suite and executive sponsors (CFO, CHRO, CIO, COO), shaping transformation vision, ambition and investment cases and holding the room at board and steering committee level.
  • Lead customer value definition and realisation on transformation projects in a billable capacity – road-mapping, business cases, benefits frameworks, KPIs and value tracking – proving delivery against Kainos’ Workday value benchmarks across a multi-year horizon.
  • Provide senior programme assurance and design governance, mobilisation and delivery approaches for complex, multi-country Workday programmes, intervening decisively when value or delivery is at risk.
  • Originate, shape and win advisory work: lead Phase 0 / Pathfinder engagements, proposals, RFP responses and commercial propositions, growing the T&A pipeline and account footprint.
  • Actively support sales activity across EMEA and achieve agreed sales targets that drive value across net new and customer base.
  • Build and lead the specialism – developing methods, IP, thought leadership and a high-performing team of consultants, and partnering with Workday and delivery leadership.

Essential criteria


  • 15+ years in management consultancy or transformation, with significant time at Director or Partner level.
  • Proven track record advising C-suite stakeholders on large-scale ERP Cloud enabled transformation.
  • Proven track record in winning large global transformation consulting assignments
  • Demonstrable expertise in business case development, benefits management and value realisation.
  • Experience leading or assuring complex, multi-workstream programmes, including budget, risk and governance.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with evidence of selling and shaping advisory work.
  • Outstanding executive communication, facilitation and influencing skills.

Desirable criteria


  • Workday (or SAP / Oracle cloud ERP) programme experience across HCM, Financials or Planning.
  • Recognised programme or portfolio certification (MSP, PRINCE2, PMP) or a value management qualification.
  • Big 4 / tier-1 consultancy background.
  • Published thought leadership or public speaking experience.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

About Grafana Cloud Observability

Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.

The squad: Database Observability

We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

The opportunity:

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
  • Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
  • Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
  • Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
  • Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
  • User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.
  • You care about our community of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.

Bonus Points for

  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.
  • Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.
  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 107,000 - EUR 134,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Role overview

The Solution Sales Executive (SSE) - Data & Analytics is a sales role built for experienced data and analytics sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s business through AI, Data and Analytics. You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow’s D&A business and work on exciting and transformational use cases with Data & Analytics to deliver Insight to Action on the ServiceNow AI Platform. People who excel at this job can lead discovery sessions, leverage value-based selling, and deliver measurable business outcomes through customer specific priorities and use cases. The SSE has the technical fluency to present, demo, and provide customers with the confidence to invest in ServiceNow D&A solutions.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Lead end-to-end D&A sales cycles as a co-prime with the core account executive, from opportunity creation through close and ongoing adoption.

  • Own and sell the full D&A portfolio (Workflow Data Fabric, RaptorDB Pro, Data Apps, and Autonomous Data Analytics) across your assigned accounts.

  • Develop strategic D&A account plans to position ServiceNow D&A solutions as foundational to a customer’s AI, real-time analytics, and data strategy with a focus on new business with existing ServiceNow customers.

  • Lead discovery, value-based conversations, technical presentations, and demos with data, analytics, and AI leaders to uncover priorities, pain points, and accelerate AI ready data modernization initiatives.

  • Develop relationships with customer technology and data executives, including those at the Chief Data and Analytics Officer (CDAO) level, as well as leaders in data engineering, data governance, and analytics, in addition to the ServiceNow platform owner and CIO, to increase awareness and influence.

  • 5+ years of field sales experience with an emphasis on D&A sales, or AI-adjacent solutions preferred.

  • Technical fluency in AI, Data and Analytics, to be able to present, demo and lead credible discovery, value positioning, and use case identification with executives, ServiceNow platform owners, and Data and Analytics leaders.

  • Experience selling analytics or BI (such as Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Power BI, Qlik, or Oracle Analytics) or credible depth in modern data platforms, cloud data warehousing, data integration, data management and governance.

  • Experience selling Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Palantir, Salesforce Data 360, Informatica, or Boomi, as well as a strong understanding of the broader data market, is an advantage

  • Experience with consumption-based models and driving growth after the first sale.

  • Experience with the ServiceNow ecosystem, platform, use cases and target buyers is a huge plus

  • A self-starter mindset, hands-on, thought leader that is comfortable operating in a fast paced matrixed, product, sales, and GTM environment.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Track record of multi-threading accounts, including developing a second buyer or influencer alongside the primary one.

  • Experience selling the value of packaged pre-built line of business specific analytics products such as sales analytics, customer service analytics, HR analytics etc. is a plus.

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

raw.description:
At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters.

As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us. Here, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, tackle meaningful projects, and build a career defined by growth, opportunity, and impact.

Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring a Digital Asset Manager to join our dynamic Proposals Team. This position reports to the Director of Proposals. The Digital Asset Manager serves as the primary administrator and day-to-day owner of Woolpert's digital asset management (DAM) platform, including asset intake, metadata and taxonomy standards, permissions, digital rights documentation, integrations, reporting, and user enablement. This position develops, applies, and improves governance standards, taxonomies, and workflows that keep project imagery, graphics, video, presentations, resumes, and marketing content accurate, well organized, and easy to find and reuse across the firm. Work is complex and important to the organization and is performed with minimal supervision and wide latitude for independent judgment, including resolving cross-system issues, partnering directly with vendors and system owners, and assisting less-experienced team members.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

  • Administers and maintains the DAM platform end to end, including configuration, asset intake, cataloging, permissions, distribution, retention, and archival, and resolves issues with limited oversight.
  • Develops, documents, and maintains project-level and asset-level metadata standards, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, and naming conventions, and leads periodic reviews to keep them current.
  • Establishes and applies quality-review criteria for incoming assets, evaluating completeness, duplication, and compliance, and confirms required metadata and usage information are captured before publication.
  • Plans and conducts audits of asset collections to identify, correct, retire, or archive inaccurate, duplicate, or obsolete assets, and recommends corrective actions to content owners.
  • Leads the ingestion, normalization, and rationalization of legacy or acquired asset collections, coordinating timelines and requirements with contributing teams.
  • Defines and enforces clear distinctions among working files, final approved assets, restricted materials, and archival records.
  • Maintains rights-related metadata and supporting documentation, including copyright, licensing, permissions, usage restrictions, and image credits, and partners with Legal and Communications to resolve higher-risk usage questions.
  • Oversees the accuracy of employee profiles, headshots, project experience, and resume-related content maintained in or supplied to the DAM, and works with data owners to resolve gaps.
  • Monitors and troubleshoots data flows between the DAM and connected enterprise, proposal, and content-management systems, and serves as a day-to-day point of contact with system owners and vendors on configuration, defects, and enhancements.
  • Diagnoses and resolves complex user, system, and workflow issues, escalating only those requiring enterprise-level decisions or contractual action.
  • Designs and delivers user training, and creates and maintains user guides, workflow documentation, and quick-reference materials.
  • Provides expert user support and guidance on search, metadata, permissions, rights, and asset-distribution practices.
  • Analyzes and reports on DAM adoption, asset usage, data completeness, and search activity, and translates findings into recommendations that improve reuse and content quality.
  • Recommends and implements approved improvements to taxonomy, configuration, documentation, training, and workflows, and evaluates new capabilities for fit.
  • Assists and provides work direction to less-experienced team members, contractors, or contributors supporting the DAM.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

  • 5 years of experience in digital asset management, content or knowledge management, records/library services, or a comparable enterprise information system.
  • Experience developing and applying metadata, taxonomy, or cataloging standards to digital content.
  • Experience administering or serving as a primary user of an enterprise DAM, content management, or knowledge management platform.
  • Advanced knowledge of digital asset management concepts, including metadata, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, file formats, and asset lifecycle practices.
  • Ability to develop, document, and enforce governance standards, procedures, and workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills when handling high volumes of content.
  • Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex system, workflow, and user issues, including cross-system problems.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to train, advise, and influence nontechnical users and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to analyze usage and adoption data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate's degree or higher in library science, information science, information management, digital media, archives, communications, marketing technology, or a related field preferred.
  • 7 or more years of experience administering a digital asset management, content management, or knowledge management platform.
  • Experience leading system integrations, APIs, marketing technology, proposal technology, or AI-enabled content workflows.
  • Experience in an architecture, engineering, geospatial, consulting, or other professional-services environment.
  • Experience developing training programs and supporting enterprise users at scale.
  • Experience supporting DAM migrations or post-acquisition content integrations

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, OR TRAINING:

  • DAM, taxonomy, metadata, or information governance training or certification preferred.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of copyright, licensing, permissions, and digital rights management practices.
  • Familiarity with information architecture and data-quality management concepts.
  • Familiarity with documentation and metadata requirements for AI-generated and AI-edited assets.

Travel Requirements:

  • Must be able to travel up to 5% of the time for business purposes.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

  • Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).
  • Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.
  • Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.
  • Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.
  • Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Pay Range
$75,400—$94,300 USD

Woolpert is an equal-opportunity employer. Woolpert is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. raw.title: Engagement Manager
raw.excerpt: We're looking for a senior, client-facing Engagement Manager who owns the client's success from the first scoping conversation through final acceptance.
raw.description:
We're looking for a senior, client-facing Engagement Manager who owns the client's success from the first scoping conversation through final acceptance.

This is a services-led role that starts before the contract is signed. Once the work is underway, you are the person the client holds accountable for the outcome, and the person Mirantis holds accountable for delivering it.

Our solutions are highly customized, and the engagements you run will span cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and AI workloads for both enterprise clients and cloud service providers. You may run multiple engagements at once, or a single large multi-workstream program where complexity warrants it, holding Mirantis, client, and third-party teams to a common schedule while keeping the critical path clear and the commercial health of the engagement intact.

The environment is fast-evolving and frequently ambiguous. Bringing order to it is the job. You'll be the calm center of the engagement — the person who holds client confidence when the schedule slips, who escalates early rather than absorbing problems quietly, and who can move from a working session with engineers to a C-level update without changing gears.

What You'll Do

  • Own the client's success end to end — from pre-sales scoping and solution design through contract, pilot, delivery, and acceptance — across both Enterprise and Cloud Service Provider (CSP) engagements.

  • Serve as the client's primary point of contact and the senior Mirantis voice on the engagement, building trust and sustaining client confidence under delivery pressure.

  • Partner with sales, solution architects, and engineering during pre-sales to scope and estimate custom work, author the delivery sections of the statement of work, and coordinate the internal teams needed to win the opportunity.

  • Run multiple concurrent client engagements, or a single large multi-workstream program where complexity and time commitment warrant it.

  • Translate client business objectives into executable plans, holding Mirantis, client, and third-party teams to a common schedule and a shared set of commitments.

  • Deliver in line with Mirantis delivery procedures — maintaining RAID logs, integrated plans and schedules, and providing clear, concise status reporting — applying the level of rigor the engagement warrants, whether the work is phased or iterative, and actively managing the critical path to remove blockers before they affect committed dates.

  • Manage technical delivery in coordination with Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to meet client objectives.

  • Ensure client readiness by coordinating the infrastructure, dependencies, and prerequisites the client owns, and hold third-party vendors and subcontractors to their timeline and quality commitments.

  • Own the commercial health of the engagement — scope, change, and the delivery inputs that drive its financial performance — identifying and documenting scope creep as it arises, driving the change order process, and partnering with Services Operations on measurement and reporting.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, ensuring all stakeholders have clear visibility, and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.

  • Report status across the full stakeholder spectrum, from project teams to Mirantis and client executive and C-level leadership.

  • Identify opportunities through ongoing delivery to expand Mirantis’ engagement with the client, and work with Sales to develop follow-on work based on client needs, emerging requirements, and evolving business priorities.

  • Improve delivery processes and collateral, and mentor the project managers on the team.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in project or program management leading complex, client-facing solution implementations in a professional services, consulting, or technology vendor environment.

  • Experience delivering enterprise infrastructure or cloud platform implementations — you understand what it takes to stand up, integrate, and get acceptance on infrastructure in a client environment.

  • Experience running multi-party delivery across client teams, third-party vendors and subcontractors, and internal product and engineering organizations distributed across time zones.

  • Pre-sales experience: scoping and estimating custom work, and authoring the delivery sections of statements of work.

  • Commercial ownership of engagements — scope control, change orders, and accountability for how an engagement performs financially.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to engage credibly with engineers and architects on tradeoffs, dependencies, and risk.

  • Demonstrated ownership of client outcomes. You have been accountable when a program succeeded or failed, not only the person tracking it.

  • A pragmatic, outcome-driven mindset - you focus on delivering value, not just managing tasks

  • Bachelor's degree in a business or technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or similar.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure solutions based on Kubernetes, OpenStack, and/or hybrid cloud concepts.

  • Familiarity with AI concepts — including data pipelines, LLMs, and model lifecycle — and experience delivering projects related to them.

  • Experience delivering projects for data center environments.

  • Experience managing vendor or subcontractor relationships as part of project delivery.

  • Familiarity with using AI tools and agents to streamline process execution and reporting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engagements deliver to scope, schedule, and quality — and where constraints emerge, expectations are managed early enough that client trust holds.

  • Engagements perform to their financial plan, with scope change identified, documented, and converted into change orders rather than absorbed.

  • Plans, RAID logs, and reporting are current and trusted, and risks reach leadership before they affect committed dates.

  • Delivered results generate follow-on work, and you help shape what comes next.

Location and Travel

This is a remote role with moderate travel, typically 10–25%, for client engagements, workshops, and internal team meetings. Travel may be international. Candidates must be willing and able to travel internationally, including to the United States, and to hold or obtain the documentation required to do so. You may support clients globally, with some flexibility in working hours to accommodate client and delivery team time zones.

Why Mirantis

  • Work with a global leader in hybrid cloud, open-source infrastructure, enterprise AI cloud, and neocloud.

  • Partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers on next-generation platform and AI initiatives.

  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous growth.

  • Competitive compensation, strong benefits, and stock options.

  • Work for an established leader in the Cloud Native industry with over 800 enterprise customers, HQ’d in Silicon Valley.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented, and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune and Global 2000 customers implement modern open-source cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Flexible working schedule and remote / or hybrid work environment.
  • Receive a competitive compensation package.

Mirantis ranked in the top 50 of G2's Best IT Cloud Products of 2021!

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis helps organizations ship code faster on public and private clouds. The company provides a public cloud experience on any infrastructure from the data center to the edge. With Lens and the Mirantis Cloud Native Platform, Mirantis empowers a new breed of Kubernetes developers by removing infrastructure and operations complexity and providing one cohesive cloud experience for complete app and devops portability, a single pane of glass, and automated full-stack lifecycle management with continuous updates.

Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at .

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership at HII – Mission Technologies
HII’s Leadership Capability Framework defines the standard of excellence expected of all leaders across Mission Technologies. Leaders are accountable for modeling these capabilities and building them within their teams:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Develop talent, empower teams, and build an inclusive environment.
  • Build Relationships – Strengthen trust, collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Take Ownership – Drive accountability, execution excellence, and results.
  • Customer First – Anticipate mission needs and deliver value to our partners.
  • Shape the Future – Inspire innovation and align work with strategic priorities.
  • Act with Urgency – Make informed decisions and move with purpose.

These capabilities define how leaders inspire teams, deliver results, and shape the future of Mission Technologies.

Summary

The Senior Program Manager, Vessel Acquisition & Modernization is responsible for leading the acquisition, new construction, conversion, modernization, and delivery of Military Sealift Command (MSC) and special mission vessels. This role provides program leadership across complex maritime projects, ensuring compliance with operational, technical, contractual, regulatory, cost, and schedule requirements. The position serves as the primary interface among government stakeholders, shipyards, contractors, and mission partners throughout the vessel lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • Lead vessel acquisition, shipbuilding, conversion, and modernization programs from planning through delivery and acceptance.
  • Manage program cost, schedule, technical performance, and risk across multiple stakeholders and contractors.
  • Oversee shipyard contracts and program execution in accordance with FAR and DFARS requirements.
  • Direct configuration management, Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE) integration, change management, and acceptance processes.
  • Coordinate vessel testing, sea trials, certifications, and delivery milestones.
  • Ensure compliance with ABS classification requirements, U.S. Coast Guard regulations, Navy standards, and MSC operational requirements.
  • Support integration of mission systems, including small boat operations, aviation support systems, dive and salvage equipment, sensors, and C4I capabilities.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration among MSC, NAVSEA, Fleet Commands, Combatant Commands, shipyards, prime contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Provide executive-level program reporting, status updates, and strategic recommendations.

What We Are Looking For

  • 6 years relevant progressive experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant progressive experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant progressive experience.
  • 8-15+ years of experience leading vessel acquisition, new construction, major conversion, ship modernization, or shipbuilding programs.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Military Sealift Command (MSC), Navy auxiliary vessels, Offshore Support Vessels (OSVs), special mission vessels, or comparable maritime platforms.
  • Experience managing complex programs involving multiple government, industry, and operational stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of MSC operations, Navy vessel acquisition processes, and maritime mission requirements.
  • Knowledge of ABS classification standards and U.S. Coast Guard regulations.
  • Experience with mission system integration, including small boat operations, aviation support, dive and salvage systems, sensors, and C4I systems.
  • Thorough understanding of FAR/DFARS regulations and government contracting processes.
  • Experience with shipyard operations, contract management, configuration control, GFE management, sea trials, acceptance testing, and risk management.
  • Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Clearance: Must possess and maintain an active Secret clearance.

Preferred: Bonus Points For...

  • DAWIA Level II or Level III Certification in Program Management (or equivalent).
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
  • Experience with Chouest-class or similar commercial vessel platforms.
  • Experience managing cost-reimbursement, fixed-price, and performance-based logistics contracts.
  • Prior experience supporting Military Sealift Command (MSC), NAVSEA, Fleet Commands, Combatant Commands, or other Department of Defense organizations.

Job Summary:

Scope of the Role

The Software Engineer II is a mid-level technical contributor in the organization who is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions. They are developing and building the applications and systems that run the company. This could be the backend systems, the frontend user experience, the products, or the tools to keep the business running. They may work independently or as part of a team and contribute to the technical direction of the software engineering department. The impact they should have on the company is to deliver high-quality software products that meet the needs of customers and stakeholders, while also continuing to develop their technical skills and knowledge. They should have a keen focus on learning and professional development, as well as a willingness to collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders. A Software Engineer II is also expected to demonstrate proficiency with agentic AI coding tools, using them to independently accelerate feature delivery while applying strong judgment to validate every line of AI-generated output.

Performance Outcome: Development of Products or Systems

A Software Engineer II will have a deeper understanding of the development processes and tools, including a stronger focus on quality, thanmore juniorengineers.Initiallythe SoftwareEngineer II might write code according to a specification or ticket written by someone else, using an architecture and/or design created by others. However, as they advance, they will contribute increasingly more to defining the requirements, architecture, and design of what they are building. They are more capable of working independently and not being blocked byothers, andwill have developed someexpertisein their area of focus, which may include several different approaches to solving problems with their area.The SoftwareEngineer II will begin to work on components that span a product and potentially a system and will also understand the components of other immediate team members and how their system interacts with these components. At Sulzer, we keep some of the world's most critical infrastructure running. From power generation and water treatment to oil & gas, chemical processing and manufacturing, our Service Centres and Field Service teams repair, maintain, upgrade and overhaul pumps, motors, turbomachinery and rotating equipment that our customers depend on every day.

With significant investment across our UK service network and a continued focus on operational excellence, we are looking for a Continuous Improvement Lead to drive transformational change across our Service Centres, Field Service operations and support functions throughout the UK North region.

This is more than a process improvement role. It's an opportunity to influence how we work, challenge traditional ways of thinking, and embed a culture of continuous improvement across a diverse engineering and service operation. You'll play a key role in enhancing customer experience, improving productivity, reducing turnaround times, eliminating waste and delivering measurable business results through the application of Lean methodologies and structured problem-solving techniques. Working closely with Service Centre Managers, Operations Managers, Workshop Supervisors, Supply Chain, Quality and front-line employees, you'll lead improvement initiatives that make our operations safer, faster, simpler and more efficient while helping position Sulzer as the service provider of choice in our markets.

  • Develop and implement standard work, visual management tools and operational performance metrics.
  • Coach, mentor and develop managers and employees in Lean thinking and continuous improvement methodologies.

Who We Are:

At Amsive, we're more than just a performance marketing agency; we're a team that thrives on collaboration and innovation. We offer a supportive environment where personal growth is just as important as professional development. We're a team of passionate individuals ready to tackle challenges, learn from one another, and drive results. We believe in empowering our team members, providing them with the tools they need to succeed, and trusting them to lead the way. With decades of expertise and a commitment to integrated solutions, we don't meet the industry standard; we're setting it. 

If you're looking for a place where your work matters, a career path you can grow on your terms, and a team that's as invested in your success as you are, Amsive is for you. We offer a unique blend of flexibility, growth opportunities, and a culture that values each individual. Join us, and be part of the team ready to welcome, support, and grow with you. 

We regret to inform you that currently, Amsive DOES NOT provide sponsorship opportunities.
This is a REMOTE position, candidates will be required to live in the United States and work EST or CST time zones.

What we are looking for:

Amsive is looking for an Associate Director, Social & Influencer Strategist to own a portfolio of client accounts, develop organic social and influencer strategies, and guide the team responsible for day-to-day execution. This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who can turn business goals and audience insights into clear plans, give useful creative direction, and keep multiple brands moving forward.

The Associate Director is accountable for the strategic quality, delivery, and performance of assigned social and influencer programs. Working with department leadership, Client Experience (CX), project management, creative, and channel specialists, this person sets account priorities, coaches team members, reviews work, and helps resolve challenges before they affect the client.

What you will be doing:

Own assigned social and influencer accounts

  • Lead assigned accounts from discovery and planning through execution, reporting, and ongoing optimization. Understand each client’s business, audience, brand voice, scope, and measures of success.
  • Serve as the primary social and influencer subject matter lead for assigned clients. Build trust through clear recommendations, proactive ideas, and consistent follow-through.
  • Lead strategy presentations, planning discussions, and performance reviews. Translate results into practical decisions about content, platforms, creators, and investment.
  • Partner with CX on client communication and relationship coordination, and with project management on schedules, dependencies, and approvals. Bring the strategic recommendations and delivery decisions needed to move the work forward.

Develop organic social strategy

  • Build organic social strategies grounded in audience research, social listening, competitive analysis, brand positioning, and client objectives.
  • Define platform roles, content pillars, editorial priorities, formats, publishing cadence, community engagement, and testing plans for each brand.
  • Translate strategy into clear briefs, content calendars, campaign concepts, and actionable direction for social managers, creators, designers, and copywriters.
  • Guide platform-native storytelling across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant channels. Recommend new platforms and formats where audience needs and business goals support them.
  • Set community management guidance, review sensitive responses, and escalate reputation or client concerns through established paths.

Lead influencer and creator programs

  • Develop influencer, creator, ambassador, and UGC recommendations that connect talent, content, and distribution to the client’s goals.
  • Guide creator research, audience and brand-fit evaluation, casting, outreach, briefing, and relationship management with the team executing the program.
  • Oversee campaign execution, content review, client approvals, posting milestones, and performance reporting. Ensure deliverables meet the approved brief and program requirements.
  • Partner with operations and designated reviewers on budgets, compensation, contracts, usage rights, exclusivity, disclosure requirements, and payment milestones. Keep commitments within approved scope and approval paths.
  • Connect creator content with organic publishing and coordinate with paid media specialists when approved amplification supports the program.

Guide and support the execution team

  • Turn account priorities into clear assignments, responsibilities, and quality expectations. Help team members understand both what needs to happen and why it matters.
  • Review content calendars, copy, creative, creator recommendations, community responses, and reporting before client delivery. Give specific feedback and confirm revisions address the brief.
  • Provide day-to-day coaching, unblock work, and help team members strengthen strategy, platform fluency, creative judgment, and client communication.
  • Monitor workloads across assigned accounts with project management. Recommend priority changes or resource adjustments, and raise capacity concerns with department leadership.
  • Support department leadership with onboarding, training, development feedback, and performance observations. Reinforce shared workflows and help the team build confidence and accountability.

Measure performance and connect the work

  • Define account-level KPIs and reporting plans with department leadership and analytics partners. Evaluate organic audience growth, engagement quality, content performance, creator results, and contribution to client goals.
  • Identify what is working, explain what needs to change, and turn insights into the next round of briefs, tests, and recommendations.
  • Partner with editorial content and SEO/AEO specialists to connect social and creator programs with audience questions, useful expert content, social search, and broader discovery opportunities.
  • Coordinate content repurposing and distribution across relevant teams while maintaining each brand’s voice and channel requirements.

Manage delivery and support account growth

  • Track deliverables, deadlines, effort, and approved budgets across assigned accounts. Flag scope changes, production needs, creator costs, or timing risks early, with a recommended path forward.
  • Keep Asana tasks, ownership, and account status current with project management and the execution team. Ensure briefs, feedback, approvals, and assets are easy to find.
  • Identify useful opportunities to expand or improve client programs. Contribute to scopes, proposals, pitches, and case studies with department leadership and CX.

Who you are:

  • 6+ years of experience as a social and influencer strategist with a track record of managing multiple client brands in an agency or comparable consulting environment.
  • Strong in organic social strategy, community engagement, editorial planning, and platform-native creative, with examples of growing audiences and improving meaningful engagement.
  • Experienced in influencer and creator programs, including talent evaluation, briefing, content approvals, campaign coordination, and measurement.
  • Comfortable leading client conversations and turning business objectives, audience insights, and performance data into clear recommendations.
  • Experienced guiding or managing team members, reviewing creative work, prioritizing assignments, and giving constructive feedback.
  • A strong writer, presenter, and creative briefer who can adapt to different brand voices and give the team clear direction.
  • Organized across competing deadlines, scopes, and budgets, with sound judgment about when to act and when to escalate.
  • Comfortable with Asana, social publishing and listening platforms, analytics tools, and creator management systems. Familiarity with social search and SEO/AEO collaboration is a plus.

Additional Information:

  • Unlimited Vacation Time, Annual Sick Days, Annual Personal Days, and 11 Paid Holidays
  • Dental, Vision, and Health Insurance
