raw.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

About the Role

As Lead Product Manager for Agentic Commerce, you'll define what agentic payments and rewards look like at Imprint, then go build it. This is a zero-to-one role: you'll run a small skunkworks team that ships in tight increments, puts new products in front of real users fast, and lets the market tell us what works.

We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply fluent in payments, and genuinely obsessed with AI agents. You don't just follow the space; you use agents every day and build with them yourself.

Agentic Commerce is a small, high-autonomy team inside Imprint's payments organization. It operates like a startup within the company: few dependencies, short cycles, and a bias toward shipping something real over polishing a plan.

You'll report to the product leader for Payments, Risk and Customer Operations, and partner day to day with engineers on our payments and messaging platform. You'll also work closely with partnerships, risk, compliance and our brand partners to turn experiments into products that can run at scale.

The Opportunity

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for agentic commerce at Imprint, from how agents initiate and authorize payments to how cardholders use agents to earn and redeem rewards.

  • Run a fast build-measure-learn loop: frame a bet, ship the smallest version that tests it, read the signal, and decide whether to scale, pivot or kill it.

  • Prototype hands-on with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor and similar) to get from idea to something users can touch in days, not quarters.

  • Get close to the power users who already use agents to optimize their spending and rewards, and turn what you learn into products they'd pay attention to.

  • Track the agentic payments ecosystem (network and wallet agent programs, agent payment protocols, tokenization) and decide where Imprint should build, partner or wait.

  • Work with risk, compliance and our bank partners to design agent-initiated payment flows that are safe and auditable from day one.

  • Make the case for what's working to leadership and brand partners, and help shape how Imprint takes agentic products to market.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: you've talked to dozens of power users and partners, picked the first two or three bets, and shipped at least one experiment to real users.

  • First 6 months: a repeatable cadence of small releases, with clear evidence on which agentic use cases drive engagement, spend or rewards value.

  • First 12 months: at least one agentic product live with brand partners, and a point of view on agentic commerce that shapes Imprint's broader product strategy.

Your Profile

  • 8+ years building products, as a product manager, founder or both, with a track record of taking something from zero to real usage.

  • Strong payments experience: card networks, issuing, acquiring, tokenization, wallets or money movement. You understand how a transaction actually flows and where the hard problems live.

  • Demonstrated high agency in ambiguous environments. You've been handed a blank page with no team, playbook or clear owner and delivered measurable impact anyway.

  • A genuine, hands-on passion for AI agents, shown through what you've built, shipped or tinkered with, not just what you've read.

  • Fluency with core LLM and agent concepts (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails) and the judgment to turn them into reliable products that handle real money.

  • Comfort prototyping with modern AI-native tools and working directly in code alongside engineers.

  • Clear, concise communication. You can explain a complex system to an engineer, a bank partner and an executive in the same afternoon.

We care more about what you've done than how your resume is titled. If you meet most of these and are excited by the role, we encourage you to apply.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As an Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist, you’ll help ensure Samsara’s invoices and vendor payments are processed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies. You’ll report to the Accounts Payable Manager and support the procure-to-pay process.

You’ll partner with colleagues across the company and with vendors to resolve questions, keep payments moving, and improve AP processes as Samsara grows.

This role can be based in an office or fully remote within Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to make a real-world impact. Samsara helps the industries that power our world operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably. Your work will help support the teams and processes behind that mission.
  • You’re motivated to grow. You’re interested in building your AP expertise, taking ownership of your development, and learning as the business evolves.
  • You enjoy improving how work gets done. You look for practical ways to make processes clearer, more efficient, and ready to scale.
  • You value working as a team. You build respectful partnerships, communicate openly, and contribute to an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Invoice and payment processing

    • Process a high volume of invoices accurately and on time.
    • Process invoices in multiple currencies for domestic and international vendors.
    • Partner with colleagues across the company to ensure invoices and payments are processed appropriately and in line with company policies and procedures.
    • Support weekly payment runs and help ensure vendors are paid on time.

    Vendor management

    • Respond to vendor inquiries through the company’s email management tool.
    • Maintain accurate accounts payable vendor records.

    Reporting, month-end close, and cross-functional initiatives

    • Reconcile account statements.
    • Support the monthly AP close, including the soft-close process, AP aging reviews, and accrual preparation.
    • Assist with the AP forecast.
    • Prepare analyses, schedules, and presentations to support audits and tax filings.

    Processes, systems, and controls

    • Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and systems, and recommend changes that support scale.
    • Document AP processes in accordance with policies and internal controls.
    • Perform and maintain AP SOX and operational controls, and follow applicable policies and internal controls.
    • Model Samsara’s cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2–3 years of accounts payable experience.
  • Knowledge of basic accounting principles.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of transactions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to partner with business stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify and help resolve issues.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or business administration.
  • Experience with ERP systems; NetSuite experience is preferred.
  • Zendesk experience.
  • SOX compliance experience.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships

Job Details

Role: Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships
Department: Business Development
Job Location: Remote (Canada)
Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)
Compensation: $112,000 - $163,000 CAD + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!


About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.


The Role

Joining Thrive’s Business Development department as Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships, you’ll be one of Thrive’s senior technical voices in sales moments. You’ll be involved in business development calls, RFPs, and audits across a range of different kinds of opportunities. With a background in paid media, you’ll articulate Thrive’s values, differentiators, and the driving principles behind managing modern paid media campaigns. You’ll partner with our team to qualify opportunities, execute sales workflows, and present and defend recommendations in high-stakes rooms. You’ll translate complex ad platform, measurement, and creative data into clear, credible insights tied to client business outcomes. Internally, you’ll own Thrive’s audit discipline, coach the stakeholders who contribute to it, and help the team develop content for use within the sales process and other company functions. Externally, you’ll participate in client travel, events, and key moments for existing clients.

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Set the standard for Thrive's technical audit discipline across paid media, measurement, and creative. Own the quality of strategic audits and RFP responses, ensuring recommendations are evidence-based, actionable, and tied to client outcomes.
  • Client: Build client confidence as a senior technical advocate throughout the new business process and existing partnerships. Present and defend strategic recommendations to executive stakeholders, translating complex technical findings into clear business insights.
  • People: Build audit capability across Thrive by coaching cross-functional contributors across Performance, Creative, Data, and Strategy. Establish quality standards, provide feedback, and develop resources that strengthen the team's technical expertise and delivery.
  • Company: Support Thrive's growth by strengthening how the company qualifies and wins new business opportunities. Partner with Business Development leaders to shape sales strategy, identify client growth opportunities, and inform service positioning and market differentiation.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days, you’ll learn Thrive’s sales process and performance marketing approach, including observing our audit process, how we think about multichannel strategies that generate leads and revenue for our most complex clients, and begin leading technical components of calls, as well as begin leading sales-focused audits with some support.
  • In your first 60 days, you’ll lead technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven audits and RFPs.
  • In your first 90 days, you’ll own all technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven audits and RFPs from back-end analysis through to pitch.

Qualifications

  • You’ve directly managed, audited, and optimized enterprise paid media programs with at least $250,000 USD in monthly spend, across e-commerce and/or demand generation.
  • You’re recognized as a performance marketing expert, with hands-on depth in Google Ads, Meta, and at least two other major platforms (e.g., Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Amazon, programmatic/DSPs).
  • You have a strong understanding of measurement: incrementality and lift testing, MMM, attribution, server-side and conversion tracking, and GA4 or equivalent analytics.
  • You’ve led audits end-to-end and spearheaded the technical components of the sales process, turning account-level data into insights and prioritized recommendations.
  • You have excellent analytical skills: you’re comfortable working through large datasets, building forecasts and budget scenarios, and pulling unique insights from both quantitative and qualitative data.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and have the ability to make complex technical findings clear and persuasive for any audience.
  • You’ve presented and defended recommendations to C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders in high-stakes new-business and expansion conversations.
  • You’ve coordinated sales, strategy, media, creative, and data contributors across audits and RFPs, owning scope, timelines, narrative, and quality.


---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Manager, Global Strategic Finance to drive execution of global financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes that support decision-making across our organization.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Manager, Global Strategic Finance to drive execution of global financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes that support decision-making across our organization.


This finance position will focus on the operationalization of our global planning and forecasting cycle, consolidation accuracy, internal reporting, and financial governance. You will partner with business leaders across all regions and functions to collect planning data, validate assumptions, and deliver financial visibility that supports operational and strategic decision-making. This role reports to the Director of Global Strategic Finance and works cross-functionally with Finance Operations, Accounting, and business unit leadership.


You will be the execution backbone of the global financial planning process—ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and consistency across a complex, multi-region organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute global financial planning and forecasting cycle — Manage the mechanics of annual budgeting and quarterly rolling forecasts; coordinate planning submissions across business units and geographies; validate data quality, challenge assumptions, and consolidate forecasts into a unified plan; manage planning calendar, timelines, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support global consolidation and close processes — Assist with P&L consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and month/quarter/year-end close activities; prepare consolidation workpapers and variance analysis; coordinate with regional finance teams and Accounting to ensure accuracy; support preparation of GAAP and management reporting views.
  • Develop and maintain financial reporting dashboards and KPI trackers — Build and refresh internal dashboards tracking key financial KPIs, budget vs. actual, and performance trends; highlight variance drivers and business performance insights; support monthly management reporting and internal governance meetings.
  • Monitor covenant and liquidity metrics — Track debt covenants, cash position, and liquidity metrics; prepare monthly covenant tracking reports; flag potential covenant risks early; support liquidity forecasting and treasury coordination.
  • Partner with business units on planning and forecast accuracy — Work with regional finance leads and business unit managers to validate planning assumptions, educate on forecasting methodology, and improve forecast accuracy over time; resolve data discrepancies and support root cause analysis.
  • Support financial modeling and scenario analysis — Build and maintain financial models supporting budget vs. actual analysis, sensitivity analyses, and scenario planning; assist in developing base case and alternative scenarios for internal governance discussions.
  • Drive process improvements and system enhancements — Identify opportunities to streamline planning processes, improve data quality, and enhance forecasting systems; work with IT and Finance Operations to implement tools and automation that reduce manual work and improve accuracy; leverage AI and automation tools to increase efficiency.
  • Support financial controls and data governance — Ensure data integrity in planning systems; support Accounting in reconciliations and validations; document planning assumptions and methodology; partner with Finance Operations to maintain strong process controls.

Skills & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of finance experience — including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and business partnering.
  • FP&A or corporate finance experience — In a strategic finance, financial planning, or corporate finance function.
  • Global and/or multi-entity finance experience preferred — Comfortable working across regions, entities, and consolidation scenarios.
  • EPM proficiency preferred — Experience with EPM planning tools (Adaptive Insights, Vena, Hyperion, Anaplan, etc.); willingness to learn new systems is essential.
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills — Ability to build financial models, perform variance analysis, and develop scenarios; advanced Excel skills required.
  • Attention to detail and process discipline — Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple competing deadlines, and commitment to accuracy in financial reporting.
  • Business partnering skills — Ability to work effectively with business leaders, finance teams across regions, and cross-functional stakeholders; comfort building relationships and managing expectations.
  • Strong communication skills — Ability to clearly explain financial data and insights to both finance and non-finance audiences; comfort presenting findings to leadership.
  • Problem-solving mindset — Ability to identify issues, dig into root causes, and recommend solutions; comfort with ambiguity and iteration.
  • AI and automation fluency — Comfort using LLM tools and AI-assisted applications to improve forecasting accuracy, automate manual processes, and enhance data quality; experience evaluating or implementing AI-driven efficiency tools is a plus.
  • ERP experience preferred — Familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).
  • MBA or CPA is a plus — Signals commitment to financial rigor and professional development.
  • PE-backed or growth-stage SaaS experience — Preferred.

About Us

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you! 

Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

At MRI, one of our core values is to strive to amaze.  From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?  

We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!  

MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.

We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

Zscaler is seeking a high-impact Sr. Director, National Partners to lead and scale our strategic National Solution Provider and Distribution ecosystem across the Americas (AMS). In this role, you will lead a senior team of Partner Business Managers (PBMs), drive C-level alignment with national partners, and orchestrate co-selling with regional sales leadership to accelerate Zero Trust adoption and multi-million-dollar ACV growth.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

Strategic Partner Vision & Executive Alignment

  • Own C-level/VP alignment across top National Solution Providers to make Zscaler their go-to Zero Trust partner.

raw.title: Gameplay Tools Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories.
raw.description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Gameplay Tools Engineer, you will create custom Unreal Engine tools that support teams across the studio. You will partner with stakeholders to understand the unique needs of their iteration workflows and author bespoke tools using C++ within the Unreal editor and in-game environments that will accelerate those pipelines. You will be a force-multipler for the team, enabling rapid exploration of new features and comprehensive analysis of and decision-making regarding the breadth of content that powers the emergent interactions of our games.

A Day in the Life:

  • Craft tools that support other disciplines (including art, audio, design) in efficient content creation, iteration and analysis.

  • Work with individual developers to build features that can reduce manual effort and accelerate workflows.

  • Playtest regularly with the team to understand the creative spaces our games are operating within in order to better support the team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple tools and supporting systems across the game, partnering closely with stakeholders and the production team to improve iteration throughput.

  • Collaborate closely with audio, VFX and design stakeholders to understand the needs of their development pipelines and proactively create solutions that will allow content production at scale.

  • Act as a technical bridge between gameplay and backend engineering teams to aid in the development of analysis and diagnostics systems across all aspects of our games.

  • Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and reducing friction in the development process.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience building game tools across one or more projects.

  • Experience building customized tools via the Unreal editor’s extension mechanisms.

  • Familiarity with Wwise or similar audio middleware.

  • Experience working closely with VFX systems and artists.

  • Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

Nice to Haves:

  • Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine.

  • Prior experience owning the decision-making and implementations of significant portions of the tools ecosystem of a game or engine.

  • Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay, engine or infrastructure systems for large-scale content.

The Team:

  • You will report to the Lead Gameplay engineer.

  • You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on.

How We Work

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

  • Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions.

  • Adapt when plans change.

  • Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection.

  • Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work.

  • Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning.

  • Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together.

You'll Thrive Here If...

  • You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions.

  • You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve.

  • You balance ambition with pragmatism.

  • You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback.

  • You care about helping your teammates succeed.

  • You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new.

Please Note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST).

Our Interview Process

(all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted)

  • Step 1: People Operations Introduction

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview

  • Step 3: Panel Interview (3 - 1 Hour Sections)

  • Step 4: Gardeners Debrief

  • Step 5: Offer

Life at Gardens

Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more.

We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it.

Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us could build alone.

Gardens Offers:

  • Competitive salaries and pay transparency

  • Stock options

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for individuals, 90% for dependents)

  • Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, and additional benefits

  • 401(k) contributions (U.S.) / RRSP + DPSP contributions (Canada)

  • Paid parental leave

  • A fully distributed remote studio across North American time zones

Benefits and perks listed may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Gardens and the country in which you work.

Physical Requirements: This is a primarily sedentary, remote role requiring the ability to remain stationary and perform computer-based work for extended periods, including sustained use of monitors, keyboards, mice, and game controllers for a minimum of six hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. Gardens is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Encouragement: We believe that diverse perspectives make our team stronger and our games better. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every single qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Research consistently shows that talented people, particularly women, people of color, and those from historically underrepresented communities are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. We care far more about curiosity, growth, and a willingness to learn than checking every box.

Scam Note: Unfortunately, scammers have impersonated Gardens Interactive by offering fake employment opportunities intended to collect financial information.

Official communication from our team will always come from a @ email address. We will never ask for financial information during the hiring process.

If you're ever unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly through LinkedIn or

raw.title: Channel Operations Coordinator
raw.excerpt: We are building a partner program from scratch.  Our Head of Channel recruits the partners and decides how the program runs.
raw.description:
We are building a partner program from scratch. Our Head of Channel recruits the partners and decides how the program runs. You make sure it runs.

That means every referral gets logged, every registered deal gets a decision, and every partner-sourced opportunity can be traced back to the partner who sent it. When a partner asks where their deal stands, you know the answer before they finish the email.

This is an inside role that also travels. When you are not at an event, you will spend most of your time in our CRM, our partner tracking tools, and spreadsheets that other people depend on. Expect some of the processes you build in your first quarter to be rewritten by your second. The program will grow faster than its first version.

We will judge this role on whether the partner pipeline is accurate, current, and moving.

What You'll Own

  • Partner records. Onboard new partners into our systems, keep agreements, contacts, and tiers current, and close out partners who go quiet.
  • Deal registration. Receive registrations, check them for conflicts with existing opportunities, route them for a decision, and tell the partner the outcome. Quickly, and in writing.
  • Pipeline hygiene. Every partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunity carries the right source, the right partner, and the right stage. You find the ones that do not and fix them with the owner.
  • Reporting. Build and run the weekly partner pipeline report for our scorecard. When a number moves, know why before someone asks.
  • Referral payouts. Track what each partner has earned under their agreement and prepare payouts for approval and accounting. You calculate. You do not approve.
  • Event follow-through. Handle registrations, badge lists, and shipping for the events the Head of Channel picks, then get every contact from the event into the CRM within the week. A conference without follow-up is a very expensive trip.
  • Partner communications. Send program updates, distribute enablement materials built with marketing, and keep the partner contact list clean enough that the right person gets the right email.

What Comes to Us

The Head of Channel decides which partners we sign, which events we attend, and which tools we use. Partner agreements, referral fees, and payouts are approved by the CEO.

You will not sell. When a partner brings a deal, our sales team works it, and you keep the record of it straight from first referral to close.

If something in a registration or a payout looks wrong, flag it. Catching it is part of the job, and nobody here will be annoyed that you did.

REQUIRED

  • One to two years in sales operations, channel operations, revenue operations, or partner support at a B2B technology company

  • Daily working experience in a CRM such as Zoho, HubSpot, or Salesforce

  • Willingness to travel up to 30 percent of the time

  • Spreadsheet skills strong enough to build a report someone else can trust

  • Written communication that partners can act on without a follow-up call

  • Attention to detail that holds up on the hundredth record, not just the first

  • CCP certification within twelve months of hire, supported by Agile IT

  • U.S. person status, required by the nature of our customers' work

PREFERRED

  • Experience with a partner relationship management platform

  • Experience coordinating trade shows or conferences

  • Familiarity with the Microsoft partner ecosystem

  • Exposure to defense, federal, or another regulated market

  • Experience with Zoho or Autotask

Additional Information:

  • Salary: $70,304 to $85,000 per year. The final offer depends on experience, skills and location.

  • Comprehensive benefits package (medical, retirement plan, PTO, professional development).

  • Work environment: This role is remote, with travel up to 30 percent of the time, mostly to the partner events on our calendar. We meet in person as a full company once a year, and the next one is in San Diego in early 2027.

  • You will report to our Head of Channel.

  • You will be the second person on a channel team of two. The upside is that you will see how a partner program gets built from the inside. The cost is that some days you will also be the person who finds out what does not work yet.

Agile IT is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, contact HR.

Agile IT is a Microsoft AOS-G partner and Cyber AB Registered Practitioner Organization (RPO) built for the Defense Industrial Base. As one of six original AOS-G resellers for GCC High, we help defense contractors meet CMMC compliance and operate securely in Microsoft cloud environments. Our customers build fighter jet components, naval propulsion systems, satellite payloads, and aerospace platforms that support the Department of War. We make sure their Microsoft environments are ready for the job.

We are in a high-growth phase, and we are stacking the team to match. This role sits at the center of how we get DIB clients across the finish line, from first gap assessment through a C3PAO-led Level 2 assessment and the compliance work that follows.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Job Summary

The Electronics Category Manager is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies, managing suppliers, and providing category leadership for electrical and electronic components used in electrical panels and control assemblies. This role collaborates closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, and panel shops to ensure cost efficiency, quality, and supply resilience.


What You’ll Do

Category Strategy & Ownership

- Develop and implement category strategies for assigned categories.

Segment suppliers into strategic classifications and manage AVL (Approved Vendor List).
- Own performance metrics for cost, lead time, quality, and supply resilience.


Engineering Collaboration & Design Support
- Partner with Engineering on component selection for new product introductions (NPI).
- Identify alternate components and substitutions.
- Drive standardization of components across product platforms.

Supplier Identification & Management
- Identify and qualify new OEMs and distributors.
- Negotiate pricing, agreements, and stocking programs.
- Manage supplier performance through QBRs and scorecards.

Panel Shop & Operations Support- Act as sourcing liaison for panel shops.

- Support insourcing and outsourcing of Panels and electrical assemblies as needed.
- Standardize components and bills of materials (BOMs).
- Support escalations, costed BOMs, and Approved Manufacturer Lists (AML).

Cost Management & Optimization
- Develop cost-reduction initiatives and pipelines.
- Transition spend from distribution to direct OEM where beneficial.

- Manage assigned spend and build ideation and roadmaps to achieve Y-o-Y savings goals.

Lead-Time, Lifecycle & Risk Management
- Monitor global supply constraints and lead-time trends.
- Identify end-of-life (EOL) and last-time-buy (LTB) risks.
- Implement second sourcing and risk mitigation strategies.

Data Management & Compliance
- Maintain accurate ERP and PLM master data.
- Ensure compliance with regulatory and customer requirements.

- Own commercial agreements and reporting processes.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in sourcing, category, or commodity management.
  • Experience collaborating with Engineering and panel integrators.
  • Strong negotiation and commercial skills.


Preferred (Not Required)

  • Experience with UL 508A panel shops.
  • Familiarity with low-voltage components and automation systems.
  • Global sourcing experience.

About Admitpro.ai

Admitpro.ai is an early-stage artificial intelligence startup built to help high school students discover their strengths, map out early career paths, and navigate the journey toward their future goals. We are building a platform where cutting-edge technology meets human potential. We are launching an elite cohort of student leaders to serve as the local faces and voices of our technology in school districts nationwide.

What We Provide to You

This internship is built from the ground up to give you real-world skills, an incredible resume, and a massive advantage when you apply to college. We do not expect you to have any prior marketing or business experience; we just want you to be curious, hardworking, and ready to learn.

Here is what you will get out of your internship with us:

  • Hands-on Training with Next-Gen AI: We will teach you how to use advanced, autonomous software engineering and marketing AI agents like Claude Code, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw to manage networks and scale regional outreach campaigns.

  • A Real Portfolio Project: Over the course of the internship, you will build your own independent project: a community expansion framework for your specific geographic region or school district. At the end of the internship, you will give a formal presentation of your project to our leadership team. This gives you a tangible, impressive leadership asset to talk about in your college applications and essays.

  • Letters of Recommendation & Certificates: Every student who completes the internship will receive an official certificate of completion. For students who show amazing growth and excellence, our founders will write a personalized letter of recommendation for your college applications focusing heavily on your direct impact on company growth.

What You Will Do

As a Regional Growth Lead, your week will balance structured learning with real startup leadership experience:

  • Learn: Attend / watch training to master modern leadership strategies and community outreach software.

  • Test: Act as an elite internal tester for the Admitpro.ai platform by using the service deeply, catching bugs, testing new features, and giving us direct feedback on what works and what can be improved.

  • Evangelize: Act as a local student advocate, introducing Admitpro.ai's free features to your peers, clubs, and student networks.

Who We Are Looking For

  • You are a current high school student who is driven, ambitious, and loves community building, leadership, public speaking, or student government.

  • You are organized, reliable, and comfortable leading initiatives and connecting with peers remotely and locally.

  • No prior experience is required. We will teach you everything you need to know.

raw.description:
About the Job



Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.

The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer-focused behavior.

We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.

Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .

Summary:

The Billing Specialist, known as Revenue Cycle Specialist II with ruralMED, is responsible for planning, organizing, and implementing activities related to charging, billing, collections, and cash management functions.

This role requires strong, hands-on experience with critical access hospital (CAH), rural health clinic (RHC), and/or hospital/facility billing, including a deep understanding of the unique reimbursement methodologies, regulatory requirements, and payer guidelines associated with these settings.

The specialist ensures maximum reimbursement for services provided by utilizing expert knowledge of insurance rules and regulations, best practice workflows, and multiple billing systems. Additionally, this role serves as a key resource and mentor to other billing staff, particularly in complex hospital and rural billing scenarios. Compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as Ovation policies, is required.

General Requirements / Job Duties:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Billing (Hospital & Rural Focus):

  • Evaluate, coordinate, develop, and implement billing processes, with a strong focus on critical access hospital, RHC, and facility-based billing workflows

  • Process electronic and paper claims accurately and timely, ensuring compliance with CAH reimbursement methodologies and payer-specific billing requirements

  • Resolve clearinghouse and DDE claim errors and payer rejections, including those specific to hospital and rural facility billing

  • Perform follow-up on underpaid or unpaid claims, particularly those involving complex hospital billing structures, cost-based reimbursement, and rural payer nuances

  • Research and resolve issues impacting reimbursement, including medical necessity, coding discrepancies, and facility-specific billing requirements

  • Review balances post-insurance to ensure proper adjudication based on hospital and CAH billing guidelines

  • Resolve overpayments, including reconciliation of facility claims and cost-based reimbursements

  • Process payer correspondence and take appropriate action using internal and external resources

  • Maintain aging reports and proactively address accounts nearing timely filing limits

  • Resolve denied claims using payer reconsideration and appeals processes, with emphasis on facility and rural claim denials

  • Document all account activity thoroughly within the EHR system

Reporting:

  • Review and act on accounts receivable reports (DNFB, ATB, denials, clean claims, etc.), with attention to hospital billing performance metrics

  • Prepare reports to address payer discrepancies, particularly those involving facility reimbursement issues

​

Other:

  • Maintain accurate payer setup, including rules specific to hospital, CAH, and rural billing

  • Stay current on CMS, Medicaid, and commercial payer regulations impacting facility and rural reimbursement

  • Perform reimbursement analysis, including cost-based reimbursement and hospital payment methodologies

  • Monitor third-party payer contracts to ensure accurate reimbursement

  • Maintain proficiency in EHR, clearinghouse, and payer systems

  • Communicate escalated billing or payer issues to leadership

  • Participate in meetings, training, and continuing education

  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality at all times

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred

  • Minimum of 2 years of medical billing experience required (5+ years preferred), with a strong emphasis on:

    • Critical Access Hospital (CAH) billing – strongly preferred

    • Hospital/facility billing – required

    • Rural Health Clinic (RHC) billing – preferred

  • Proven experience working with facility-based claims, UB-04 billing, and payer reimbursement methodologies

  • Strong knowledge of medical and insurance terminology

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office

  • Knowledge of Nebraska payer rules is a plus

Working Conditions:

  • Work from home with a stable internet connection, a dedicated workspace, and access to necessary equipment. Requires prolonged sitting and consistent communication via phone, email, and video conferencing.

  • Remote work is expected 100% of the time unless otherwise agreed upon. This role requires access to confidential information and adherence to all privacy and security policies.



Benefits


The base compensation range for this position is:


$46,666.67 - $65,333.33

Compensation ranges could be hourly or salary depending upon the exempt status of the posted position.


Beginning compensation is determined based on objective factors such as location, qualifications, skills, certifications, and experience. Typically, a candidate is hired in the lower to midpoint of the range; the top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive specialized experience and mastery within the role. Compensation may increase over time based on performance, experience, and tenure.


Compensation is only part of Ovation's total compensation package. Some additional benefits offered to full-time associates are:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage
  • HSA with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts for health care, and dependent care accounts
  • Wellness platform with premium incentives
  • Employee assistance support and additional voluntary supplemental plans including accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and child disability insurance
  • Robust and flexible paid time off offerings and company paid holidays
  • 401(k) plan with discretionary employer match opportunities
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company issued equipment

Job Title: TMF Associate
Employment Type: Full time, Permanent
Job Reports To: Manager, TMF Operations
Department/Unit Name: TMF Operations

Job Summary:

Responsible for the management of the Trial Master File (TMF) content and associated processes during the study life cycle from study set up to transfer/archiving. Work in partnership with study teams during periodic file reviews and audits to address findings related to the TMF. Manage access and organization of the controlled electronic file repository, in line with the defined file structure and access management framework. Work proactively and successfully within a cross-functional team. Communicate and promote department and company goals and practices. Interact with stakeholders in a way that fosters a positive working atmosphere and encompasses a professional and helpful attitude. Time allocated may be adjusted based on need.

Service Delivery

  • Serve as the primary TMF contact for assigned studies.
  • Ensure TMF is complete and “inspection ready” throughout study lifecycle and documents are filed contemporaneously.
  • Work with Team Lead to create study specific TMF management and oversight documents (e.g., File Index, Expected Document Lists and TMF Management Plan) in alignment with study.
  • Develop and maintain study-specific work instructions, as needed.
  • Utilize organization skills to maintain a quality control schedule and perform periodic inventories of study TMF to ensure completeness.
  • Review and communicate out-of-scope and/or incomplete documents to study teams; escalating as needed.
  • Reconcile expected document lists based on study events and milestones.
  • Prioritize and resolve TMF help desk tickets; may include triaging activities.
  • Provide study specific TMF training to internal and/or external stakeholders, as needed.
  • Process and review documents, following applicable scanning and best practices and best practices, and applying ALCOA principles appropriately.
  • File and retrieve TMF documents in a timely manner.

Department Support

  • Complete routine administrative tasks in a timely manner (e.g., timesheets, metrics).
  • Participate in discussions, decisions and sharing of knowledge in department meetings, periodic presentations, and smaller working groups.
  • Seek opportunities to assist in the development, implementation and maintenance of internal systems (e.g., databases used to manage records).
  • Provide mentorship and training to junior level staff.
  • Propose suggestions and work on the development and maintenance of department quality system documents to improve efficiencies.

Qualifications

  • The successful candidate will possess a college diploma/degree and 3 years of relative related experience or on going training. They will have an understanding of TMF organization, implementation, and archival including relevant regulations and guidance to assure quality and integrity of TMFs. Have the ability to incorporate the principles of ALCOA in relation to TMF oversight. Utilize skills in time management and problem-solving. Identify challenges and problems and take the initiative to identify solutions. Demonstrated computer literacy, proven functional knowledge of Microsoft packages and potential to develop.

Working Conditions

  • - Home based, with the ability to go into office occasionally if needed.
  • *Accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment and selection lifecycle. Requests can be directed to

Warning

  • PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Alimentiv is aware of the continued increase of phishing scams, leveraging various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media. Please note that Alimentiv only uses company email addresses, which contain “@alimentiv.com”, to communicate with candidates via email. If you are contacted by someone about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender’s email address and that they are asking you to apply on this website. If you believe you’ve been a victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report.

The firm has approximately 1,100 attorneys in 17 offices: 13 in the U.S., two in China, and two in Europe. Our broad spectrum of practices and entrepreneurial spirit allow exceptional opportunities for professional achievement and career growth.

Wilson Sonsini is seeking a Patent Docketing Specialist to join our Intellectual Property docketing team. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating and maintaining all aspects of the patent computerized docket system, working closely with practice group lawyers, staff, and third-party docketing vendors to ensure efficient and effective patent support services.


This position is available as a fully remote opportunity.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Calendar dates related to patent application filings, formalities, office actions, and maintenance fees
  • Download and file electronic correspondence from the USPTO, foreign patent offices, or foreign agents into the document management system
  • Circulate incoming correspondence from the USPTO, foreign patent offices, or foreign agents to the appropriate attorney teams
  • Prepare firm-standard and custom docket reports
  • Proactively monitor due dates to ensure deadlines are met on time
  • Review outstanding dates in the docketing database, consult with supervisors, and advance or de-docket as instructed
  • Open and close matters in the docketing database as needed
  • Set up new cases in the docketing database
  • Assist with intakes and transfers related to new clients, attorney hires, attorney departures, or changes in counsel
  • Participate in IP practice group and docketing team meetings
  • Provide backup support to other docketing staff as needed
  • Perform other tasks as assigned

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

  • 5+ years of automated patent docketing experience; candidates with more experience are also considered
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience
  • Familiarity with electronic filing systems and paperless docketing
  • Extensive knowledge of CPI and the USPTO's Patent Application Information Retrieval (PAIR) system
  • Knowledge of U.S., PCT, and foreign patent docketing procedures
  • Understanding of rules and deadlines for domestic and foreign patents
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail • Ability to manage multiple priorities • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, and Excel)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to perform duties with minimal direction
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate virtually with colleagues


The primary location for this job posting is in Palo Alto, but other locations may be listed. The actual base pay offered will depend upon a variety of factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, level of education, professional certifications and licenses, and work location. Business Intelligence Developer (Power BI)

Job Title: Data Engineer

Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS) – Enabling Technology
Location: Remote

About Pearson Virtual Schools

At Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS), we are committed to expanding access to high-quality education through innovative digital learning solutions. PVS is a division within Pearson, a global leader in the education industry. Our PVS Enabling Technology team plays a critical role in this mission by building scalable, trusted data products that empower school leaders, educators, and operational teams to make informed decisions that improve student outcomes.

As we evolve toward a Data Product–driven organization, we are investing in modern analytics capabilities that combine trusted data pipelines, semantic models, and self-service reporting experiences.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Power BI Developer to help build and deliver analytics and ETL (extract, transform & load) solutions that support decision-making across Pearson Virtual Schools. This role will work across data engineering and business intelligence, turning data into clear and useful reporting experiences.

You will work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop semantic models, dashboards, and reports that follow established data products and organizational standards. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent ownership of reporting work across the delivery lifecycle—from gathering requirements through deployment and support—while collaborating with experienced team members on broader analytics and data engineering initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Data Visualization & Reporting

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports that support school operations, student outcomes analysis, and enterprise reporting
  • Translate business needs into intuitive, actionable visualizations aligned with PVS reporting standards
  • Help improve report performance, usability, and accessibility for diverse end users (school leaders, analysts, executives)
  • Implement and maintain data security policies within reporting tools in adherence with PVS data security policies, governance and best practices

Semantic Modeling

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) that serve as governed, reusable data foundations
  • Apply established data modeling practices such as star schema, DAX optimization, and row-level security
  • Partner with engineering to ensure alignment between data pipelines and reporting layer

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Validate data outputs and ensure consistency between reports and source systems
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues
  • Contribute to monitoring, testing, and documentation of reporting solutions
  • Implement and validate Row Level Security in a multi-tenant environment

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to refine requirements and prioritize features
  • Participate in design discussions, backlog refinement, and peer reviews
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Scalability & Data Product Enablement

  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable reporting assets that align with PVS data product strategy
  • Support self-service analytics by enabling well-documented datasets and consistent definitions
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment practices, governance, and lifecycle management

What You Bring

Technical Expertise

  • 4+ Years of practical experience with Power BI, including report development, visualizations, DAX, Power Query, and semantic modeling; exposure to tools such as Tabular Editor 3, DAX Studio, or ALM Toolkit is helpful
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts, including star schema and fact/dimension design
  • Experience with SQL and working with structured datasets in data warehouses/lakehouses
  • Familiarity with data pipelines and integration concepts (e.g., Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT patterns)

Problem Solving & Growth

  • Experience independently delivering reporting solutions from requirements through deployment and support
  • Ability to troubleshoot common data, performance, and visualization issues, with support when needed
  • Experience improving data quality, reliability, and usability

Collaboration & Communication

  • Strong communication skills that deliver exceptional value to internal and external customers
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams
  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in Power BI development, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related area
  • Experience building or supporting reports and dashboards used for operational or business decision-making
  • Experience working with data in an environment where tools, architecture, and governance practices continue to evolve

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in education, EdTech, or multi-tenant data environments
  • Experience with Google BigQuery
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and semantic layer standardization
  • Experience supporting self-service analytics at scale

Why Join Us

  • Contribute to meaningful analytics work that supports students, educators, and school systems nationwide
  • Be part of a growing Data Product organization shaping the future of analytics at PVS
  • Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Become part of the Pearson Virtual Schools mission where we are helping people achieve success through lifelong learning

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Trusted, high-performing Power BI reports used consistently by stakeholders
  • Scalable semantic models enabling self-service analytics

In this role, you will own the product throughout its entire lifecycle—from identifying customer needs and defining product strategy to measuring business impact and continuously improving the product. Product Strategy & Vision

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Associate, Brand Onboarding to join our Product Support team. This is a hands-on, in-the-queue role: you'll own your own Shopify onboarding queue, work directly with brands every day, and get them live fast. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Brand Onboarding.

You'll spend roughly 80% of your time onboarding brands and 20% on projects that make onboarding smoother for brands and the team. This role is remote and works Pacific Time business hours, giving our West Coast brands same-day coverage, with flexibility to support launches as needed.

Your Impact In The Role

  • Own a dedicated queue of Shopify brands from kickoff through go-live, getting every brand live quickly with clear next steps, proactive updates, and no surprises
  • Walk brands hands-on through setup (Shopify integration, tracking, catalog, and payment configuration), resolving blockers yourself within onboarding before they delay launch or become support tickets
  • Take on at least one non-Shopify onboarding a month to build range and grow toward a mixed queue
  • Proactively drive stalled and unresponsive brands forward, keeping account notes current so status is always clear
  • Provide OOO coverage for Shopify and low-maintenance accounts so no brand stalls
  • Handle complex onboarding questions through resolution, applying judgment beyond macros and escalating to the Manager when needed
  • Keep onboarding docs and checklists up to date without being asked, flagging gaps, root causes, and repeat issues you see in the queue
  • Help newer Associates during active onboardings and share what you learn with the team

You Are Energized By

  • Being on the front line with brands and getting them to launch
  • Juggling a full queue and keeping every account moving
  • Figuring out why something broke, not just patching it
  • Owning a problem from first flag to final fix, and bringing a proposed solution, not just the issue
  • Direct feedback and evolving processes; you own mistakes openly and adjust quickly
  • Fast-moving, high-growth environments where priorities shift and adaptability is a strength

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in client onboarding, implementation, customer support, or a related role
  • Hands-on Shopify experience strongly preferred; e-commerce, creator, or affiliate platform experience a plus
  • Proven ability to manage many accounts at once, balancing urgency, quality, and relationships
  • Strong troubleshooting skills: you isolate issues and go beyond the script
  • Accurately assesses brand impact and urgency to prioritize your queue
  • Clear, complete written communication: brands, teammates, and Engineering can act on your updates without follow-up questions
  • Strong written and verbal communication with brands and internal teams
  • Precision in technical guidance: you confirm before you advise, especially on high-stakes launches
  • Highly organized and reliable; you follow through on every account

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Familiarity with Intercom, Salesforce, or similar support and CRM tooling
  • Knowledge of the creator economy, influencer marketing, or affiliate platforms
  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Fin AI, Claude, or similar) to work faster and spot gaps

The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of bonus potential or commission, and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. ShopMy is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of ShopMy receives equity on top of cash compensation!

Benefits & Perks

ShopMy invests in more than compensation. We support your health, your growth, and your life outside of work.

  • Equity in ShopMy - Every employee is an owner; all roles receive equity
  • Monetize Your Influence - Every employee builds and grows their own ShopMy page
  • 401(k) with Company Match - 3% employer contribution, fully vested
  • Healthcare Coverage - Medical, dental & vision benefits, including a 100% employer-paid medical option and dependent coverage
  • Mental Health Support and More - We offer employees and their dependents virtual mental health support, urgent care, and primary care visits at no cost
  • Flexible PTO - Take the time you need, including your birthday off
  • 13 Company Holidays

  • Remote-First Culture with an NYC HQ - Some teams may have different location requirements
  • Workplace & Wellness Stipends - Support for wellness, home office needs, and a Wellhub membership
  • Disability & Life Insurance - 100% employer-paid
  • Health Care FSA/HSA
