raw.title: Gerente de Produto
raw.excerpt: Um portfólio de produtos bem posicionado começa com a compreensão do mercado, das necessidades dos clientes e das oportunidades de cada cultura.
raw.description:
Um portfólio de produtos bem posicionado começa com a compreensão do mercado, das necessidades dos clientes e das oportunidades de cada cultura. Na Enza Zaden, você terá um papel estratégico no desenvolvimento e posicionamento de variedades, conectando as estratégias globais às necessidades dos mercados regionais.


Como Gerente de Produto - SOLANÁCEAS, você contribuirá para o crescimento sustentável do negócio, buscando maximizar as vendas, a participação de mercado e a margem bruta por meio da gestão do portfólio e da introdução de novas variedades na América do Sul.


Faça a diferença como Gerente de Produto


Nesta posição, você será responsável por contribuir para a definição e implementação das estratégias de mercado e de portfólio para as culturas sob sua responsabilidade. Seu trabalho envolverá o acompanhamento do desempenho comercial das variedades, a identificação de oportunidades e a definição do melhor posicionamento dos produtos nos diferentes mercados da região.


Você atuará em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Gestão de Portfólio, Desenvolvimento de Produtos, Vendas, Marketing e Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, garantindo que as estratégias globais sejam traduzidas em planos regionais e ações locais.


Além disso, manterá contato próximo com clientes estratégicos e outros parceiros do setor, trazendo informações relevantes sobre suas necessidades e sobre as tendências do mercado para apoiar o desenvolvimento e a introdução de variedades.


Nesta posição, suas atividades incluirão:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar o posicionamento das variedades de Solanáceas no mercado regional, em colaboração com a Gestão de Portfólio, buscando ampliar a participação de mercado, as vendas e a margem bruta;
  • Analisar os resultados de vendas e as previsões comerciais da região, alinhando informações e oportunidades com os gestores de Vendas das subsidiárias;
  • Alinhar o portfólio de variedades comercializadas na região com a estratégia global, em conjunto com a Gestão Global de Portfólio;
  • Contribuir para a construção de planos estratégicos de mercado e de culturas ou segmentos, considerando os mercados convencional e orgânico;
  • Traduzir os planos estratégicos em ações táticas e operacionais, acompanhando sua implementação nos mercados sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e atualizar modelos estratégicos de produto por cultura ou tipo de cultura, considerando características relevantes das variedades, necessidades dos clientes e informações de mercado;
  • Compartilhar com a equipe de melhoramento informações e recomendações sobre conceitos, modelos de produto e oportunidades para atender às necessidades dos diferentes mercados;
  • Participar da execução dos planos de clientes, oferecendo informações e suporte técnico à equipe comercial;
  • Propor o avanço de variedades nas diferentes etapas do processo de desenvolvimento e introdução, de acordo com os processos internos da empresa;
  • Definir, quando necessário, a alocação de sementes de variedades em introdução e de variedades já existentes na região, em alinhamento com a Gestão Global de Portfólio;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as lideranças regionais de Vendas e a Gestão Global de Portfólio para alinhar as estratégias de produtos e clientes aos objetivos da Enza Zaden;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Desenvolvimento de Produtos, Vendas e Marketing, compartilhando dados, estratégias e resultados, além de acompanhar a implementação dos planos de mercado;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes estratégicos e outros parceiros do setor, como associações e consultores, para compreender suas necessidades e identificar tendências e oportunidades.

O que você traz como nosso futuro colega


Como Gerente de Produto, você combina visão estratégica, conhecimento técnico e compreensão das necessidades do mercado para contribuir com o desenvolvimento e o posicionamento de um portfólio competitivo.


Você se sente confortável analisando informações comerciais e de mercado, identificando oportunidades e transformando estratégias em planos de ação. Também gosta de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, conectando diferentes áreas e construindo relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e parceiros.


Buscamos uma pessoa com iniciativa, capacidade analítica e orientação para resultados, que tenha interesse em contribuir para o desenvolvimento de produtos e para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.


Além disso, você possui:

  • Formação superior em Agronomia, Engenharia Agronômica, Engenharia Agrícola ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência profissional no agronegócio, preferencialmente nos mercados de sementes ou hortaliças, em atividades relacionadas a gestão de produtos, desenvolvimento de portfólio ou vendas técnicas;
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com planejamento de mercado, análise de vendas e desenvolvimento de estratégias de produto;
  • Capacidade de analisar informações de mercado, necessidades dos clientes e tendências do setor;
  • Visão comercial e orientação para resultados;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e facilidade para construir relacionamentos com clientes, parceiros e equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Organização e habilidade para transformar estratégias em planos de ação e acompanhar sua execução;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas a clientes, áreas de produção e mercados sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Inglês e espanho avançado/fluente.

Enza Zaden como sua empregadora

A Enza Zaden é uma empresa internacional familiar que desenvolve variedades inovadoras de hortaliças desde 1938. Junto com mais de 3.300 colegas ao redor do mundo, trabalhamos com sementes de hortaliças com melhor sabor, maior produtividade e fortes resistências. Fazemos isso a partir da nossa missão: “Breeding to feed the world”. Todos os dias, mais de 480 milhões de pessoas consomem hortaliças cultivadas a partir das nossas sementes, e isso é motivo de muito orgulho para nós.


Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho e cuidamos uns dos outros. Boas ideias têm espaço para crescer e, juntos, seguimos avançando. É assim que continuamos a crescer e inovar, tanto como empresa quanto como colegas.


O que você pode esperar de nós

Acreditamos que é importante que você possa crescer no seu trabalho e se sentir bem com o que faz. Por isso, investimos no seu desenvolvimento, bem-estar e satisfação profissional.

Por meio do nosso programa de desenvolvimento Great to Grow, do nosso foco em vitalidade e de atividades que aproximam os colegas, criamos um ambiente de trabalho onde você pode continuar aprendendo e contribuir com energia e entusiasmo.


Vamos nos conectar

Está em busca de uma carreira que cresça junto com você? Candidate-se utilizando o botão de inscrição. Você receberá uma confirmação automática em poucos minutos. Informaremos os próximos passos em até 10 dias úteis.


Esta posição não poderá ser preenchida em regime temporário ou interino.


Tem dúvidas sobre a posição ou sobre o processo seletivo? Fique à vontade para entrar em contato com a área de RH no e-mail


A Enza Zaden é uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em histórico, identidade ou características pessoais.

Quer saber mais sobre a Enza Zaden? Visite nosso site.

raw.title: Director of Marketplaces
raw.excerpt: The Opportunity:We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Marketplaces to own our Amazon and third-party marketplace channels globally.
raw.description:
The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Marketplaces to own our Amazon and third-party marketplace channels globally. In this role, you will own the long-term planning, daily execution, and optimization of Amazon & additional marketplace performance for Caraway, including paid advertising, SEO and organic ranking, forecasting, reporting and analytics, business operations, review generation, listing and account management, product detail page improvements, and brand and pricing integrity across marketplaces.

This role will push us to think differently about our business and about how Amazon affects it, including how AI-driven shopping is changing the way customers find products. Our team moves fast, relies on data, and is always testing. You will be pivotal in helping Caraway become a generational brand with household-level awareness.

This role reports to Wilko Reinholz, Chief Marketing Officer.

Who You Are:

You have deep experience running Amazon seller accounts and turning strategy into results. You bring strong P&L expertise, a proactive mindset, and experience managing external Amazon agency relationships. You obsess over understanding how Amazon’s search and recommendation systems work, and how they are evolving with AI, and you optimize organic performance by leveraging keyword opportunities, reviews, competitive monitoring, pricing and promotion tactics, advertising, and third-party tools. You are relentless in building review funnels.

You protect brand equity as fiercely as you pursue sales: you know how to make marketplace pricing and assortment complement, rather than undercut, our DTC site and retail partners. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are data-driven, and enjoy owning all aspects of the Amazon channel, from day-to-day operations to long-term planning. You have omni-channel experience with at least two other marketplaces (e.g., Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, , Wayfair; including global marketplaces). You have a keen eye for product and merchandising opportunities, and understand how to leverage Email, SMS, Influencers, Affiliate, Paid Advertising, etc. to drive outside traffic to Amazon. You work well with creative, marketing, and logistics partners to bring our assortment to life.

Responsibilities:

  • P&L Ownership: Lead Amazon & Marketplaces for Caraway (globally). Set KPIs and targets, channel strategy, and drive sustainable revenue and margin growth.
  • Advertising and Traffic: Own in-platform marketing (PPC, DSP, video, OTT, Amazon Marketing Cloud) with a focus on organic ranking. Use Caraway’s email, SMS, influencer, affiliate, and PR channels to drive outside traffic to marketplaces. Judge ad spend on incrementality and contribution margin, and coordinate with paid social and search so we do not compete against ourselves.
  • Listings and Conversion: Oversee product setup and content (copy, imagery, keywords, attributes, A+ content) with internal and external teams. Own conversion strategy and testing.
  • Pricing, Assortment and Brand Protection: Set marketplace pricing and assortment so they support, not undercut, our DTC site and retail partners. Enforce MAP and monitor unauthorized sellers, hijackers, and counterfeits.
  • Operations and Account Health: Manage margin, account health, customer service experience, seller rating and case log management.
  • Inventory and FBA: Own FBA & FBM strategy, including inbound placement, inventory positioning, in-stock rates, and fee and freight costs. Work with Finance and Inventory Planning on demand forecasts, and update them as conditions change.
  • Product Launches: Plan and run on-time Amazon launches from start to finish, working with internal and external teams.
  • Growth: Work with Amazon directly on new opportunities to drive incremental growth (e.g. shows, exclusive color drops, bundles, etc).
  • Promotional Calendar: Own the promotional calendar (Deal of the Day, Lightning Deals, coupons, event deals) with Marketing, Finance, and Ecommerce to drive revenue and organic ranking.
  • Reviews: Build and run strategies to increase high-quality reviews and ratings. Monitor customer reviews and use what you learn to improve products, listings, and customer service.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Work with Caraway’s Data & Analytics team to report on key Amazon metrics, find insights, and turn them into improvements. Build dashboards that connect marketplace results to company-wide revenue and marketing measurement, and present results, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Market Awareness: Track competitors and marketplace changes, including algorithm updates, AI shopping features, fees, and policies.
  • Partners: Build strong working relationships with our Amazon agency, other agency and platform partners, Amazon contacts (such as CSMs), and internal teams (Strategy, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Ops). Decide over time which work should move in-house.
  • New Geographies and Marketplaces: Evaluate new channels and geographies to expand our marketplace presence and businesses: sequencing, localization, and operational set up.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • 8+ years of experience building, leading, and managing the Amazon and Marketplace channel for an eight-figure plus Amazon business (bonus if that includes international marketplaces)
  • Deep, hands-on Amazon experience (Seller Central), with a P&L ownership track record, not just campaign management
  • Fluency across the full Amazon stack: search/SEO, content, retail media (Sponsored Ads, DSP, AMC), FBA/supply chain, and platform operations
  • Practical, hands-on approach to organic ranking and review strategy
  • Strong experience in inventory management, merchandising, listing optimization, margin management, and pricing
  • Experience protecting brand pricing and positioning in a marketplace environment, ideally for a premium or DTC-heritage physical product brand (housewares, kitchen, or adjacent categories a plus)
  • Good instincts for new product opportunities based on keyword research and customer insight
  • Keen eye for new product development opportunities based on keyword research and customer insights
  • Experience managing agencies and cross-functional stakeholders while staying hands-on with the day-to-day
  • Expertise with Amazon and marketplace tools such as Helium 10, SmartScout, Amazon Brand Analytics, and advertising management platforms
  • Proficiency with analytics tools such as Looker, Excel, SQL, or Tableau
  • A growth mindset with a desire to test new ideas to unlock new, outside-the-box opportunities

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - 195,000. Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors determining the base pay at offer, including but not limited to: skills, qualifications, experience. This range provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

Life at Caraway:

Who We Are:

Caraway is a home goods brand on a mission to craft well-designed, non-toxic essentials that thoughtfully raises the standards of what you cook with. We’re passionate about creating elevated products, made without forever chemicals, that are better for you, your family, and the planet. We prioritize a holistic approach to the creation of Caraway products. We partner with ethical manufacturers where their employees are safe, paid fairly, given benefits, and work regulated hours. Our eco-friendly manufacturing process emits less CO2 than traditional non-stick coatings, and we use sustainable packaging practices and ship in packaging made from recycled materials. We pride ourselves on continuously striving to do and be better—for you and the planet—in every step of the process.

Since launching in November 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest growing digitally-native brands of the last decade and are now sold in retailers including Target, Bloomingdale’s, Crate & Barrel, The Container Store, Costco, Zola, and many more.

We’ve amassed over 200,000+ five-star reviews from more than 2.5M+ happy customers and thousands of press hits from the likes of Vogue, Domino, Good Housekeeping, Food & Wine, Architectural Digest, PureWow, Fortune, and CNN.

Team: You will be joining a passionate and collaborative fully-remote team that prides itself on high-quality work, supporting one another, sharing our successes, and building a brand we truly love, together.

Culture: At Caraway, we value continuous learning and career growth. We strive to continually optimize our processes, ensuring that we’re thoughtful in everything we do, both internally and externally. We listen to our employees, celebrate our wins, and constantly look for ways to be better for our team, and the world.

Workplace: Being a fully-remote company, we have no headquarters and are truly distributed across the country. Our leadership team sits on both the East and West Coast and we have folks in a variety of states. We offer a monthly stipend towards co-working space should folks need to switch up their working environment every now and then.

Benefits: We value you and your family. With this in mind, full-time eligible employees are provided:

  • Equity: We believe in our product and that the sky's the limit for where our business is going. You are an asset to Caraway’s success and we think you should be rewarded for it.
  • 401k: A 3% company match to help you plan for for your future
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental + vision coverage options with generous employer contributions + access to FSA/HSA/Dependent Care FSA’s
  • Parental Leave: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, depending on tenure, and access to additional fertility care services via KindBody
  • A Setup that works for you: From MacBook to PC, we’ve got you covered. Let us know what you prefer and we’ll get your at-home set up stocked!
  • Elevate your Workspace: Annual reimbursements for you to elevate your workspace, from standing desks to desktop succulents, you got it!
  • Fully Remote: Need to pick up the kids? No problem. Have a doctor’s appointment? Enjoy! Flexibility when you need it most.
  • Coworking Reimbursement: Need a break from the home setting? Monthly reimbursements for you to get out of the house and work from anywhere. From day passes, to monthly memberships, the world is your oyster, we mean office.
  • Events + Swag: Connection is top of mind (Yes, even in our completely remote environment). We have monthly virtual events, company wide offsites, and many opportunities for new Caraway swag!
  • Leveling Up with Caraway: In addition to exciting opportunities and exposure in your day-to-day work, we offer annual reimbursements to full-time employees to support their professional development aspirations!
  • #AwayFromCaraway: We believe healthy, happy humans do better work. We offer unlimited PTO in addition to our 11+ paid annual holidays and quarterly wellness days.
  • Wellness Reimbursement: Monthly reimbursements for you to stay well. From meal services to gym memberships to monthly massages, we want our team to have the flexibility to choose what wellness means for them.
  • Employee Discount: We provide an employee discount on all Caraway Home products so you can continue to level up your kitchen and home life, too!
  • Home Upgrade(s): Complimentary product as a new hire + continuous to expand your Caraway Home collection.

Caraway is an Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as during outreach, reviewing applications and analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

raw.description:
We’re hiring a Microsoft 365 Administrator based in Asia-Pacific to help manage, maintain, and secure our Microsoft cloud environment—including Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Purview.

You’ll be our first IT team member in the region, giving colleagues across Asia-Pacific support in their own working hours. You'll also play a key role in keeping our environment secure, well documented, and audit-ready for our clients and regulators.

What You’ll Do:

  • Administer Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Intune.
  • Resolve escalated technical issues (Level 2/3) for colleagues across Asia-Pacific in their local working hours, and be IT’s point of contact in the region.
  • Manage the user and device lifecycle—onboarding, role changes, and offboarding—across Entra ID and Intune, following our access control procedures.
  • Support our security and audit-readiness work, including Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels and data loss prevention), access reviews, and vulnerability and patch management.
  • Run and test backup and recovery, and take part in disaster recovery tests that produce the evidence our auditors and clients ask for.
  • Ensure the environment stays compliant with our internal policies and with data protection requirements such as GDPR and HIPAA.
  • Work closely with the IT team in Europe and the Americas on identity, infrastructure, and security projects.
  • Automate routine work with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and our approved AI tools.
  • Follow change management and keep runbooks, configurations, and support processes documented.
  • Stay up to date on the latest Microsoft 365 and security features and assess potential benefits for the organization.

What are we looking for?

· Fluent in English, written and spoken

  • Based in Asia-Pacific, ideally in Taiwan, Thailand, or India, able to work 100% remotely
  • Willing to overlap part of your working day with colleagues in Europe
  • Logical, analytical, and always ready to learn something new!
  • Comfortable working independently as the first IT person in the region, and as part of a global team
  • 1–5+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration, including Entra ID, Intune, and Exchange Online (but we’re open to ambitious early-career professionals, too)
  • Good communication skills and a customer-service mindset

Nice to Have:

  • Microsoft Defender, Entra Conditional Access, and Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels, DLP)
  • Identity governance: role-based access, access reviews, and privileged access
  • SharePoint site architecture and permissions management
  • Scripting and automation with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Git
  • Microsoft 365 backup and recovery tools, such as Veeam
  • Experience supporting audits or working with frameworks such as ISO 27001, HIPAA, or GDPR
  • Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, SC-300, or MD-102

Why Milestone One?

  • Work fully remotely from Asia-Pacific, with flexibility and trust
  • Be the first IT team member in the region, with real ownership and visibility
  • Join a collaborative, supportive global team making a difference in clinical research
  • Gain experience in Microsoft cloud security and real-world compliance frameworks
  • Get certified, level up your career, and take on exciting projects—one milestone at a time
  • Be part of something meaningful: secure, compliant, modern digital workplaces built with care and curiosity

Ready to grow with us? Apply now and let’s shape the future of secure digital work—one milestone at a time!

At Milestone One, it’s the people that move us forward.

We’re not just supporting clinical research—we’re laying the foundation stones for stronger study delivery. Milestone One is a Site Enabling Services organization with global headquarters in Zug, Switzerland, supporting clinical study sites around the world. Our IT runs on a secure, cloud-based Microsoft environment, and every milestone we reach is powered by passionate people like you.

At Milestone One, we work with purpose. Our team values curiosity, accountability, continuous learning, and a drive to go the extra mile. We're looking for people who think logically, solve creatively, and genuinely enjoy a challenge.

If that sounds like you, this might be your next step!

raw.excerpt: BryceTech is seeking a Program Manager to provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for a complex, multi-disciplinary support contract serving the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD).
raw.description:
BryceTech is seeking a Program Manager to provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for a complex, multi-disciplinary support contract serving the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD). This individual will be responsible for ensuring the successful planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of program management, financial management, comptroller, and customer support services across multiple Navy departments, programs, and geographic locations. The Program Manager will serve as the primary interface between BryceTech and Government leadership, ensuring contract objectives are achieved within established schedules, budgets, performance standards, and customer expectations.

Responsibilities

  • Provide overall program leadership and direction, overseeing the successful execution of all contract requirements and ensuring alignment with Government objectives

  • Develop and maintain program management plans, schedules, resource allocation strategies, and performance metrics to support effective contract execution

  • Oversee personnel, subcontractor coordination, staffing levels, labor-hour utilization, and resource requirements across geographically dispersed teams

  • Direct program planning and control activities, including budgeting, cost management, Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) development, schedule management, and performance monitoring

  • Establish and maintain risk management processes to identify performance, financial, staffing, and schedule risks and develop appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

  • Oversee the delivery of financial management, comptroller, program management, and customer support services, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and quality across all functional areas

  • Provide strategic oversight of program execution, including tracking technical milestones, deliverables, funding requirements, and evolving customer priorities

  • Lead Agile program management initiatives, including the application of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, backlog management, and performance tracking across multiple teams

  • Establish effective communication channels with the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO), Contract Specialist (CS), Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and other Government stakeholders

  • Conduct biweekly contract status meetings to review program execution, performance risks, issues, and proposed mitigation or corrective actions

  • Prepare and present program status briefings, management reports, performance assessments, and recommendations to Government leadership

  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation, review, and submission of contract deliverables and Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) documentation

  • Monitor contract performance against established quality standards and Government requirements, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed

  • Oversee compliance with contract requirements, security policies, personnel vetting, mandatory training, Operations Security (OPSEC), and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) protection requirements

  • Evaluate changing mission requirements and support the implementation of program adjustments to maintain alignment with Government priorities

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, resource utilization, financial performance, and customer satisfaction

Required Qualifications:

  • Active DoW Secret Clearance or above

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, management, finance, engineering, or a related field

  • Ability to travel primarily within the CONUS and potential for travel OCONUS one (1) to three (3) times per year for an estimated duration of three (3) to five (5) days per trip

  • 15+ years of experience managing complex Government contracts or programs, preferably supporting the Department of the Navy, DoW, or other federal agencies

  • Demonstrated experience overseeing multi-disciplinary teams and coordinating program execution across multiple functional areas and geographic locations

  • Strong background in program planning and control, resource management, budgeting, cost management, risk management, and performance reporting

  • Experience managing cost, schedule, and performance across large-scale Government programs

  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with senior Government stakeholders, contracting personnel, and customer leadership

  • Experience developing and presenting program status reports, executive briefings, management reports, and performance assessments

  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience overseeing teams utilizing project management tools such as Jira and Confluence

  • Strong understanding of Government contracting requirements, contract administration, deliverable management, and quality assurance processes

  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in mathematics, engineering, MBA, or other technical degree

  • 20 years of experience supporting Navy programs

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or DAWIA III Certification

  • Experience supporting Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), Naval Surface Warfare Centers (NSWCs), or Navy In-Service Engineering Activities (ISEAs)

  • Experience managing Financial and Program Management Support (FPMS), comptroller, financial management, or program analysis contracts

  • Experience applying Agile methodologies and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) within complex Government environments

  • Familiarity with Navy Enterprise Resource Planning (N-ERP), Power BI, and other Government financial and reporting systems

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

BryceTech is a trusted leader in complex technology domains, delivering data-driven solutions in aerospace, biosecurity, and defense. raw.description:
Job Title: Global Study Delivery Lead

Location: Remote-Flexible/Global

Job Type: Full-Time, exempt

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

SUMMARY

To lead and be accountable for Civia's global study delivery function, setting the standard for operational excellence, building high-performing delivery capability, and ensuring the successful delivery of all studies to time, cost, quality, and client expectations.

SCOPE

This is a hands-on, operational delivery role — not advisory and not a back-office systems function. The Global Study Delivery Lead is the global delivery authority for Civia’s studies, accountable for delivering them to time, cost, and quality, acting as a primary client point of contact, and owning project-management excellence across the organisation. Its defining way of working is close, day-to-day partnership with in-country delivery teams — enabling them and holding a single, high standard everywhere — and it is the single accountable owner of how delivery performance is reported. Where study-level delivery is managed at country level, this role owns delivery across the entire global portfolio, together with the methodology, baselines, and KPIs that make it repeatable.

The role operates at enterprise level within the study delivery leadership structure and holds no responsibility for strategic partners. The methodology, documentation, and reporting it builds are a means to an end: consistently delivering studies and exceeding client expectations.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Accountability for delivering Civia’s study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, globally
• Partnering closely with in-country delivery teams to raise and hold a single, high standard across every study and geography
• Acting as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, building trust and ensuring every commitment is met
• Ownership of project-management excellence across Civia, holding internal functions to account for delivery
• Direct, decisive intervention whenever delivery performance is at risk
• Identification, creation, and implementation of the methodology, documentation, baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that make delivery repeatable
• Sole ownership of study-performance reporting — ensuring delivery is represented accurately, currently, and in KPI terms always
• Sustained client confidence through delivery that consistently meets and exceeds expectations
• The accountable leader in Civia for setting the tone and expectations for study management, fostering excellence, and a mentor who develops less experienced delivery colleagues.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Study Delivery — Time, Cost & Quality

• Own delivery of the global study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, end to end across start-up, recruitment, execution, and close-out
• Maintain a forward-looking view of delivery health and forecast accuracy, and intervene directly and decisively when any study is at risk
• Drive the trade-offs and recovery actions that keep studies on schedule, on budget, and at the required quality
• Protect delivery quality, timelines, and cost discipline through proactive risk identification and resolution

Client Leadership & Point of Contact

• Act as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, owning the relationship and representing Civia’s delivery performance
• Provide transparent, forward-looking delivery communication — progress, risks, variance, and recovery actions
• Build trust through reliability and consistency, ensuring every commitment made to a client is met
• Enable repeat work by making Civia predictable and exceptional to deliver with

Project-Management Excellence Across Civia

• Own the standard of project-management excellence across Civia, leading the study delivery and project-management methodology
• Set clear ownership, decision rights, governance routines, and escalation pathways for study delivery
• Coach and uplift delivery and project-management capability so studies are run to a consistently high standard everywhere
• Hold internal functions accountable for their contribution to delivery commitments
• Mentor and develop more less experienced delivery and project-management colleagues, actively building the next generation of delivery talent

Global Partnership & Cross-Functional Alignment

• Work closely and continuously with in-country delivery teams— the primary partnership through which studies are delivered — enabling them, aligning on priorities, and holding a single, high standard everywhere
• Align Site Operations, Recruitment, Regulatory, Data, Quality, and Safety with country teams to deliver each study to plan
• Facilitate portfolio- and study-level delivery reviews and drive timely resolution of bottlenecks
• Establish clear accountability so every country team and function knows what it owns and by when
• Escalate constructively and act decisively when delivery performance deviates from plan

Methodology, Baselines, Forecasts & KPIs

• Identify, create, and implement Civia’s study delivery methodology, documentation, and processes — the means by which studies are delivered reliably
• Define the reporting baselines and forecasting models against which all study delivery is planned and measured
• Design, implement, and own the KPI framework for study delivery, ensuring metrics are meaningful, comparable, and acted upon globally
• Act as the single source of truth for study-performance reporting — owning the accuracy, currency, and integrity of every system, report, and KPI
• Embed a single, repeatable way of working that removes delivery variability across studies, sites, and geographies

Governance, Risk & Continuous Improvement

• Establish disciplined governance routines and a performance cadence across the portfolio
• Ensure continuous audit and inspection readiness is built into delivery
• Lead corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives, closing the loop from insight to embedded change
• Continuously refine methodology based on delivery data, lessons learned, and evolving client and regulatory expectations

Performance Measures (KPIs)

• On-time delivery: Studies delivered to agreed timelines across the global portfolio
• On-budget delivery: Delivery to cost and margin protection across the portfolio
• Quality: Delivery to required quality, with continuous audit and inspection readiness sustained
• Portfolio delivery vs commitment: ≥100% of study commitments met across the global portfolio
• Client satisfaction: Strong sponsor feedback on delivery and repeat awards
• Country-team partnership: Strength of collaboration with in-country delivery teams, evidenced by consistent, high-quality delivery and expectations exceeded across geographies
• Forecast accuracy: Delivery performance tracking on or ahead of approved baselines and forecasts
• Reporting integrity: Study performance always represented accurately and current, with systems, reports, and KPIs trusted as the single source of truth
• Delivery variability: Year-on-year reduction in delivery variance and avoidable slippage
• Project-management maturity: Consistent, high-standard application of delivery methodology and KPIs across all studies and geographies

Experience & Qualifications:

Required Experience

• 10-15 years of relevant experience with deep operational understanding of clinical trial delivery and its dependencies
• Track record of delivering strategic and operational outcomes
• Proven ability to design, document, implement, and scale delivery and project-management systems
• Strong regulatory, GCP, GDPR and operational literacy
• Strong analytical and financial literacy — builds baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that hold up
• Platform experience with CRIO, HubSpot, and Monday.com

Mindset

• Deeply focused on delivery — driven to complete studies to time, cost, and quality
• Client-first and self-starting; takes ownership of the relationship and closes delivery gaps on their own initiative
• Uncompromising on delivery standards and determined to exceed client expectations

Behavior

• Brings structure, clarity, and a single way of working to complex, multi-geography delivery
• Operates hands-on and close to the work, building strong, trusting partnerships with in-country delivery teams to raise the standard everywhere
• Acts decisively when delivery is at risk; closes the loop from insight to embedded change
• Communicates with authority, transparency, and credibility at leadership level
• Focuses on practical solutions and supports others in learning and improving through challenges.

Personal Traits

• Highly accountable, resilient, and composed under pressure
• Self-directed, organised, and adaptive — treats being a self-starter as the baseline, not the goal
• Builds confidence with teams and stakeholders through follow-through and reliability
• Takes pride in honest, current reporting — owns delivery issues as a reflection of the function and moves quickly to put them right

Qualifications:

  • ​B.S. or B.A.; MBA or equivalent advantageous. Science related degree preferred.

Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

The Content Production Assistant is a key member of the Content Operations team, responsible for uploading, formatting, publishing, and maintaining digital content across TechnologyAdvice's websites. Working closely with Editorial and other cross-functional teams, the CPA helps ensure content is published accurately, on time, and in accordance with established formatting and basic SEO standards.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with digital content and technology, has strong attention to detail, and takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work. The role offers hands-on experience with multiple content management systems (CMS), exposure to different websites and content types, and opportunities to develop technical, problem-solving, and content operations skills.

Employment Level: Entry Level

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines

Working Hours: 9pm to 6am PHT (APR-OCT) or 10pm to 7am PHT (NOV-MAR)

What you'll do

Content Publishing & Management

  • Upload, format, and publish articles, images, videos, and other digital content using content management systems (CMS).
  • Coordinate and schedule content publication according to deadlines and established priorities.
  • Make updates, corrections, and edits to published content based on requests from Editorial and other internal teams.
  • Ensure content is properly formatted, tagged, and presented consistently across different websites.

SEO & Quality Assurance

  • Apply basic SEO best practices, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, and internal linking.
  • Perform quality checks before and after publication to identify formatting errors, broken links, missing images, or incorrect information.
  • Review and correct publishing issues to maintain content accuracy and minimize revision requests.

Task Management & Collaboration

  • Manage and prioritize publishing requests using ClickUp, ensuring tasks are updated and completed within expected timelines.
  • Balance multiple publishing requests and adjust priorities to accommodate urgent updates or changing deadlines.
  • Communicate proactively with Editorial and other internal teams to clarify requests, resolve issues, and flag potential delays.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support efficient content publishing workflows.

CMS Support & Process Improvement

  • Troubleshoot routine CMS and content formatting issues, escalating more complex problems when needed.
  • Participate in CMS testing and provide feedback on website updates, user interface changes, and publishing functionality.
  • Identify opportunities to improve publishing accuracy, efficiency, and existing workflows.

Who you are

  • 1–2 years of experience working with content management systems (CMS), such as WordPress or headless CMS platforms.
  • Experience uploading, formatting, publishing, or maintaining digital content.
  • Familiarity with basic SEO practices, including metadata, headings, image alt text, and internal linking.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, particularly when reviewing content, formatting, and links.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive, detail-oriented tasks while maintaining consistent quality and productivity.
  • Ability to troubleshoot routine content or CMS issues, follow established processes, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Willingness to learn new CMS platforms, receive feedback, and adapt to changing workflows and priorities.
  • Familiarity with ClickUp or similar task management tools is a plus.
  • Must have a working laptop/pc and, internet, and a backup connection.
  • Agile professional who excels in a fast-paced environment and thrives on continuously pivoting strategies to drive business needs forward.

**The duties and responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is in general terms and are not definitive. The job holder is expected to accept any reasonable alterations that may from time to time be necessary.**

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 14 days of annual paid time off, plus all regular Philippine government-declared holidays to unwind and recharge. Plus 5 additional days after 1 year.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Full enrollment in Philippine statutory benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and HDMF.
  • Healthcare: Corporate HMO Plan for all full-time PH employees upon completion of two months of tenure.
  • De Minimis Allowance: Enjoy a monthly rice subsidy, following government guidelines.
  • Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Philippines at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the Philippines throughout their employment with our company.

Salary Range
We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

Monthly Pay Range
₱40,000—₱50,000 PHP

EOE statement

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law.

Pre-employment screening required.

TechnologyAdvice does not engage with external staffing agencies. Any candidates introduced by such firms will not be eligible for compensation. TechnologyAdvice communicates only through @technologyadvice.com emails and official recruiting platforms. We never recruit via Teams, WhatsApp, or similar apps, and we will never request money, gift cards, or personal financial details during hiring.

About Us

Impact Advisors, LLC is a nationally recognized healthcare management consulting firm delivering Best in KLAS advisory, implementation, and optimization services. We are driven by a commitment to exceed client expectations and are proud to be a trusted partner to many of the nation's leading healthcare organizations. Our mission to drive patient-centered, value-driven outcomes has earned us prestigious industry accolades. To learn more about us, visit www.impact-advisors.com.


Job Overview

Impact Advisors is building a security product for health systems, and this is a founding role on it.


The position requires behavioral modeling at scale: establishing baselines across large populations, detecting deviation, and delivering models that perform reliably in production within customer environments. Source data is varied and often not structured for security use, so the work spans raw data through to deployed models.


The successful candidate will own the analytical layer end to end, including feature development, modeling, evaluation, deployment and ongoing operation. Candidates are expected to come from cyber security or an adjacent domain in which the same problem shape occurs, such as fraud, abuse, payments risk or insider risk.

Responsibilities

Modeling and analysis

  • Profile unfamiliar data, assess what it supports, and establish baselines for users, roles, devices and systems
  • Develop detection and scoring approaches using methods appropriate to the problem, including peer group comparison, clustering, classification, outlier detection and time series
  • Tune models against production data, reduce false positives without loss of coverage, and maintain performance as underlying systems change
  • Define evaluation criteria, measurement methods and drift detection

Data and delivery

  • Build the data path supporting the models, from ingestion and normalization through to reliably computed features
  • Own deployment and ongoing operation of models in production
  • Develop visualizations that allow customer security leads to interpret and challenge model output

Applied AI

  • Select the appropriate model for each task across statistical, classical machine learning and language model approaches, and justify the selection
  • Apply small and local models where deployment constraints require them
  • Use AI coding tools as part of standard development practice

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, mathematics, statistics or computer science
  • 5+ years applying data science to a security, fraud, abuse or risk domain, including models deployed to production
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience at data volumes where tooling selection affects outcomes
  • Demonstrated anomaly detection experience: population baselining, peer group comparison, and data-derived thresholds
  • Ability to reason about base rates and alert volume, including deriving required precision from population size and alert capacity
  • Experience building data pipelines
  • Experience deploying and maintaining models in production, including versioning, monitoring and retraining
  • Hands-on experience applying language models in production
  • Clear written and verbal communication of technical findings to non-technical audiences

Additional Information

  • 25% travel to clients

The Chief Engineer for Strategic Systems is an autonomous technical leader responsible for the end-to-end mission success of solid rocket propulsion system programs by managing large multidisciplinary teams, overseeing complex systems engineering processes, and aligning technical execution with budgetary and schedule requirements.

The position reports to the Director of Engineering and is part of the Strategic Systems department based in Folsom, CA. This role can also be located in Reno, NV, Huntsville, AL, Long Beach, CA or can be Remote.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Minimum Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other relevant engineering discipline with 15 years of engineering experience and 5+ years of technical leadership in solid rocket motors (SRMs)
  2. Able to direct the end-to-end technical lifecycle of the program by leading cross-functional teams through rigorous design reviews and qualification milestones, ensuring that the final system is producible, compliant with technical data requirements, and balanced against cost and schedule constraints.
  3. Able to lead the engineering team in meeting all program milestones by maintaining a rigorous focus on the critical path, proactively deconflicting resources, and driving schedule performance through the aggressive management of task span-times and alternative execution strategies.
  4. Demonstrated responsibility in establishing and maintaining lean technical scope baselines by eliminating contingency budgeting, monitoring cost performance indices (CPI) to mitigate variances, and rigorously challenging budget change requests to preserve management reserves through the exploration of alternative technical solutions.

  2. Current DoD Secret Security clearance

Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements:

  • Ability to lift, move or carry items or equipment up to 50 pounds

This is a senior software sales role responsible for developing new Enterprise clients for Agiloft’s contract lifecycle management (CLM) solutions business. You will engage with customers and prospects to analyze business needs and requirements, articulate value-driven solutions, including AI-powered capabilities, and guide complex opportunities from discovery through close using disciplined sales execution and forecasting.

A proven mastery of the full sales lifecycle with the ability to present and execute a strong win strategy y , and be comfortable tailoring Agiloft’s messaging to the tge multiple buyer personas we serve. Success in this role requires comfort in independently operating and driving the sales lifecycle in your territory, managing complex deals, and balancing multiple priorities.

Job Responsibilities

    Sales Execution & Deal Ownership

  • Sell Agiloft’s CLM platform to new Enterprise customers, owning opportunities from qualification through close
  • Develop and execute your win strategy and help your customers buy the Agiloft CLM platform, with confidence and within forecasted timescales.
  • Develop and execute close plans aligned with MEDDPICC criteria, including metrics, decision process, paper process, and champion validation
  • Manage complex deal structures, procurement processes, and customer buying committees
  • Maintain accurate records of account activities, opportunities, and sales forecasts in Salesforce / Clari in accordance with sales best practices
  • Provide regular updates to sales leadership on progress, account strategies, and forecast accuracy

Would you enjoy working with diverse technologies and exercising multiple computer science techniques?

Would you like to solve technical challenges for our customers?

Join our Cloud Engineering team!

The Security Technology Group develops products that protect our customers from online threats. These threats include phishing, ransomware, bot-attacks and all types of malware, to shield from identity/financial theft.

Partner with the best

You will be developing using Golang/Python involving complex threat detection algorithms in an ultra-high traffic environment. You will be involved in creating both platform and product related services. You will work closely with Cloud Engineers, Product Engineers, Data science and DevOps to manage projects, provide creative solutions, and develop successful implementations.

As a Software Engineer Senior, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning feature delivery from requirements and design through release.
  • Building modular infrastructure and product services.
  • Collaborating across teams to integrate existing components.
  • Serving as a SME for key components.
  • Mentoring junior engineers and promoting engineering best practices.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 5+ years of software development experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in Golang and great programming skills in Python.
  • Have experience developing RESTful APIs, HTTP services, and proxies.
  • Have solid knowledge of Linux internals, performance tuning, security, and networking.
  • Have a solid understanding of distributed systems and concurrent programming.
  • Have experience with NoSQL databases such as Cassandra and Redis, including data modeling.
  • Have experience integrating with AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Have experience using AI-assisted development tools to write, review, and test code.

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $121,400 - $218,600/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

raw.title: Chief Risk Officer (CRO)
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Credit Loss Ratio
  • Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
  • Portfolio Delinquency Rates
  • Operational Loss Events
  • Regulatory Findings and Remediation
  • Fraud Loss Reduction
  • AML Compliance Effectiveness
  • Cyber Risk Incident Metrics
  • Risk Appetite Compliance
  • Capital and Liquidity Adequacy
  • Audit and Regulatory Examination Outcomes

raw.title: Senior Enterprise Implementation Consultant
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$100,406—$165,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
