raw.description:
MyOme is a clinical whole genome analysis company helping individuals and families understand their risk for disease. As a leader in polygenic and AI-based integrative risk modeling, we combine genome sequencing with AI-driven analytics and clinical data to deliver a lifetime of clinically meaningful, actionable insights, from proactive risk assessment to rare disease diagnosis. Our laboratory is CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited, and we’re based in Menlo Park, California.

Our team brings together scientists, engineers, clinicians, and professionals across disciplines, united by a shared purpose: making genomic insight a routine part of everyday healthcare. We put patients first and hold ourselves to the scientific and clinical rigor that families and their clinicians depend on.

Joining MyOme means contributing your expertise to work that matters for patients and families. Whether you’re advancing our science and technology, supporting the clinicians and patients we serve, or strengthening our operations, you’ll help turn genomic discoveries into better care.

Position Overview:

MyOme is seeking a motivated Clinical Genomic Specialist to support clinical whole genome sequencing for both Proactive and Rare Disease products. In this role, you will review clinical documentation, contribute to clinical report writing, and provide guidance to ordering clinicians. You will also serve as a genomic testing resource for internal teams, help ensure efficient and accurate order processing, and collaborate cross-functionally to support various projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Review clinical documentation and extract appropriate HPO terms to support interpretation and reporting
  • Draft clinical reports across proactive and rare disease whole genome sequencing products
  • Perform variant assessment and classification across proactive and rare disease whole genome sequencing products.
  • Provide genomic genetic testing expertise and support to the internal client services team regarding test selection, test performance, and laboratory processes.
  • Leverage awareness of current processes and systems to suggest ways to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
  • Work cross-functionally to troubleshoot issues and maintain excellent patient and provider satisfaction.
  • Develop clinical content, including patient-facing education materials and provider resources, to support clear communication and effective use of genetic testing results.
  • Collaborate on publications, product launches, marketing pieces, and other projects as opportunities arise.

What You'll Need:

  • MS in Genetic Counseling from an accredited program and ABGC/ABMG certification or active candidate status required or PhD with clinical diagnostic experience.
  • 1-3 years of previous clinical genetics experience
  • Previous laboratory genetics experience in the exome/genome space preferred
  • Must possess a strong working knowledge of human genetics and diagnostic genetic testing concepts
  • Excellent time management skills, attention to detail, and organized
  • Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, engaging content for a variety of audiences.

Location, Compensation, and Benefits:

  • Location: Remote in the US
  • Compensation: Annual salary range of $95,000 - $125,000, commensurate with experience. This role is eligible for equity.
San Francisco Bay Area pay range
$95,000—$125,000 USD

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Health, Dental, and Vision)
  • 401K
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company-sponsored off-sites and team meals during in-person meetings
  • Direct access to company leadership and the opportunity for career growth

Equal Employment Opportunity and Reasonable Accommodations

MyOme is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. MyOme provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and as otherwise required by law. To request an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact .

Why Work at MyOme?

Join us if you:

  • Want to make an impact at the intersection of healthcare and technology, changing the way people engage with their health at the genetic level
  • Enjoy rolling up your sleeves, taking initiative, and being empowered to lead
  • Value humility, transparency, and collaborative problem-solving
  • Thrive in fast-moving, dynamic environments with smart, driven teammates
  • Appreciate competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits

Learn More: myome.com

Job Description Summary:

JOB LOCATION: Atlanta or Remote (Northeast Corridor)

The Sr. Director, Revenue Growth Management (RGM) Customer Execution, Convenience Retail (CR) and Planning leads a RGM Customer Execution team for CR, supporting the Vice President of CR Sales and the CR Sales Team.

This role serves as the lead RGM and financial partner for the CR business, overseeing customer and System planning, forecasting, price-pack architecture, trade spend, performance management, and business gap-solving. The Sr. Director partners with customers, Franchise Bottlers, Finance, Brand teams, and other cross-functional leaders to deliver volume, revenue, gross profit, and share growth.


This role also manages the Annual Business Planning cycle across all RGM Customer and Franchise Execution teams. This includes working with the VP of RGM Execution leader on customer plan targets, rate coherency adjustments, updates to the planning cube, calendar management, customer planning templates, SOVI rate adjustments, etc.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead annual customer and System business planning for CR, including customer strategies, pricing, price-pack architecture, promotions, trade spend, and execution priorities.
  • Partner with CR Sales to develop Joint Business Plans and identify the right brands, packages, price points, and promotional strategies by customer and shopper occasion.
  • Own volume, revenue, and gross profit planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and customer P&L management.
  • Lead scenario planning and identify risks, opportunities, and actions to close gaps or accelerate business results.
  • Manage a significant CR trade budget and evaluate investment effectiveness by customer, program, package, and promotion.
  • Lead monthly financial reviews, forecast updates, trade spend routines, and executive performance reporting.
  • Translate complex business data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leaders, customers, and Franchise Bottlers.
  • Build strong customer and Bottler partnerships to align customer priorities, marketplace opportunities, and System economics.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop a diverse, high-performing team of RGM Customer Execution for the CR space.
  • Drive consistent planning processes and effective use of tools such as Apollo, CPA, Matrix, Curio, and Power BI.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • 8 to 10 or more years of relevant experience in consumer goods, beverages, Convenience Retail, Sales, Finance, commercial strategy, planning, or RGM.
  • 5 or more years of people, project, or cross-functional leadership experience.
  • Experience supporting Convenience Retail, immediate-consumption channels, or complex retail customers strongly preferred.
  • Experience leading annual business planning, forecasting, pricing, trade spend, customer investments, and P&L management.
  • Strong understanding of RGM principles, including price-pack architecture, assortment, mix, promotions, and investment effectiveness.
  • Strong financial, analytical, scenario-planning, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, customers, Franchise Bottlers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong executive communication and people leadership skills.

What We’re Looking For

A strategic and commercially minded leader who can connect customer strategy, financial planning, and marketplace execution. The successful candidate will turn insights into action, influence across a complex System, and build a high-performing team.

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

Delta Solutions & Strategies is seeking multiple Vosler Academy Curriculum Developers. Curriculum developers will assist in determining education needs and requirements directly affecting Space Force Enlisted Professional Military Education (EPME) across the EPME continuum.

What you will be doing:

  • Support STARCOM, Delta 13 and Vosler Academy education initiatives and assist in solving education needs for Total Force components through development, refinement, and application of education modalities.
  • Use a variety of needs analyses to determine and develop EPME instruction, and evaluation.
  • Oversee the planning, researching, development, evaluation, and revising of EPME curriculum for EPME resident and distributed learning courses.
  • Attends private sector symposiums and training events to assimilate best practices, synchronize EPME educational methodologies with generational requirements, and develop alternate training methodologies.
  • Supervises teams to accomplish Headquarters required curriculum changes, act as Lead Instructional Designer on behalf of Space Force EPME requirements.
  • Develops, reviews, and revises core curriculum and makes recommendations of learning objectives, course content, methodology, textbook design, evaluation instruments, editing and production and other related aspects of curriculum development.
  • Authors innovative input to the curriculum and review processes as well as the curriculum program plan. Designs assigned core course lesson plans for EPME.
  • Determines the need for curriculum changes and updates lessons, readings, tests and rubrics accordingly. Participates in course development and makes major modifications as required to enhance the curriculum. Creates new lesson plans to improve or keep pace with changing educational developments.
  • Establishes course objectives in assigned areas of responsibility to support curriculum development through direct and indirect research and research methodologies covering: leadership, communication, profession of arms, international security theories, and holistic principles and concepts spanning primary, intermediate, senior and executive levels of EPME.
  • Reviews and coordinates on all changes to EPME lesson plans.
  • Reviews and provides professional recommendations on all EPME educational products. Reviews, provides recommendations, and guidance on EPME data generated from evaluation.
  • Reviews seminar, auditorium, and online critiques where appropriate.
  • Stays abreast of course objectives and goals.
  • Participates in the development of the EPME short and long-range educational plans.
  • Additional duties as may be assigned.

What you will need:

  • The ideal candidate has 10+ years experience in a Military Education environment, experience teaching, developing curriculum and experience with Instructional Systems Design and/or the ADDIE process.
  • While a masters degree is preferred a bachelor's degree or real-world experience may be substituted.
  • Experience is not limited to USAF or USSF, experience in other branches is acceptable and desired.
  • While the work location is Peterson SFB, CO (Colorado Springs), remote and/or telework is acceptable. Successful candidates who reside outside of Colorado Springs should expect to travel to Peterson on one or more occasions.
  • Clearance Requirement: Must be able to obtain a Top Secret/SCI
Delta Solutions & Strategies offers a generous benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), PTO, paid holidays, parental, military, and jury duty paid leaves.
In compliance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the salary range for this position is $90,000-$120,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Delta Solutions & Strategies considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

raw.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

As a Senior Analyst Relations Manager at Tailscale, you’ll play a key role in shaping how industry analysts understand our technology, vision, and place in the market. Sitting within Product Marketing, you’ll own and grow our analyst relations program, deepen existing relationships, and build new ones across the broader analyst ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and leadership, dive deep into emerging technologies, and turn analyst insights into meaningful recommendations that influence product strategy, positioning, and business decisions. This is an opportunity to build a high-impact program, shape Tailscale’s presence in evolving markets, and make a tangible difference as we grow.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll help shape product direction, influence analyst perspectives, and strengthen Tailscale’s market positioning. You’ll build and execute a proactive calendar of analyst inquiries, briefings, and research aligned with product priorities and emerging market opportunities. You’ll also turn analyst feedback and market intelligence into actionable insights that inform decisions across the company, ensuring analyst relations becomes a meaningful driver of Tailscale’s growth.

This role might be perfect for you if you have experience in analyst relations at a B2B technology company, an interest in enterprise security and infrastructure, and the curiosity to learn about emerging technologies like AI. We're looking for someone who can confidently engage with analysts, ask thoughtful questions, and exercise good judgment about which insights are most relevant to Tailscale.

Because we're a fully remote company, we're looking for a motivated individual who is comfortable working asynchronously, thrives in ambiguity, and has a focus on getting it right, not being right.

Key Responsibilities

  • Running Tailscale's analyst relations program, establishing a consistent cadence of analyst engagement and ensuring we get meaningful value from our analyst relationships and research subscriptions.
  • Leading regular analyst inquiries across secure connectivity, privileged access management, AI governance, and emerging areas of technology. Develop sufficient product and market knowledge to independently manage most inquiries, bringing in subject-matter experts when needed.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with relevant industry analysts, identifying opportunities for ongoing engagement with established firms and emerging analysts.
  • Capturing and sharing analyst insights, synthesizing key findings, market trends, and recommendations into actionable updates for Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, and leadership.
  • Coordinating and executing analyst briefings, including identifying relevant analysts, preparing briefing materials, working with internal stakeholders, and managing follow-ups.
  • Monitoring analyst research, reports, and emerging market categories to identify opportunities for Tailscale to participate in relevant evaluations, research, and industry conversations.
  • Supporting analyst evaluations and research processes, including preparing submissions, gathering information from internal teams, and coordinating responses to analyst requests.
  • Develop analyst-facing materials in collaboration with Product Marketing that clearly communicate Tailscale's products, positioning, differentiation, and market vision.
  • Maintaining an organized repository of analyst intelligence, making research, notes, recordings, and past conversations easily accessible and useful to internal teams.
  • Supporting original market research initiatives, including industry surveys and internal reports focused on topics such as AI, zero trust, and enterprise security.
  • Tracking program effectiveness, including analyst engagement, research participation, visibility, and internal utilization of analyst insights.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, communications, analyst relations, or a related field within B2B technology, with at least 1 year of experience directly working with analysts.
  • Experience helping establish or improve analyst relations processes and programs.
  • Familiarity with the technology analyst ecosystem, including firms such as Gartner and Forrester and a deep understanding of how analyst inquiries, briefings, and research processes work.
  • An affinity for complex, highly technical subjects and an interest in learning about networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and AI technologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and summarize complex information for different audiences.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify useful insights and distinguish relevant recommendations from broader industry commentary.
  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with analysts and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and systems, with an interest in using AI to organize, surface, and make analyst research and insights more accessible and actionable for internal teams.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple ongoing activities and deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the persistence and follow-through needed to develop relationships and keep projects moving.
  • The ability to work independently, seek input when needed, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • A bias toward action, execution, and iteration.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, networking, infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, or enterprise AI.
  • Existing relationships with analysts covering cybersecurity, networking, infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise technology markets.
  • Experience successfully securing inclusion for their company in a Gartner Magic Quadrant, including managing the submission and evaluation process.
  • Experience with market research, industry surveys, or research-based content.
  • Startup or high-growth technology company experience.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$190,000—$237,000 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .

raw.description:
About You

Do you have a passion for the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry?

Do you want to work across a mix of strategy consulting projects that draw from competitor, customer, medical and commercial insights?

Are you a highly motivated professional interested in being part of a dynamic team of self-starters, working with global healthcare and pharmaceutical clients across the full product life cycle?

If so, consider turning your expertise into a valuable career at Prescient. We welcome applications from experienced life science consultants with a track record of leading client engagements and developing teams to join our growing Competitive Strategy practice.

About Our Competitive Strategy Practice

Prescient has four core practices: Commercial, Competitor Intelligence, Medical, and Value, Pricing and Access. We specialise in supporting our biopharma clients in making insightful strategic choices for their products and portfolios. Our offerings are designed to anticipate and respond to competitive risk across the product life cycle – from early pipeline through post-launch – delivering timely insights and strategic implications that enable integrated decision making across competitive intelligence, marketing, medical and commercial functions.

The Competitive Strategy practice is on an exciting journey to expand our customer-centric team. When you join this exciting venture, you will work with global healthcare and pharmaceutical clients across the full product life cycle, from discovery to loss of exclusivity, to help them unlock the full potential of their brands and portfolios.

As a Principal, you will spend approximately 80% of your time on project delivery and team leadership and 20% on business development, primarily within existing accounts.

About the Opportunity

You will be part of a fast-growing PE-backed business that allows high-performing employees to make an impact and contribute to growing the business. You will have the chance to channel your experience and know-how into supporting the development and commercialization of our clients’ assets and portfolios.

As a Principal, you will lead multiple concurrent engagements end to end – from scoping and design through to final recommendations – with considerable independence. You will lead and develop a team of Engagement Managers, Consultants and Analysts, typically including direct reports, and will be accountable for the quality, timeliness and profitability of the work you oversee.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, shaping the strategic questions our projects are designed to answer, and will partner with Directors and Vice Presidents to grow accounts through our “land and expand” model. You will also help build the practice by participating in or leading internal initiatives such as team training, new methodologies and tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reporting: Report to a Director or Vice President within the Competitive Strategy practice, ensuring clear communication on project portfolio progress, risks, resourcing and account opportunities
  • Project Leadership and Delivery:
    • Lead multiple concurrent competitive strategy and competitive intelligence engagements end to end, owning design, planning, client and people management, evidence collection, analysis and reporting
    • Work with clients to ensure projects are designed to answer the right strategic business questions, and ensure deliverables meet Prescient’s quality standards, timelines and budgets
  • Client Management:
    • Serve as the lead day-to-day relationship holder for client stakeholders, establishing yourself as a credible strategic advisor who anticipates needs and brings a clear point of view
    • Lead challenging client conversations – including scope changes, expectation setting and course corrections – balancing client satisfaction with commercial discipline
  • Business Development and Account Growth:
    • Identify, scope and convert new opportunities within existing accounts, leading proposal development and contributing to pricing
    • Contribute to strategic account plans alongside Directors and Vice Presidents, and pursue opportunities with new brands within existing clients
  • Subject Matter and Therapeutic Area Expertise:
    • Act as a valued subject matter expert externally on the clinical, regulatory and commercial aspects of your therapeutic area(s), and serve as a knowledge resource to internal teams
    • Apply a working knowledge of FDA, EMA and other relevant regulatory guidelines to sharpen competitive insights and implications
  • People Leadership: Line manage, coach and develop Engagement Managers, Consultants and Analysts; support recruitment in coordination with the talent acquisition team; and ensure a sustained focus on delivering concise, impactful insights
  • Practice Development: Participate in or lead internal initiatives that advance Prescient’s capabilities, such as team training, new methodologies and tools, and ensure technology and data & analytics are embedded across programmes
  • Thought Leadership: Contribute to thought leadership content, in collaboration with senior leaders and the marketing team, that strengthens Prescient’s brand and business development activities
  • Conference and External Engagement: Plan and lead conference coverage for your accounts, directing team coverage and engaging with a wide range of experts and delegates at priority symposia, presentations, posters and booths

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience in biopharma consulting or client services, typically 8 or more years in life sciences research, analytics or consulting; CI experience is strongly preferred and a mix of industry and consulting experience is a plus
  • Strong results orientation with a proven track record of:
  • Leading multiple engagements end to end, delivering high-quality outputs on time and within budget
  • Managing and developing team members, ideally including 2 or more years of direct-report experience
  • Contributing to business development, including shaping proposals and growing existing accounts
  • Deep expertise in one or more therapeutic areas – oncology, immunology or biosimilars experience is strongly preferred – including the clinical, regulatory and commercial dynamics of US and EU markets
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA, EMA and other relevant regulatory guidelines
  • Strong client management skills:
    • Credibility to engage senior client stakeholders as a trusted advisor and lead discussions on findings and their strategic implications
    • Experience managing scope and expectations against an agreed statement of work, keeping clients satisfied while maintaining commercial discipline
    • Ability to recognize and act on opportunities to expand Prescient’s support within an account
  • Confident communication skills, with the ability to distill complex matters into a clear business case and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams
  • Ability to dive “in the weeds” while pulling back to see the big picture
  • Demonstrated leadership ability, with a willingness to make decisions and own the follow-through
  • Ability to give and receive feedback constructively
  • Strong learning agility to navigate ambiguity, adapt to change and rapidly acquire new therapeutic or methodological expertise
  • BA/BS required; an advanced degree in a life science discipline is preferred

What We Offer

  • A competitive package and remuneration linked to performance
  • A strong values-based culture grounded in collaboration, curiosity and excellence
  • Tailored career development based on your interests and aspirations – not a one-size-fits-all approach
  • A team of smart, supportive colleagues who invest in each other’s success
  • Leaders who are accessible, ambitious for the team and committed to mentorship
  • An opportunity to lead client engagements and teams, and to help shape our growing Competitive Strategy practice
  • A flexible working schedule and recognition for outstanding contributions
  • A flat hierarchy that empowers you to take ownership and make an impact

About Prescient Healthcare Group

Prescient® is a pharma services firm specializing in dynamic decision support and product and portfolio strategy. We partner with our clients to turn science into value by helping them understand the potential of their molecules, shaping their strategic plans and allowing their decision making to be the biggest differentiating factor in the success of their products. When companies partner with Prescient, the molecules in their hands have a greater potential for success than the same science in the hands of their competitors.

Founded in 2007, Prescient is a global firm with a footprint in 10 cities across three continents. Our team of nearly 475 experts partners with 27 of the top 30 biopharmaceutical companies, the fastest-growing mid-caps and cutting-edge emerging biotechs, including some of the biggest and most innovative brands. More than 70% of our employees hold advanced life science degrees, and our teams deliver an impressive depth of therapeutic, clinical and commercial expertise.

The annual full time base salary range for this role is ($145,000 - $175,000). Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines. Prescient offers PTO and paid holidays, the terms of which are set forth in the program policies. All full-time employees also are eligible to participate in various benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance and 401K; in each case in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Prescient has been a portfolio company of Bridgepoint Development Capital since 2021 and Baird Capital since 2017. For more information, please visit .

We are an equal opportunity employer and fully comply with applicable legislation in all of the geographies in which we operate. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other category protected by applicable national, federal, state or local laws.

Don’t meet every job requirement? That’s okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role, but your experience doesn’t perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

raw.description:
About the Role

    Provectus is an AI consultancy founded in 2010 and led by its founders. As an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic Preferred Partner, we help Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences companies design, build, and operate production AI systems. With offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we work with clients worldwide.

    We are hiring an Account Executive to turn incoming enterprise leads into signed consulting engagements. Clients buy multi-month consulting engagements. You won't build pipeline from scratch. Anthropic and AWS share qualified enterprise leads with us.

    Your job has four parts:

    • Qualify those leads quickly.

    • Run discovery with buyers at banks, insurers and life sciences companies.

    • Scope the work with our architects.

    • Close.

What You'll Do

    • Pick up new leads as they arrive, decide which to pursue, and be able to explain why

    • Working knowledge of Financial Services (banking, insurance, capital markets) or Life Sciences (pharma, biotech). You have worked in the industry or sold into it, and you can discuss a buyer's process and regulatory constraints in their terms

    • Experience selling services engagements or complex B2B deals with several stakeholders

Nice to Have

raw.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

The Operations Specialist, CX Ops is an individual contributor role within the Customer Experience (CX) Operations team, supporting Implementation teams across Granicus. This role is focused on operational enablement, process excellence, tooling stewardship, and cross-functional coordination.

The CX Operations team serves as a connective layer between frontline CX teams and internal partners, ensuring that Implementation teams are equipped with clear processes, effective tools, and actionable insights to deliver consistent, high-quality customer outcomes. The CX Operations Specialist plays a critical role in translating operational complexity into scalable standards and practical guidance for teams — operating independently across a wide range of work, from daily administrative tasks to highly strategic priorities, while remaining organized, dependable, and accountable.

AI tools are a standard part of how this role operates. The CX Operations Specialist is expected to actively embed AI into day-to-day work, continuously build AI capability, and translate data and AI-generated insights into clear, actionable narratives that connect operational decisions to broader business outcomes.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

Process Improvement & Documentation

  • Identify operational bottlenecks across processes, departments, platforms, and workflows, and analyze their root causes
  • Independent Problem-Solving and Ownership: Demonstrates a strong result-oriented mindset, is persistent, and is comfortable independently navigating unfamiliar or ambiguous problems. Proactively investigates options, uses available information and resources, and brings forward recommended solutions rather than relying on step-by-step direction.
  • Experimentation and Continuous Improvement: Approaches problems with a practical test-and-learn mindset. Willing to try new ideas, assess results, learn from unsuccessful approaches, and adapt until an effective solution is found—without requiring continuous guidance or reassurance.
  • Partner with CX leadership to develop and implement tailored standard operating procedures that improve Implementation workflows and efficiency
  • Author and own documentation for operational processes and automated workflows
  • Engage with operating teams and management to propose innovative ideas, introduce new processes, and share insights derived from data analysis

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare regular reports and dashboards using Wrike, Microsoft Excel, and Salesforce to summarize key performance metrics
  • Help frontline managers interpret Utilization, Resource Forecasting, Revenue Forecasting, and Timesheet reporting
  • Identify trends, risks, or issues in operational data and provide concise commentary explaining what the data means and why it matters to business outcomes

Operational Support & Tooling

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on operational workflows, systems, and tools, providing guidance to team members and management
  • Provide day-to-day operational support to Implementation Project Managers, including tool assistance, project navigation, troubleshooting, and maintenance
  • Support timesheet management, project assignments and quality checks, SKU maintenance, and KPI management
  • Manage Wrike users and support platform governance
  • Operationalize and maintain new tools, solutions, and processes to optimize CX team performance

Training & Enablement

  • Own the CX Ops training curriculum for Implementation teams
  • Develop, administer, and refine a catalog of modules that teach, test, and measure operational knowledge across time-tracking, project administration, resource management, and other relevant topics
  • Deliver live enablement sessions in English to large groups when required
  • Facilitate internal discovery sessions to understand how Granicus CX teams support customers

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a key link between Customer Experience teams and internal stakeholders, including Business Systems and Finance
  • Ensure effective issue escalation and timely resolution
  • Contribute actively to CX Ops team culture, build strong peer relationships, and support the team wherever needed

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Five or more years of experience in a similar operations role, preferably in a SaaS or technology-driven environment
  • Experience in a post-sales organization; Professional Services or Client Delivery experience is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated end-to-end process improvement experience, including discovery, solution development and proposal, implementation coordination, communication, and enablement
  • Advanced experience with CRM software such as Salesforce and project management or professional services automation platforms; Wrike experience is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience identifying trends or issues and developing data-driven commentary and recommendations
  • Training and enablement experience, including confidence presenting live in English to large groups and helping audiences adopt new processes or tools
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple seniority levels
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, manage, and follow through on complex, multi-phase internal projects such as acquisition integrations, software platform migrations, and cross-functional process improvements
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data into a clear story: identifying trends, risks, or issues and providing concise, actionable commentary
  • A business degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Monday.com, ClickUp, Kantata, or Rocketlane in a professional services or implementation context
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to operational workflows, reporting, or process documentation
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Background in public sector, government technology, or civic engagement SaaS environments
  • Experience supporting or leading acquisition integrations, platform migrations, or large-scale cross-functional transformation initiatives
  • Familiarity with Granicus products, CX delivery models, or government digital services

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
  • A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

Overview

The Principal Healthcare Consultant will play a central role in helping our clients to execute strategies to help them compete and win. We partner with health plans to adapt their product strategies to the evolving needs of their clients, creating offerings that strengthen and sustain their competitive advantage. The Principal works alongside plan client leaders in product management and line-of-business leadership to deliver on this opportunity: designing competitively differentiated benefits and services products for employer groups with highly tailored needs and finding where such investments can create leverage across books of business.

The Principal then leads engagements alongside our other consultants to execute this strategy, translating it into technology and operational designs, and enabling them within the plan's ecosystem. Strategic product thinking paired with practical execution is what sets us apart from traditional consulting firms. The Principal will be instrumental in achieving this balance, advising executive clients to set product strategies that can win share in the market, while ensuring that client staff and NASCO successfully execute the strategy to achieve desired goals.

Responsibilities

  • Advises health plan executives on product strategy and innovation, helping them decide what to bring to market, when, and for which segments
  • Leads product strategy engagements from framing through executive readout, including portfolio review, product concept definition, and prioritized roadmaps
  • Defines and designs competitive health plan products, including benefit and plan design, network and pricing constructs, and funding arrangements, working with plan product, actuarial, finance, and sales partners to balance cost, value, and feasibility
  • Helps plans respond to highly tailored employer group needs, identifying where group requirements can be met through configurable offerings rather than one-off builds and where product investments create leverage across books of business through shared capabilities and sequencing that reduce costs and shorten time to market
  • Assesses market, regulatory, and competitive dynamics, including national carrier positioning, to shape offerings that differentiate rather than follow
  • Translates product strategy into executable plans, targets, success measures, and timelines aligned to plan years, rate filings, and bid cycles
  • Leads engagement on strategic work, directing the contributions of other consultants who take plans through operational design, configuration, and enablement within the plan's ecosystem
  • Participates in strategic pre-sales pursuits alongside commercial leaders, leading executive discoveries, framing customer problems, and establishing the value case before solutions are positioned
  • Develops practice points of view and reusable frameworks on health plan product strategy and innovation, working with the Market Intelligence team to ground them in current market data, and builds our reputation as a strategic partner by sharing them through customer forums, industry events, and published perspectives, including case studies and proof points of customer outcomes
  • Shares customer and market insight with product management to inform roadmap priorities and positioning

Qualifications

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Consulting or advisory experience serving health plans
  • Experience at a Blue Cross Blue Shield plan or national carrier, or familiarity with Blues plan operations and inter-plan programs
  • Product leadership across multiple lines of business, including Medicare Advantage product development and bid experience
  • Familiarity with core payer administration platforms and how platform capabilities enable or constrain product design
  • Published perspectives, industry speaking, or recognized thought leadership in health plan product strategy

Experience

  • 10 years of experience in healthcare payer operations, product management, product strategy, healthcare consulting, or related leadership roles
  • 5 years of experience leading complex strategic initiatives or consulting engagements
  • 5 years of experience working on or with health plans
  • 8 years in consulting, strategy or solution design
  • Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and influencing strategic business decisions
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving multiple business functions and stakeholder groups

Required Training, Certification and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Finance, Marketing, or a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred Training, Certification and Education

  • Master’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field
  • Advanced coursework or formal training in innovation, portfolio management, or healthcare transformation

Working Conditions

  • Remote home office
  • Requires frequent interaction with internal and external stakeholders
  • Travel up to 20% may be for customer workshops, executive sessions, and industry events
  • Must be able to use workstation at least 8 hours a day

Benefits Overview

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

Physical and Mental Health Benefits

  • Choice of Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits
  • Generous PTO with buy/sell options
  • 9 Company holidays, a floating day off, and a day off for volunteering
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness program - earn insurance discounts or credit towards health-related items

Financial Health Benefits

  • 401K Plan with employer matching contributions
  • Company-funded spending/reimbursement accounts to help with out-of-pocket medical expenses
  • Bonus and Recognition programs
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Consultation with financial planner
  • Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
  • Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

Other Benefits

  • E-Learning – Comprehensive and current library of e-learning and performance support assets, available on demand and at no cost

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

raw.description:
Sponsor Dedicated Senior Medical Writer (Regulatory Submission Documents)- US Remote Based

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

The role could be remote based from the following locations: US or Canada


This Sponsor dedicated role will involve partnering closely with Clinical Scientist and will be focused on Protocols and Protocol Amendments.


  • Leads the clear and accurate completion of medical writing deliverables, ensuring scientific information is presented clearly and accurately. Manages medical writing activities associated with individual studies, coordinating medical writing activities within and across departments with minimal supervision. Leads the resolution of comments from the client.
  • Completes a variety of documents that may include clinical study protocols and clinical study protocol amendments; clinical study reports; patient narratives; annual reports; investigator brochures; informed consents; annual reports; plain language summaries; periodic safety update reports, clinical development plans; IND submissions; integrated summary reports; NDA and eCTD submissions; journal manuscripts; and abstracts, posters, and presentations for scientific meetings.
  • Adheres to established regulatory standards, including, but not limited to, ICH E3 guidelines, as well as company standard operating procedures, client standards, and company and/or client approved-templates, authorship requirements, and style and formatting guides, when completing medical writing projects, on time and on budget.
  • Coordinates quality and editorial reviews. Ensures source documentation is managed appropriately. Leads team document reviews, and reviews documents as needed.
  • Acts as peer reviewer for internal team to ensure document scientific content, clarity, overall consistency, and proper format.
  • Reviews statistical analysis plans and table/figure/listing specifications for appropriate content, and for grammar, format, and consistency. Provides feedback to further define statistical output required and document needs.
  • Interacts and builds good working relations with clients, department head, and peers in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs, as necessary, to produce writing deliverables.
  • Performs online clinical literature searches and complies with copyright requirements.
  • Identifies and proposes solutions to resolve issues, escalating as appropriate. Provides technical support, training, and consultation to department and other company staff. May contribute to development of internal materials and presentations or changes to internal process, standard practices, and capabilities.
  • Mentors and leads less experienced medical writers on complex projects, as necessary.
  • Develops deep expertise on key topics in the industry and the regulatory requirements and guidelines that affect medical writing.
  • Aware of budget specifications for assigned projects, working within the budgeted hours and communicating status and changes to medical writing leadership.
  • Completes required administrative tasks within the specified timeframes.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required (less than 25%).

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in medical writing, with proven experience in Protocol writing
  • Experience working in the biopharmaceutical, device, or contract research organization industry required.
  • Experience with late development
  • Experience with Oncology/Hematology/Cell therapy.
  • Strong understanding of FDA and ICH regulations, other regulatory guidelines, and/or good publication practices strongly required.
  • Experience writing relevant document types required.
  • Experience in working with Veeva/CARA.
  • Extensive knowledge of English grammar and ability to communicate clearly; strong familiarity with AMA Manual of Style.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

$80,600.00 - $145,000.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

raw.title: Practice Director, Cloud Services - US-Based
raw.excerpt: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand.
raw.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is an innovative organization that is disrupting the global professional services and talent market. In response to our clients’ overwhelming demand for exceptional talent in new areas, we are expanding the breadth and depth of our Technology Services offerings, including Hybrid Cloud and DevOps, to fuel the next phase of growth. As a Practice Director for Toptal’s Cloud Services practice, you will lead and develop the team of solution architects who design, sell, and deliver hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions for our clients.

You will set the technical vision and standards for the team, shape the solutions it takes to market, and be empowered to work across organizational lines to build a world-class architecture practice. This leader will be a proven expert in hybrid cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices, and a proven people leader who has built and managed teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants. The right candidate will understand target buyers, their priorities, and the trends impacting them. Their knowledge will inform which solutions the team builds out, how we scope and package what we do, and how we create a competitive value proposition now and in the future to meet changing market needs.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for leading Toptal’s Cloud Services Team. This includes:

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of solution architects. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Hiring Talent: Recruit, onboard, and retain top solution architects, and ensure the team has the right skills in the right capacities (e.g., hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, SRE, security) to meet market demand.
  • Architecture Standards: Define reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions, and review the team’s solution designs for quality, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Pre-Sales Leadership: Partner with Sales to assess client needs, define solution approaches, and shape proposals and technical presentations. Ensure architects are matched to the right opportunities, and lead key client conversations yourself.
  • Solution Development: Work with practice and delivery leadership to turn repeatable solutions into scalable offerings, such as hybrid cloud architecture and migration, landing zones, container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD and DevSecOps, SRE and observability, and FinOps.
  • Delivery: Partner with Delivery to ensure designs are implemented successfully. Guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions, and step in directly on critical engagements.
  • Capacity and Performance: Plan team capacity, manage workload and utilization across opportunities and engagements, and track key team metrics such as pipeline support, win rate, and client satisfaction.
  • Partnerships: Build relationships with key technology and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat, HashiCorp) and keep the team’s certifications and partner alignment current.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay current on hybrid cloud, platform engineering, and DevOps trends; contribute to marketing content that builds the team’s reputation with clients and in the market.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Remain hands-on by owning architecture for strategic accounts and building proofs of concept, modeling the standard you expect from the team.

This role is highly collaborative and will work extremely closely with our Marketing, Sales, Delivery, and Talent Operations teams to fulfill the above responsibilities.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal; meet your colleagues and the Solution Architects on your team.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of our industry, Toptal’s operating model, and the core messages important to Toptal.
  • Shadow critical teams throughout the organization to learn Toptal’s core operations and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Begin developing relationships with key leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Dive deeper into the operations of key teams (e.g., Sales, Talent Operations) across the company.
  • Conduct a comprehensive review of current demand in your practice area, talent that already exists in the network, active engagements, and any work we may already be doing or have done.
  • Assess the skills, strengths, and development needs of your Solution Architects.
  • Articulate a hypothesis about how to grow the team’s impact (priorities, structure, and standards) and design experiments and execution approaches to get there.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Sales (Enterprise/SMB), Marketing, and Talent Operations.
  • Be in front of clients on a regular basis to hear from them firsthand.
  • Define the team’s operating model, architecture standards, and pre-sales engagement process.
  • Build your team and begin positively impacting revenue growth.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have moved from purely planning to execution.
  • See an impact from your involvement in early initiatives, including repeatable solutions in market and a growing pipeline supported by your team.
  • Establish key partner relationships and a clear hiring and talent plan for the team.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Feel like you made the best decision of your career.
  • Increase the growth rate of Toptal materially.
  • Have a high-performing, fully staffed Solution Architect team recognized for Hybrid Cloud and DevOps expertise.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA is preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering and architecture, with at least 5+ years leading teams of solution architects or senior engineers within cloud or technology services.
  • 3+ years managing a business or team, preferably with P&L or budget responsibility, and a proven track record of overseeing financial performance, identifying areas for improvement, and driving profitability and growth.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants.
  • Proven ability to build and scale hybrid cloud and DevOps service offerings in a consulting, managed services, technology services, or enterprise environment.
  • Deep expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including connectivity, identity, governance, and workload placement across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with data center and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) and hybrid cloud technologies (e.g., Azure Arc, AWS Outposts, Google Distributed Cloud).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker), serverless computing, and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and automation frameworks (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Argo CD).
  • Expertise in DevOps and platform engineering practices, including DevSecOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), observability, and the use of delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to drive improvement.
  • Experience with cloud migration and application modernization strategies, disaster recovery, and business continuity in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks and practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS), including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization, and of emerging trends such as AI-enabled infrastructure and operations, and edge computing.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP Architect; CKA/CKAD; Terraform Associate) are a plus.
  • Ability to develop strong relationships with enterprise clients and executives to drive hybrid cloud and DevOps consulting engagements.
  • Proven ability to lead collaboratively and operate in a high-growth environment.
  • Skilled in articulating a strategy with a strong, agile execution plan.
  • Comfortable with rolling up your sleeves to do the work, demonstrating traction, and building a team over time.
  • Demonstrated success in making data-driven decisions and defining key metrics to measure progress.
  • Ability to walk in the shoes of your audience in order to understand their challenges, develop and execute an approach to solve them, and articulate the solution in a clear and compelling way.
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Refined relationship development and leadership skills with a track record of building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Confidence in your analytical abilities, with proven success in delivering results in ambiguous and sophisticated project efforts.
  • Skilled in the art of communicating (written and verbal) with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

About Translated

Translated is an AI-enabled language services company on a mission to allow everyone to understand and be understood in their own language.

We combine Lara, our AI translation model, with a network of more than 700,000 vetted professional translators, matched to every job by T-Rank and orchestrated through TranslationOS, our AI-first localization delivery platform. This symbiosis of artificial intelligence and human expertise lets us design localization programmes that were previously unthinkable, helping more than 360,000 clients grow their business worldwide.

We are looking for a Senior Account Executive to join Translated's Enterprise Growth team and accelerate our growth in your market. You will own new business across a named list of enterprise accounts in travel and luxury, e-commerce and automotive, building on the customers, references and pipeline Translated already has.

You will sell an AI-first way of working with language: routing each piece of content to the right mix of AI and human expertise, measuring quality objectively, and helping global companies reduce time and cost without compromising brand voice or compliance. You will work with localization, digital and procurement leaders as a trusted advisor, not as a vendor.

We are offering a full-time remote role for an employee based in France or the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), with regular travel in your market and to Rome.

Responsibilities

  • Own new business in your territory, with a personal annual net-new target, from first contact to signed contract.
  • Build and run account plans for a named list of enterprise targets.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, referrals and partnerships with consulting firms and technology partners.
  • Lead consultative sales cycles: discovery, content and cost assessments, AI pilots, business cases, negotiation and closing.
  • Run RFPs, RFIs and supplier onboarding with large procurement teams, including framework agreements and security reviews.
  • Work with our solutions, operations and account management teams to design proposals that protect margin.
  • Hand new customers over smoothly to Account Management and stay involved in their first expansion.

Requirements

  • A consultative seller who is genuinely curious about AI and can explain AI translation, human-in-the-loop workflows and quality measurement to both localization and procurement leaders.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding quota, including enterprise deals above €250k closed as the lead seller.
  • Trained in and using a structured sales methodology (for example MEDDICC, Challenger or Miller Heiman).
  • Confident presenting to buying groups and senior executives, and running workshops with customer teams.
  • A self-starter with a pursuit mentality and the energy to grow a territory, not just manage one.
  • Creative and resourceful: you look for new ways to open doors and get things done.
  • Knowledge of translation management systems, machine translation or LLM-based tools is a plus, as is experience with software localization, multilingual publishing or regulated content.
  • Languages: native French, German, or Italian, fluent English.

Required Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in a similar sales role in the translation & localization industry, and prior experience with the full life cycle of a sales process.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a growing environment
  • Experience selling to multinational companies through procurement-led buying processes.
  • Bachelor's degree or above, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience working in a remote, international team.
  • A valid passport for international travel.

Headquarters

Translated is hosted at Pi Campus, a working environment immersed in nature where 5 luxury villas in Rome (Italy) have been converted into functional offices to foster talent growth. Pi Campus is also a venture firm created by Translated to reinvest part of its profits into promising AI startups.

Application Process

We will conduct an initial screening based on the information you provide about yourself and your experience. Candidates whose profiles align with the job requirements will be contacted for an initial introductory call. Successful candidates will then be invited to an interview to discuss their experience.

If everything goes well, we will make you an offer to join our team.

Diversity statement

At Translated, we proudly embrace and celebrate each individual's unique qualities to our team, regardless of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other differences. We recognize that these diverse perspectives empower us to overcome challenges, foster innovation, and drive excellence. As an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to cultivating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported to achieve their full potential.
